«Esas ideas son muy hermosas en teoría pero no son practicables; los nombres necesitan un poder ponderador que los gobierne y obligue a respetar el contrato social». Esa es la última objeción que nos dirigen los partidarios del actual orden social cuando, después de haber discutido, se han quedado sin argumentos y demostrado que el trabajador no puede esperar ninguna mejora sensible para su suerte conservando los mecanismos del actual sistema social.

«Esas ideas son muy hermosas, pero no son practicables; el hombre no está bastante desarrollado para vivir en estado tan ideal. Para ponerlas en práctica sería necesario que el hombre hubiera llegado a la perfección», añaden muchas personas sinceras, pero que, extraviadas por la evolución y la rutina, no ven más que las dificultades y no están bastante convencidos de la idea de trabajar por su realización.

Además, al lado de esos adversarios declarados y de los indiferentes que pueden convertirse en amigos, surge una tercera categoría de individuos, más peligrosos que los adversarios declarados. Esos se fingen entusiastas por las ideas; declaran en alta voz que no hay nada más hermoso; que nada vale la organización actual, que debe desaparecer ante las ideas nuevas, que son el fin al cual debe tender la humanidad, etc., etc. Pero añaden que no son practicables ahora; hay que preparar para ella á la humanidad, guiarla á comprender ese estado dichoso, y con pretexto de ser prácticos, tratan de rejuvenecer esos proyectos de reformas que acabamos de demostrar que son ilusorias; perpetúan las preocupaciones actuales, lisonjeándolas en aquellos á quienes se dirigen, y tratan de sacar el partido mayor posible de la situación actual en beneficio personal, y pronto desaparece el ideal para que lo sustituya un instinto de conservación del actual orden de cosas.

Desgraciadamente, es demasiada verdad que las ideas, objeto de nuestras aspiraciones, no son realizables inmediatamente. Es demasiado ínfima la minoría que las ha comprendido para que tengan influencia inmediata en los acontecimientos y marcha de la organización social. Pero eso no es una razón para no trabajar por realizarla.

Si estamos convencidos de que son justas, debemos tratar de llevarlas á la práctica. Si todo el mundo dice que no son posibles, y acepta pasivamente el yugo de la sociedad actual, es evidente que el orden burgués durará todavía largos siglos. Si los primeros pensadores que lucharon contra la iglesia y la monarquía, por las ideas naturales y por la independencia, y afrontaron la hoguera y el patíbulo, para confesarlas hubieran pensado así, todavía estaríamos en los tiempos de los conceptos místicos y los derechos feudales.

Gracias á que siempre hubo gente que no era práctica, pero que estaba convencida de la verdad, y trataron de hacerla penetrar con todas sus fuerzas por donde pudieron, empezando el hombre á conocer su origen y á deshacerse de las preocupaciones de autoridad divina y humana.
En su libro que realmente vale, Bosquejo de una moral sin obligación ni sanción, desarrolla Guyau, en un capítulo admirable, la siguiente idea: «El que no obra como piensa, no piensa por completo». Es verdad. El que está bien convencido de una idea no puede menos de propagarla y de tratar de realizarla.

title: Gerîla TV revamped
content:
Gerîla TV (

gerillatv.net

), which operates as HPG’s video broadcasting channel, will continue its activities with a renewed broadcasting infrastructure and content structure.


A promotional statement issued by the channel said that Gerîla TV broadcasts footage related to the activities of groups described as the Kurdistan Freedom Guerrillas, as well as documentaries, cultural content, historical programs, and commemorative content about members who have lost their lives.


Gerîla TV stated that the footage it broadcasts is recorded directly by cameras in the field and therefore presents its content “from the primary source.” The channel broadcasts mainly in Kurdish, while also producing content in other languages when necessary.


In the renewed broadcasting period, greater emphasis will be placed on archiving and preserving older footage, as well as producing new digital content. The channel says that through this work, it aims to pass on the memory, life, and historical experience of the guerrilla movement to future generations.


Gerîla TV noted that efforts to collect, archive, and make available to the public footage and documents from the areas where events take place will continue. The channel said that in the new period, it will continue its work without interruption to produce, document, and publish original content.

author: Frenny Jowi
title: Tanzania’s VAT Refund Revolution: The Quiet Reform That Could Unlock Billions in Private Investment
content:
When governments unveil annual budgets, headlines focus on the big numbers: spending, growth and tax collection.


But sometimes the real story sits quietly in the technical annexes.


Tanzania’s 2026/27 budget, due to take effect from July, includes plans for 6.3%GDP growth and the biggest spending plan in the country’s history while narrowing the deficit. Yet one quieter reform may prove more consequential: VAT refunds.


This mundane issue has been one of the biggest friction points in Tanzania’s investment story for years.


For exporters, manufacturers and institutional investors, delayed VAT refunds have long acted like an invisible tax. Businesses routinely waited months, sometimes years, to recover money they were legally owed. By 2025, pending refunds had reached

roughly $650 million

. In effect, companies were financing the state with their own working capital, often without a clear repayment timeline.


Investors notice these things. A country may advertise a competitive VAT rate, generous incentives and ambitious growth plans. But if businesses cannot reliably recover VAT credits, the real cost of doing business rises sharply. In 2021, Tanzania attracted $1 billion in foreign direct investment, compared with Ethiopia’s $4.3 billion — more than four times Tanzania’s total — and Uganda’s $1.1 billion (

UNCTAD World Investment Report 2022

). The gap has many causes, but administrative friction is consistently high on investor concern lists.


The 2026/27 budget introduces a mandatory 30-day timeline for VAT refunds, backed by statutory interest if the government fails to pay on time. Previously, refund timelines functioned more as administrative guidance than enforceable law. Now delays carry a financial cost for the state, turning VAT refunds into a binding obligation.


The more revealing question is why Tanzania tolerated these delays for so long. The structural answer lies in asymmetric law: the tax code imposed serious penalties on businesses that underpaid, but set no equivalent consequences for the Revenue Authority when it failed to refund on time. As

Deloitte Tanzania

 noted in a review of the system, that asymmetry gave the TRA little institutional incentive to act urgently — and so the backlog accumulated. What has changed is political economy as much as policy. President Samia Suluhu Hassan’s

Presidential Commission on Tax System Reforms

 identified VAT refunds as a structural barrier to her administration’s investment targets. With Tanzania’s reliance on external financing falling sharply — aid now covers

less than 1% of the 2026/27 budget

, down from 23% of government revenue in 2024 — attracting private capital has become a fiscal imperative, not merely an ambition. The government cannot afford to keep losing investors to avoidable administrative dysfunction.


The scale of the problem should not be underestimated.

Anthony Chamanga, Chief Development Manager of the Tanzania Horticultural Association

, warned that sustained VAT refund delays had led to “dire financial straits, with some companies failing to meet critical obligations such as loan repayments and timely salary disbursements.” Across sectors, the pattern was the same: legitimate credits trapped in the system and quietly eroding business finances.


That is what this budget aims to change. As Rahim Dossa, Vice Chairman of the Tanzania Truck Owners Association, noted, the reform will “improve cash flow, reduce investment costs and support fleet expansion.”


The benefits extend further: lenders can assess financing needs more confidently, and investors can model returns with greater accuracy. In short, capital becomes easier and cheaper to deploy.


The significance of this reform extends beyond VAT administration.


For years, African governments have competed for investment by offering tax holidays, exemptions and special incentives. While such measures can help, investors often care just as much about predictability and administrative efficiency.


A tax incentive is worth little if it takes years to access. A favourable tax rate means less if compliance is cumbersome and refunds remain trapped in bureaucracy. The budget suggests Tanzania increasingly understands this reality.


The regional backdrop makes the change more significant.

In Kenya, VAT refund delays remain a complaint among exporters despite formal mechanisms.

 Uganda also sees cash-flow strain linked to compliance and verification.

title: İYİP'ten kimler istifa etti? Ömer Karakaş'ın ayrılığı sonrası güncel sandalye sayısı
content:
İYİ Parti’de milletvekili istifalarına bir yenisi daha eklendi. Aydın Milletvekili Ömer Karakaş, kurucusu ve milletvekili olduğu İYİ Parti’den istifa ettiğini açıkladı. Karakaş’ın istifasıyla İYİ Parti’nin 2023 seçimlerinde 43 olan milletvekili sayısı 27’ye düştü.

Karakaş, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, “Kurucusu ve milletvekili olduğum İYİ Parti’den, gördüğüm lüzum üzerine istifa ediyorum” ifadelerini kullandı.

Karakaş’ın istifasının ardından AKP’ye katılacağı yönündeki iddialar da gündeme geldi.

İYİ Parti Genel Başkanı Müsavat Dervişoğlu ise Karakaş başta olmak üzere partiden ayrılan isimlere tepki gösterdi.

Dervişoğlu, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, “Her cepheden saldırdıklarına göre, bilin ki doğru yoldayız. İlk kez eksilmiyoruz... İlk kez bölünmüyoruz… İlk kez ihanete uğramıyoruz…” ifadelerini kullandı.

Dervişoğlu, açıklamasının devamında, “Gönderdiğiniz akbabaların kopardığı et, bizi hem acıtmaz hem de tüketmez. Bu siyasi namus bataklığında siz boğulacaksınız, biz değil” dedi.

İYİ Parti, 14 Mayıs 2023 seçimlerinde yüzde 9,69 oy alarak Meclis’e 43 milletvekili gönderdi. Ancak seçimlerin ardından parti içerisindeki ayrışmalar milletvekili grubuna da yansıdı.

Karakaş’ın istifasıyla birlikte seçimlerden bu yana İYİ Parti’den ayrılan milletvekili sayısı 16’ya yükseldi. İstifa eden vekillerin bir bölümü AKP ve CHP’ye katılırken, bazı isimler ise bağımsız kaldı veya başka partilere geçti.

İYİ Parti’den 2023 seçimlerinin ardından ayrılan milletvekilleri ve sonraki siyasi durumları şöyle:

• Koray Aydın – Ankara: Bağımsız

• Kürşad Zorlu – Ankara: AKP’ye katıldı

• Nebi Hatipoğlu – Eskişehir: AKP’ye katıldı

• Ümit Dikbayır – Sakarya: CHP’ye katıldı; mutlak butlan kararının ardından CHP’den de ayrılarak bağımsız kaldı

• Adnan Beker – Ankara: CHP’ye katıldı; daha sonra bağımsız kaldı

• Ayşe Sibel Yanıkömeroğlu – İstanbul: Önce CHP’ye, ardından YENİ Parti’ye katıldı

• Ersin Beyaz – İstanbul: AKP’ye katıldı

• Nimet Özdemir – İstanbul: AKP’ye katıldı

• Ünal Karaman – Konya: AKP’ye katıldı

• Seyithan İzsiz – İstanbul: AKP’ye katıldı

• Ahmet Ersagun Yücel – İstanbul: AKP’ye katıldı

• Mehmet Salim Ensarioğlu – İstanbul: AKP’ye katıldı

• Bilal Bilici – Adana: Önce CHP’ye, ardından YENİ Parti’ye katıldı

• Ümit Özlale – İzmir: Önce CHP’ye, ardından YENİ Parti’ye katıldı

• Mehmet Mustafa Gürban – Gaziantep: Bağımsız

• Ömer Karakaş – Aydın: Bağımsız

İYİ Parti’den ayrılan 16 milletvekilinin önemli bölümü AKP’ye katıldı. Kürşad Zorlu, Nebi Hatipoğlu, Ersin Beyaz, Nimet Özdemir, Ünal Karaman, Seyithan İzsiz, Ahmet Ersagun Yücel ve Mehmet Salim Ensarioğlu AKP saflarına geçti.

CHP’ye katılan bazı milletvekilleri ise daha sonra bu partiden de ayrıldı. Böylece İYİ Parti’nin 2023 seçimlerinde elde ettiği 43 sandalyenin önemli bir bölümü farklı siyasi adreslere dağıldı.

İYİ Parti, seçimlerin üzerinden üç yılı aşkın süre geçerken 43 milletvekiliyle başladığı Meclis dönemini 27 milletvekiliyle sürdürüyor.

author: Unknown
title: AKP kurucuları 'Türk tipi başkanlık sistemi felaketimiz oldu' diyor
content:
"Aydınlığa açık, karanlığa kapalı" sloganıyla 14 Ağustos 2001’de yola çıkan, 3Y’yi (yoksulluk, yolsuzluk, yasaklar) ortadan kaldırma vaadiyle iktidara yürüyen AKP, 25’inci yaşını çeşitli programlarla kutluyor. Ancak partiye ilk harcı koyan kurucu kadrolar ve çeşitli dönemlerde önemli görevler üstlenmiş olanların eleştiri okları da dikkat çekiyor.

Ali Babacan, Ahmet Davutoğlu, Abdüllatif Şener, Hüseyin Çelik, Haşim Kılıç… Hepsi bir dönem Erdoğan’a çok yakın olan fakat daha sonra yolu ayrılan isimler ve bugün eski partilerini eleştiren bir noktadalar.

Partinin ilk Başbakanı ve 11. Cumhurbaşkanı Abdullah Gül 2022’de Karar gazetesine verdiği röportajda partinin kuruluş vizyonu ile bugünü arasındaki uçurumu işaret ediyor: "Ak Parti’nin ilk döneminde bütün bürokraside mesleklerinde yetişmiş insanlarla çalıştık. Şimdi sapma görüyorum. Artık önemli makamlarda kariyerinden çok siyasi geçmişi öncelikli insanlar var."

Kendisine yöneltilen sitemlere ise 2020 yılında Ocak Medya’dan Veysi Dündar’a verdiği röportajda ‘kuruluş belgesi’ ile yanıt veriyor: "AK Parti’nin vizyon belgesini yazdım ve hala ona uyuyorum… O belge ne diyorsa ben o rotadayım… AK Parti’nin kurucu ilkelerinden yolunu çeviren ben miyim? Elimdeki 30 km öteyi gösteren dürbün ile baktığımda gördüğüm engeli, engebeyi işaret ettiğim için suçlanmam haksızlık değilse nedir?"

Gül AKP’den koptuğu süreçte yorumlarını hep sınırlı tuttu ve aktif siyasette yer almadı. Ancak bir ay önce Saadet Partisi'nin düzenlediği D-8 zirvesinde Ahmet Davutoğlu, Ali Babacan, Fatih Erbakan ve Mahmut Arıkan ile verdiği ortak fotoğraf siyasete dönüp cumhurbaşkanı adayı olabileceği iddialarına yol açmıştı.

Partinin ‘ağabeyi’, eski TBMM Başkanı Bülent Arınç ise partiden kopmamakta ısrarcı ama “hafızasızlık” ve “Cumhurbaşkanlığı Hükümet Sistemi'nin getirdiği kontrolsüz güçten” son derece rahatsız. Partinin kuruluş yıl dönümü reklamlarında ve tanıtım videolarında geçmişin silinmesine üç gün önce BBC’ye verdiği röportajda isyan ediyor:

"Öyle videolar hazırlıyorlar ki sadece Tayyip Bey var. Tarihi tersine çeviremezsiniz kardeşim. Orada ben de varım, Abdullah Bey de var, Ali Babacan da var. Bu insanlara bakarak AK Parti'yi iktidara getirdiler. Siz bir bütünleşmeyi sağlayacaksanız yola beraber çıktıklarınızı unutmayacaksınız. Yolda bulduklarınızın büyük kısmı duygusal sebeplerle seviyor; o duygular azaldığında sel gider, kum kalır, biz kalırız.”

Arınç, Cumhurbaşkanlığı Hükümet Sistemine ise sert eleştiriler getiriyor:

"Şu anda cumhurbaşkanımız her şeyi yapabilecek güçte ve kudrette. Ama Amerika'da mesela bir büyükelçi atamasını bile Senato'dan geçirmek zorunda. Sistemi düzeltin; ehliyete, liyakate, istişareye önem verin."

AKP’nin ilk 10 yılı ile sonraki döneminin birbirinden farklı olduğunu belirten Arınç, buna karşılık liderin değişmediğine dikkat çekiyor: “11 sene Başbakanlık, 11 seneden fazla Cumhurbaşkanlığı yapıyor, aynı zamanda parti Genel Başkanlığı devam ediyor. Sistem revize edilmeli diye düşünenlerdenim ben.”

AKP’den istifa edip DEVA Partisi’ni kuran Ali Babacan, bugün “AKP ile yeniden iş birliği yapılır mı?” sorusuna Nisan ayında gazetecilerle buluşma etkinliğinde şöyle yanıt veriyor: "Ben AK Parti'nin kurucularından birisiyim. Programında, sözünde, hepsinde benim imzam var. Zaman içerisinde bu kuruluş değerlerinden maalesef uzaklaşıldı. Ehil ve dürüst insanların yerine yanlış insanların devlet kademelerine getirilmesi, kararların istişare edilmeden alınması bizim ayrılık sebeplerimiz. AK Parti’de ve Sayın Erdoğan’da değişim iradesinin zerresini görmüyoruz."

Eski Milli Eğitim Bakanı Hüseyin Çelik ise yine Nisan ayında Ankara'da düzenlenen bir konferansta eleştiri okunu doğrudan sistemin kalbine, "Partili Cumhurbaşkanlığı" modeline atıyor:

"Partili cumhurbaşkanlığı ve bugünkü bize has, 'Türk tipi' başkanlık sistemi bizim felaketimiz olmuştur. Şimdi siz cumhurbaşkanısınız ve bir partiniz var. Muhalefet partisine ağzınıza geleni söylüyorsunuz. O size karşılık verdiği zaman cumhurbaşkanına hakaret etmiş oluyor. Bugün geldiğimiz nokta itibariyle beni de çok rahatsız eden şeyler var. Tayyip Erdoğan'dan sonra AKP'nin yaşama şansı yok."

AKP’yi kapatma davasından kurtaran isim olarak da anılan eski Anayasa Mahkemesi Başkanı Haşim Kılıç, aynı konferansta yargı ve ifade özgürlüğü üzerindeki vesayete dikkat çekiyor: "2010 Anayasa değişikliği sonrasında ‘Düşünceni içinde tut, sakın dışarı vurma’ anlayışı egemen oldu."

2008 yılında AKP'nin siyasi kaderinin pamuk ipliğine bağlı olduğu …

author: Unknown
title: Iranian forces arrest Kurdish environmental activist in Sanandaj
content:
The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that Iranian security forces raided Kurdish environmental activist Awat Karami’s family home in Negel on the evening of 9 August, arresting him violently and without a warrant.


Despite repeated visits and efforts by his family to obtain information about his situation, the security and judicial authorities have continued to refuse to respond or provide any explanation.


No information is yet available regarding the reason for Karami’s arrest or the charges brought against him.


Karami is a well-known environmental activist who has played an active role in containing forest fires in the Zagros region and in various environmental campaigns.


Ministry of Intelligence forces previously arrested him in Negel on 16 January 2019. After months of interrogation at the ministry’s detention facility and the Shahramfar detention facility operated by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation in Sanandaj, he was provisionally released on bail in June 2019.


Branch One of the Islamic Revolutionary Court of Sanandaj later sentenced him to 40 months in prison on the charge of “acting against national security” through cooperation with the Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK).

content:
One of the biggest upsets from Democratic primary elections this month was Donavan McKinney’s defeat of two-term Congressmember Shri Thanedar in the House primary to represent parts of Detroit and Wayne County in Michigan’s 13th District. McKinney, a democratic socialist state lawmaker, won on a platform to get corporate money out of politics, support Medicare for All and end military aid to Israel, among other issues. Like many other insurgent Democrats running for office, he has also proposed strict limits on artificial intelligence data centers. He took no corporate

PAC

 money, and his campaign was supported by the Justice Democrats, Working Families Party, Democratic Socialists of America and major labor unions.


“We built the biggest and baddest coalition in the country,” says McKinney of his win. “People have come together and realized that our district deserves better.”

author: Sophia Sheera
title: Israel Is Removing Rubble From Gaza ‘to Erase Evidence’ of Genocide
content:
Israel is removing rubble caused by demolitions and bomb blasts in Gaza to wipe away evidence of the ongoing genocide, rights groups say. 


Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor estimates that 10 million tonnes of rubble have been carted away from the 66% of Gaza under Israeli military control. 


That means evidence of war crimes is being destroyed before forensics teams can investigate, the group says – and the remains of victims under the rubble are being taken away. 


Transforming forcibly depopulated Palestinian neighbourhoods into levelled spaces under Israeli control is an act of ethnic cleansing, the NGO added. 


“The bulldozing is an integral part of all attempts to destroy the lands in Gaza City and in the Gaza Strip in general,” Amnesty International researcher Budour Hassan

told Al Jazeera

. 


“The real fears are that these operations are taking place with the aim of obliterating and hiding evidence.”


Around 400 machines used to demolish, crush and transport rubble are being used by Israeli civilian companies under military protection in eastern and southern Gaza, according to Euro-Med. 


Sites being emptied of rubble include potential crime scenes where Palestinians were unlawfully killed, their homes destroyed and civilian infrastructures like hospitals flattened. 


Article 70(1)(c) of the Rome Statute, the treaty which informs the International Criminal Court, considers “destroying, tampering with or interfering with the collection of evidence” to be a criminal act. The court is currently investigating war crimes and crimes against humanity in Palestine. 


Israel has killed at least

 73,389 Palestinians

 and wounded another 174,266 in Gaza since October 2023.  About

10,000 are missing

, with many believed to be buried underneath rubble.

title: Une grave faille de sécurité dans Tails corrigée
content:
Le 5 août, l'équipe de développement de

Tails

, le système d'exploitation portable «

 

contre la surveillance et la censure

 

», très utilisé comme outil de sécurité numérique par les militant-es, a proposé une mise à jour d'urgence pour résorber une faille de sécurité majeure.


Les failles de sécurité concernaient le noyau Linux et l'utilisation du navigateur Tor Browser. La première et la plus inquiétante, qui était ouverte depuis 2020, permettait via le navigateur Tor d'obtenir des privilèges de navigateur système et ainsi de pouvoir désanonymiser l'utilisateur·ice du système Tails. La seconde était une vulnérabilité qui pouvaient être exploitée en ouvrant un fichier malveillant dans des applications comme LibreOffice, Audacity ou Git.


L'équipe de Tails recommande ainsi à l'ensemble de ses utilisateurices de bien réaliser la mise à jour

7.10.1

 qui vient corriger ces failles. Il est possible de faire la mise à jour directement depuis sa clé Tails, soit automatiquement si la dernière version installée n'est pas trop ancienne, ou bien de manière manuelle en suivant

les instructions en ligne

.

author: A.N.A.
title: [Alemanha] Encontro Anarquista de Munique – 2 a 4 de outubro de 2026
content:
Munique está morta?


O machismo, o consumo excessivo de álcool e a monotonia conservadora parecem ser inescapáveis ​​na Baviera. Em reação a esse atraso, sempre houve um movimento anarquista fervoroso em Munique. Queremos manter a chama acesa e continuar as autênticas tradições bávaras da Revolução de Novembro de 1918 e da República Soviética da Baviera: Contra a guerra, contra a paz, pela revolução!


Nosso foco é a militarização e a contínua miséria do povo. Os líderes do governo querem a mobilização geral. Se você ficar para trás, será considerado subumano. Nós, como movimento anarquista, precisamos partir para a ofensiva, em vez de implorar insensatamente aos políticos e pedir esmola ao “estado social”. Para isso, precisamos nos coordenar e ter uma estratégia comum.


Já começamos a organizar distribuições/mesas de livros, compartilhamento de habilidades, música e debates. Traga e organize suas próprias ideias, escreva-nos um e-mail ou simplesmente inicie uma ação espontânea quando estiver aqui. Nosso principal interesse é conhecer novas pessoas, criar ideias juntos e, por meio disso, reconectar a Baviera com o movimento em outros lugares. Organize-se, colete ideias e prepare declarações e textos para trazer. Não vamos dar tudo mastigado para você, todos precisam assumir a responsabilidade. Portanto, o evento será o que fizermos dele!


Viva a anarquia, abaixo a cela da ordem!


Se você quiser participar do planejamento, reservar uma mesa, realizar um evento ou tiver qualquer outra dúvida, não hesite em nos enviar um e-mail para: abarrio@systemli.org.


Informe-nos se precisar de um lugar para dormir; se necessário, organizaremos um acampamento.

author: A.N.A.
title: [França] 45º aniversário da Radio Libertaire
content:
No próximo dia 1º de setembro, completam-se 45 anos da primeira transmissão da 

Radio Libertaire

 em FM. Depois de ter entrado como emissora pirata entre as rádios candidatas à obtenção de uma frequência, após uma longa luta contra o poder estatal — uma luta marcada por manifestações, violência policial e diversas ameaças —, a 

Radio Libertaire

, a rádio da Federação Anarquista, se estabeleceu de forma definitiva na frequência 89,4 FM na Île-de-France e transmite 7 dias por semana, 24 horas por dia. E na internet: 

https://www.radio-libertaire.org/accueil.php

  

 

Para comemorar isso como se deve, e como fazemos a cada 5 anos, a 

Radio Libertaire

 e a Federação Anarquista estão organizando uma grande festa de apoio que acontecerá nos dias 7 e 8 de novembro na sala Olympe de Gouges, na rua Merlin, 15, no 11º distrito de Paris.

 

A programação está sendo elaborada e estamos trabalhando nela com empenho. Durante esses dois dias, mesas-redondas e shows, transmitidos ao vivo e com público presente, se alternarão.

 

A programação completa será divulgada nas próximas edições do 

Le Monde Libertaire

. Desde o seu início, a 

Radio Libertaire

 pôde contar com o apoio incondicional dos artistas e, em especial, dos cantores: Ferré, Lavilliers, Guidoni e tantos outros. Da mesma forma, em 2026, os artistas estarão presentes para cantar e dançar.

 

As mesas-redondas organizadas durante esses dois dias refletirão os temas e as lutas que unem os anarquistas, tanto local quanto internacionalmente. Mobilização contra todas as formas de fascismo da sociedade, contra a militarização da juventude, apoio aos anarquistas presos na Rússia, luta contra a digitalização de nossas vidas, contra as depredações capitalistas exercidas pela energia nuclear, pela inteligência artificial e seus data centers…

 

Dois dias para nos reunirmos, refletirmos, mobilizarmos e contribuirmos para o futuro de uma rádio cuja independência e espírito combativo se provarão muito valiosos nos próximos anos.

title: [Grécia] Cartaz: Liberdade para todos os acusados no caso Marfin
content:
A S S A S S I N A T O

 

cometido pelos ricos e poderosos para preservar suas posições privilegiadas e incutir medo em seus potenciais oponentes. Lemos sobre os assassinatos assustadoramente frequentes perpetrados pelo Estado grego. Desde pessoas baleadas à queima-roupa nas ruas por policiais até barcos cheios de migrantes, tentando alcançar a costa europeia, sendo deliberadamente afundados pelos militares. E eles nos matam de muitas outras maneiras.

 

Em 5 de maio de 2010, nenhum dos manifestantes tinha a intenção de que as pessoas dentro do banco Marfin morressem. Foi um momento de conflito social — um entre tantos naqueles anos — que tomou um rumo terrivelmente errado. Essa é a verdade dura, porém simples. Aqueles que detêm o poder sabem muito bem que matar pessoas aleatórias não faz parte da tradição combativa dos anarquistas e de outros revolucionários sociais. Ao mentirem deliberadamente sobre isso, demonstram mais uma vez sua determinação em desacreditar e, por fim, eliminar as ideias de liberdade e rebeldia que motivam essa tradição.

 

O Estado e seus lacaios não dão a mínima para vidas humanas. Eles não hesitam em pisar em cadáveres se isso servir para consolidar seu próprio domínio. Com o espetáculo que o governo encena mais uma vez em torno das novas prisões no caso Marfin — bem como com o momento escolhido para tal —, não nos esqueçamos: ele busca ganhar votos e fazer com que seus críticos se sintam pequenos e amedrontados.

 

Eles só conseguem sonhar em expandir seu poder. Enquanto nós sonhamos com sua destruição total. E é nessa direção que continuaremos avançando.

 

Sempre ao lado daqueles que lutam

LIBERDADE PARA TODOS E PARA OS ACUSADOS NO CASO MARFIN

title: Beyond the Gold Controversy: Appropriation and the Historical Making of Sabarimala
content:
Abstract: The recent controversy surrounding the alleged theft of gold at the Sabarimala temple has largely been discussed as an instance of administrative failure or criminal misconduct. This essay approaches the controversy differently. Rather than investigating the alleged theft itself, it uses the episode as a contemporary point of departure to examine the longer historical processes through which Sabarimala has been shaped by religious, cultural and institutional appropriation. Drawing on folklore, oral traditions, colonial ethnography, and scholarship on Buddhism and indigenous worship in Kerala, the essay argues that the shrine emerged from multiple overlapping religious traditions, including Chathan worship, kaavu traditions, Mala Araya cosmologies, Buddhist influences, and regional guardian-deity practices. These traditions were subsequently reinterpreted, institutionalised and incorporated within a dominant Brahmanical framework. Read in this broader historical context, the contemporary controversy is not simply an isolated event but an opportunity to reconsider enduring processes of ritual transformation, institutional control and material accumulation. The essay therefore invites a sociological reading of Sabarimala as a contested cultural landscape whose history reflects continuing negotiations over religious authority, memory and ownership.

Introduction: The recent controversy surrounding the alleged theft of gold at the Sabarimala temple has largely been interpreted as an episode of administrative failure, corruption or criminal misconduct. While these concerns remain significant, this essay approaches the controversy from a different perspective. It does not seek to establish the circumstances surrounding the alleged theft. Rather, it argues that the controversy provides a useful lens for examining the longer historical processes that have shaped Sabarimala. Read in this way, the debate over gold is less about a single contemporary incident than about enduring questions of religious authority, cultural memory and institutional control.

The essay argues that appropriation at Sabarimala should be understood not merely as the transfer of material resources but as a broader historical process involving the reorganisation of ritual authority, sacred landscapes and systems of religious legitimacy. The accumulation and control of sacred wealth are inseparable from earlier transformations through which indigenous traditions, local ritual practices and alternative religious histories were gradually absorbed, reinterpreted and institutionalised within a dominant Brahmanical framework. The alleged gold theft therefore becomes significant not because it explains this history, but because it draws renewed attention to it.

Rather than proposing a single alternative origin for Sabarimala, this essay situates the shrine within multiple overlapping religious traditions that coexisted and evolved over centuries. These include Chathan and kaavu traditions, Mala Araya cosmologies, Buddhist influences and regional guardian-deity worship. Drawing on folklore, oral traditions, colonial ethnography and interdisciplinary scholarship on religion, caste and Kerala’s cultural history, this essay adopts a historical-sociological reading of Sabarimala as a layered religious landscape. It examines how these traditions were selectively appropriated, sanitised and reconfigured through processes of institutionalisation and religious transformation. Seen in this broader historical context, the contemporary controversy becomes an opportunity to reconsider the historical making of Sabarimala and the continuing negotiations over culture, authority and ownership that define the shrine today.

Conceptualising Appropriation: This essay understands appropriation as a sociological process through which dominant institutions absorb, reinterpret and legitimise existing cultural and religious traditions while simultaneously reshaping their meanings, authority and ownership. Appropriation therefore extends beyond the acquisition of material resources to encompass the reorganisation of ritual practices, sacred spaces and collective memory. title: [Buch] Politischer Streik. Geschichte, Recht und Beispiele
content:
„

Der Inhalt dieses Buches hat vier Teile: Der erste Teil beschäftigt sich mit den politschen Streiks im Kontext der Geschichte bis zum Ende der Weimarer Rrepublik. Der zweite Teil beschäftigt sich mit der Geschichte des Rechts auf politschen und verbandsfreien Streik, und zwar mit Schwerpunkt ab 1945 bis zur Gegenwart. (…) Der dritte Teil zeigt an konkreten Beispielen, wie dieses angebliche Verbot von verbandsfreien und politschen Streiks immer wieder durchbrochen wurde.  Der vierte Teil gibt praktische Hinweis und Argumentationshilfen. In einem umfangreichen Anhang werden eine Liste mit verbotenen Streiks, ein Glossar, der Wiesbadener Appell und die „Qualifikationen“ des Hans Carl Nipperdey beschrieben (…). Dieses Buch soll nicht nur dazu beitragen, eine Debatte zu eröffnen über die Notwendigkeit, die Einschränkungen des Streikrechts zu beenden: Ohne politischen Streik keine Demokratie. Dieses Buch beschreibt auch konkrete, gangbare Schritte für den Praktiker, um diese Einschränkungen zu überwinden

.“ So fasst der Mit-Herausgeber Benedikt Hopmann die Intention des Buches im PapyRossa Verlag zusammen. Siehe mehr Informationen und zusammenfassende Argumentationshilfe sowie praktische Hinweise als dankenswerte Leseproben (es gibt keine Ausreden mehr!):


Politischer Streik. Geschichte, Recht und Beispiele


Benedikt Hopmann / Duygu Kaya / Alex Kübler / Günter Watermeier (Hg.)


PapyRossa Verlag, Köln Juni 2026


Paperback, 351 Seiten, zahlr. s/w-Abb.

Unser Recht auf Streik


Eine zusammenfassende Argumentationshilfe


Benedikt Hopmann


Das herrschende Recht zerstört den natürlichen Zusammenhang zwischen wirtschaftlichem und politischem Streik. So war der Tarifkampf für die Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall ein hochpolitischer Streik. Als er erfolgreich durchgefochten war, wurde wenig später auch eine entsprechende gesetzliche Regelung geschaffen. Trotzdem war dieser Streik im Jahr 1956/57 im rechtlichen Sinne kein politischer Streik, weil er auf einen Tarifvertrag und nicht gegen den Staat gerichtet war. Streiks, die sich an den Staat richten, werden als politische Streiks definiert – und politische Streiks sollen verboten sein.


Entgegen der herrschenden Meinung sind Streiks gegen den Staat jedenfalls dann nicht verboten, wenn sie auf die »Förderung und Wahrung der Arbeits- und Wirtschaftsbedingungen« (Artikel 9 Absatz 3 Grundgesetz) gerichtet sind.


Entgegen der herrschenden Meinung müssen auch Streiks, die nicht auf die »Förderung und Wahrung der Arbeits- und Wirtschaftsbedingungen« gerichtet sind, also Streiks mit rein politischen Zielen, erlaubt Das muss jedenfalls für den Proteststreik gelten, der auf maximal einen Tag befristet ist und auf dem abhängig Beschäftigte ihre Meinung zum Beispiel zur Verteidigung des Friedens, zum Schutz der Umwelt oder gegen rassistische Morde kundtun. Abhängig Beschäftigte dürfen nicht im Betrieb gezwungen werden, auf eine kollektive Meinungsäußerung zu verzichten.


Das Bundesverfassungsgericht hat schon vor Jahrzehnten die herausragende Bedeutung des Grundrechts auf Meinungsfreiheit und des Grundrechts auf Versammlungsfreiheit für die Demokratie hervorgehoben: »Die Meinungsfreiheit […] gilt als unmittelbarster Ausdruck der menschlichen Persönlichkeit und als eines der vornehmsten Menschenrechte überhaupt. […]


Wird die Versammlungsfreiheit als Freiheit zur kollektiven Meinungskundgabe verstanden, kann für sie nichts grundsätzlich anderes gelten. […] Indem der Demonstrant seine Meinung in physischer Präsenz, in voller Öffentlichkeit und ohne Zwischenschaltung von Medien kundgibt, entfaltet auch er seine Persönlichkeit in unmittelbarer Weise […] das Recht, sich ungehindert und ohne besondere Erlaubnis mit anderen zu versammeln, galt seit jeher als Zeichen der Freiheit, Unabhängigkeit und Mündigkeit des selbstbewussten Bürgers.« Wer meint, diese Freiheit zur kollektiven Meinungskundgabe habe nicht während der Arbeitszeit zu gelten, sagt nichts anderes als: An den Eingängen zu den Betrieben und Büros haben wir »Freiheit, Unabhängigkeit und Mündigkeit des selbstbewussten Bürgers« abzugeben. title: KON-MED: Let’s meet at the 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival
content:
The 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival, which will bring together Kurds and their friends from across Europe, will be held in Dortmund on 5 September under the slogan “Democratic Society with a Free Leadership.” The festival will celebrate Kurdish language, culture, art and folklore while emphasizing the determination to build a democratic and free future.


The Confederation of Democratic Societies of Kurdistan (KON-MED) issued a written statement calling for participation in the festival and announcing the bus routes and departure times.


The statement reads as follows:


“The 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival, one of the largest gatherings of the Kurdish people in Europe, will take place in Dortmund on 5 September 2026. As the Kurdish people, we will once again come together in a strong way around our history, culture, language, art and determination for freedom.


This year, our festival will be held under the slogan ‘Democratic Society with a Free Leadership.’ Today, for the Kurdish people, preserving our culture and defending our language, art and history means not only protecting the past, but also demonstrating our determination to build a free and democratic future. As Kurds living across Europe, while preserving our identity and culture, we are also expanding the struggle for a democratic, free and peaceful society.


The festival to be held in Dortmund on 5 September will be a powerful expression of this determination. At our festival, where tens of thousands of people will come together, we will celebrate the richness of our culture through Kurdish music, folklore, literature and art. Together with our women, young people, children and all sections of our society, we will hold a great cultural gathering. This festival is a meeting point for our defence of our identity and our determination to build a democratic future.


For this reason, we invite all our people living across Europe, our friends and the democratic public to Dortmund on 5 September.


Every family, every young person, every woman and every child should take their place at this great gathering together with people from their own communities. Come, let us meet in Dortmund with our language, our culture, our art and our determination for freedom. Come, let us together strengthen the Kurdish people's determination for a democratic society and a free future.


We invite all our people, especially our women and young people, to attend the 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival, to be held in Dortmund on 5 September, wearing traditional clothing!”

title: Prof. Lemkow: Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom must be at the centre of the process
content:
The draft 'Framework Law', entitled “Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Cohesion” and prepared as part of the “Democratic Society and Peace Process,” was first discussed by the Parliamentary Justice Commission and then by the General Assembly after being submitted to the Speaker of Parliament. The draft was approved in a vote by the General Assembly.


Prof. Louis Lemkow, a sociologist at the University of Barcelona who has been closely following the process, spoke to ANF about the draft framework law. Lemkow said the legislation was an important step but that its scope remained insufficient. Describing the law as “a first step,” he said, “It is a modest step, but nevertheless I think it is important that this law has been passed.”


Lemkow said the law creates a basis for negotiations and provides an opportunity to make progress towards the release of political prisoners. “This law does not cover everything that is needed for peace, but despite that, it is important,” he added.


 


‘Legal and international guarantees must be provided’


Prof. Lemkow emphasized that additional legal and political guarantees would be needed for the peace process to move forward, and said these guarantees could be established with the support of international authorities or with the contribution of a mediation group.


Saying that an international presence would contribute to the process, Lemkow said, “As far as I can see, experience shows that an international presence is always useful. I think international pressure will contribute to the progress of the process. Pressure and an international presence can be very helpful in providing these guarantees and moving forward.”


Regarding the return to Turkey of PKK members and politicians living in exile, Prof. Lemkow said the current situation remained unclear and that it was not yet clear whether the law provided these people with legal protection. He added: “We do not know whether the law that has been passed actually provides such legal protection. We need to see. This is a legal regulation that should provide these guarantees. The fact that it has ultimately passed through parliament is important,” Lemkow said.


‘We would like to see more’


Assessing the scope of the law, Lemkow said it was difficult to understand why it had been limited to 2005. He noted that this limitation could leave some activists and PKK members outside the scope of the law. “In this sense, the scope of the law needs to be expanded,” he said, adding that although the current legislation was insufficient, it could open up new areas for negotiation. “I don’t think this covers everything we want or everything we need to have. Nevertheless, this is a beginning. It is a step towards creating space for negotiation and for moving forward,” he said.


‘Abdullah Öcalan must be free’


Emphasizing that the fact that Önder Apo’s status remains undefined is a major shortcoming, Prof. Lemkow said that “Abdullah Öcalan’s situation is decisive” for the peace process to move forward.


Prof. Lemkow said, “Of course, Öcalan needs to be released. That is clear. It may not happen in the short term, but it is possible.”


Underlining the important role international pressure could play in securing Önder Apo’s freedom, Prof. Lemkow said, “There has already been an international constituency calling for Öcalan’s freedom. This is exactly the time to insist on that.”


Pointing out that peace processes are complex and long-term, Lemkow referred to the examples of South Africa and Ireland. Despite the difficulties encountered in those processes, he said progress had been achieved. “We were able to release political prisoners and really achieve a sustainable peace; we were able to create this space for genuine peace and tranquility,” he said.


‘The rights of the Kurdish people must be legally guaranteed’


Lemkow agreed with criticism that the law does not sufficiently guarantee the rights of the Kurdish people, and added that for lasting peace, it was necessary not only to address the situation of political prisoners but also to legally guarantee the fundamental rights of the Kurdish people.


Lemkow particularly highlighted the right to education in one’s mother tongue. “What is certain is that this is not the law we were expecting. title: Yılmaz: 'Framework Law' is important, but it will not solve the Kurdish question on its own
content:
The 'Framework Law' expected as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process was adopted by the General Assembly of Parliament with 468 votes. For the 12-article legislation to enter into force, the National Security Council (MGK) must determine and confirm that all organizations affiliated with the PKK/KCK have dissolved themselves and that arms have been completely laid down. If this condition is met, the legislation provides for the postponement of investigations, prosecutions and finalized convictions in relation to the offences covered by the proposal. The legislation excludes from its scope people who received aggravated life sentences before 2005 or who were convicted of offences carrying an aggravated life sentence.


Ercan Yılmaz, chair of the Amed branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), spoke to ANF about the 'Framework Law' adopted by Parliament. He said: “Many people who have spoken out on the Kurdish issue, expressed their views and made democratic demands have faced investigations and prosecutions because of anti-democratic provisions in Turkish legislation. So we regard this as an important initiative and stage in resolving the Kurdish question.


Because until now, everyone who has spoken out, taken action or made demands concerning the resolution of the Kurdish issue has faced considerable judicial pressure because of the adverse laws in Turkish legislation. As you know, particularly after 2015, following the end of the 2013–2015 period and the ongoing peace process, there was an attempted coup. A state of emergency was declared after the coup attempt, and many pieces of legislation, including already problematic laws such as the Turkish Penal Code and the Execution of Sentences Law, were made even more restrictive and turned into instruments of repression against opponents. Those who were generally subjected to the harshest sanctions were people who expressed their views and opinions on the Kurdish question.”


The way must be opened for participation in social life


Yılmaz said legal reforms were important in addressing the situation that had emerged during four decades of conflict, and stressed that the way must be opened for democratic politics and public debate. Pointing out that the framework law was also an important step towards enabling prisoners to return to social life and citizens who had been forced to leave the country to return to Turkey, Yılmaz continued: “Today, in terms of partially addressing the situation that emerged during these forty years of conflict, it is an important stage to eliminate the punishments imposed under these legal provisions, particularly in order to open the way for the issue to be discussed through democratic means.


Despite its many shortcomings, we believe this is an important legal change in terms of enabling people to participate more freely in social life in the next phase of the process, allowing citizens who were forced to leave the country to return, and enabling citizens who cannot return to Turkey because of accusations or convictions of PKK membership to participate in social and political life. Of course, this legislation alone is not sufficient to resolve the Kurdish question.”


Some issues becoming taboos is a cause for concern


Yılmaz recalled that human rights defenders and lawyers had submitted numerous proposals during the preparation of the law. He said: “Since the framework law was first discussed as a legislative proposal, many sectors, human rights defenders and lawyers have repeatedly expressed their views on the issue. We, too, expressed our views as the Human Rights Association. We should say that seeing some of these views reflected in the legislative proposal gives us satisfaction and hope in terms of resolving the Kurdish question. But the fact that some issues are still treated as taboos and remain outside the scope of this law will cause the process to take somewhat longer.”


Not a single citizen should continue to face judicial pressure


Emphasizing that the struggle must continue following the adoption of the law in its current form, Yılmaz said the legislation represented an important stage but that those excluded from its scope must also remain on the agenda. He said: “According to figures reported in the media, the release of approximately 4,000 prisoners, the return of approximately 2,000 PKK militants to Turkey, and the return of thousands of citizens who were forced to seek refuge in different countries …

author: collection
title: DDR-Reise-1986
content:
Der folgende Film ist die digitalisierte Fassung einer analogen Audiovision, die ich 1986 nach einer Jugendgruppen-Reise in die DDR zusammen mit meinem Freund Martin Buchholz erstellt habe. Wir besuchten Stralsund, Rostock und die Insel Rügen. Die AV-Show erzählt nicht vorrangig eine (Reise-)Geschichte, sondern ist eher impressionistisch angelegt. Aber die wechselnden Eindrücke bilden dann doch die ständige kognitive Dissonanz ab, der wir uns während dieser einen Woche ausgesetzt sahen. Besonders beispielhaft sind hier die Aufnahmen aus der zum Meeresmuseum umgewidmeten Stralsunder Katharinenkirche.


Die ursprüngliche Präsentation ist komplett analog entstanden: Fotos aufgenommen mit Olympus OM-Spiegelreflexkameras auf Kodak ED200 (5076) Farbdiafilm, alle einzeln in Glasdiarahmen montiert. Für die Überblendprojektion kamen zwei Kodak Carousel 2000 S-AV Projektoren zum Einsatz, betrieben von einem Electrosonic ES62 Steuergerät. Die Tonmischung fand auf einem Tascam 4-Spur-Cassettendeck statt, die Musikzuspielung erfolgte von Vinyl-LP. Da die Tascam die Tonspuren nicht sauber trennte, ist in leisen Musikpassagen manchmal der Steuerton mitzuhören. Eine digitale  Nachbearbeitung mit Adobe Audition konnte dies nicht komplett beseitigen.


Die Dias wurden mit einer aktuellen spiegellosen Canon R6 mit 20 MP digitalisiert. Bei der Bildbearbeitung stand eine möglichst originalgetreue Wiedergabe im Vordergrund. Nur starke Unterbelichtung und Farbstiche durch das Alter des Materials wurden etwas ausgeglichen, sowie Kratzer und Flecken entfernt.


Die zu hörenden Musikstücke sind:


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. V, 4. Satz


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. VI, 1. Satz


Johann Sebastian Bach, »Dorische« Toccata und Fuge


Edvard Grieg, In der Halle des Bergkönigs (aus den Peer Gynt Suiten)


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. VI, 4. Satz (Finale)


Bedenkt man, dass sowohl die Originaldias als auch die Ton-Cassette satte 40 Jahre alt sind, ist die Qualität noch erstaunlich gut. Auch der auf Computer-Endlospapier handgeschriebene Mischplan ist noch erhalten. Ob die digitalen Geräte und Daten jemals so eine Lebensdauer erreichen werden, ist nicht sicher. Die digitalen Kameras der ersten Generationen nutzten Speicher, für die es heute kaum noch Laufwerke gibt (zB. Sony Mavica mit 3,5” Disketten). Die damalige Bildqualität war nach heutigen Maßstäben katastrophal. CD/DVD-Laufwerke, die zur Jahrtausendwende noch massenhaft zur Archivierung  verwendet wurden, sind heute in keinem modernen Computer mehr verbaut. Dateiformate und Betriebssysteme ändern sich, viele der modernen Kameras nutzen proprietäre RAW-Formate, die möglicherweise in wenigen Jahren von dann weiterentwickelten  Programmen nicht mehr lesbar sind. Wie überhaupt Digitalfotos ohne ein entsprechendes Lesegerät einfach nichts wert sind, während man ein analoges Dia, Negativ oder Papierbild »einfach so« betrachten kann.

title: 17 августа - День рождения политзаключённого Никиты Уварова
content:
Поздравьте Никиту с днём рождения!

Как пишет группа поддержки в канале «Дело канских подростков»:

17 августа Никите Уварову исполнится 21 год. Даже не верится, ведь когда мы начинали кампанию в поддержку Никиты и других фигурантов «дела канских подростков», ему было 15 лет, а в момент задержания и вовсе 14. В 2022 году суд приговорил Никиту к 5 годам заключения, он должен был выйти в 20 лет. Но вот Никите уже 21, а он всё ещё сидит. Как так получилось?

Летом 2020 года в городе Канск Красноярского края Никита Уваров с друзьями, разделявшими анархистские идеалы, расклеивали листовки в поддержку политзаключённых и с критикой государства. Одну из листовок наклеили на здание местного отдела ФСБ.

Через некоторое время подростков задержали. Силовики давили на молодых людей и их родителей, заставили разблокировать телефоны, а позже на основании найденных в них переписок и полученных под давлением показаний Дениса Михайленко и Богдана Андреева сфабриковали дело об «обучении терроризму» — якобы подростки готовились взорвать здание ФСБ в Канске.

10 февраля 2022 года Никиту приговорили к 5 годам, а Михайленко и Андрееву дали условные сроки. К тому моменту Никита уже провел почти год с в СИЗО и должен был освободиться весной 2026 года.

За месяц до освобождения против Никиты сфабриковали новое дело, обвинив его в участии в признанном экстремистским «движении «АУЕ». Следствие утверждает, что в колонии Никита якобы распространял среди других заключённых «законы криминального мира». При этом ИК-31, где он отбывал срок, — режимная, или «красная», колония, в которой тюремная субкультура существует только в том объёме, в котором выгодна администрации.

Особенно показательно, что дело возбудили по материалам красноярского УФСБ буквально перед самым окончанием Никитиного срока. В феврале Никиту перевели в СИЗО-1 Красноярска, а затем суд заключил его под стражу уже по новому обвинению. Поэтому 19 марта, когда Никита должен был выйти на свободу, этого не произошло.

7 августа Советский районный суд Красноярска в очередной раз удовлетворил ходатайство следствия и продлили содержание Никиты в СИЗО ещё на 2 месяца — до 11 октября.

Также стало известно, что Никиту перевели в одиночную камеру по ходатайству защиты. В 12-местной камере Никита опасался разговаривать с сокамерниками, которые активно интересовались происходящим в колонии, так как подобные разговоры тоже могли подшить в дело в качестве доказательств «распространения криминальной субкультуры».

По новому делу Никите грозит ещё от 2 до 6 лет заключения. Свой 21-й день рождения Никита снова встретит за решёткой — поэтому мы очень просим вас поздравить его и напомнить, что все эти годы о нём помнят и ждут его на свободе.

День рождения Никиты уже совсем скоро, поэтому рекомендуем воспользоваться электронными сервисами для отправки писем. Возможна отправка из-за рубежа и отплата зарубежной картой.

Доступные в СИЗО-1 Красноярска сервисы: «Ф-письмо» (оплата российской картой), «Зонателеком» (возможна оплата как российской, так и зарубежной картой), PrisonMail.Online (только для зарубежных карт).

Данные для отправки: Красноярский край (Krasnoyarsk region), СИЗО-1 Красноярск (SIZO-1 Krasnoyarsk), Уваров Никита Андреевич 2005 г. р.

Почтовый адрес: 660075, г. Красноярск, ул. Республики, 72, СИЗО-1

author: Unknown
title: Prisoners’ relatives: All political prisoners must be released
content:
The 'Framework Law' prepared as part of a democratic solution to the Kurdish question and containing provisions concerning detainees and convicted prisoners, was approved by the General Assembly of Parliament. In Amed, relatives of prisoners commented on the legislation.


The families stressed that the legislation was important in terms of placing the process on a legal footing, but emphasized that the steps to be taken, and the decisions adopted needed to be inclusive.


 


'Two of my sons will be released, but I'm not happy'


While lawyers described the legislation as a “first step” and said its scope should be expanded, relatives of prisoners called for all political prisoners to be released and the prisons emptied.


Tekyeddin Sürme, whose two sons are imprisoned, said that although the legislation creates the possibility of release for some prisoners, it did not make them fully happy. “Yes, a law has been passed, but it is not the law we expected after two years. The state prepared the provisions according to its own interests. I have two sons who are imprisoned, and both of them fall within the scope of this legislation. But since the other prisoners will not be released, this does not make us very happy. We want all the prisoners, first and foremost our Leader, to be outside,” Sürme said.


All prisoners should be released


Sürme said that those released from prison should live together with society and that a similar approach should be adopted for those returning from exile. He said: “Our friends who will return from exile also need to come back here and live among the people, together with them. Freedom becomes a reality by living among the people and working together with them. First and foremost, we want a law to be passed for our Leader, and then for all our friends. The laws that are passed from now on should be more inclusive. This step must be followed by further steps, and all the prisons should be emptied. That is our greatest demand.”


Obstacles to democratic politics must be removed


Yusuf Erdoğan, a member of the Prison Commission of the Amed branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), said that they had previously shared their views on the legislation with the public. He said: “We consider this law, particularly in terms of resolving the Kurdish question, to be a ‘first-step law.’ Of course, it has shortcomings. However, we believe these shortcomings must be addressed in the legislation that follows. Despite everything, we consider this legal step that has been taken to be valuable.” 


Erdoğan said the legislation should be regarded as a starting point for resolving the problems and noted that it contained provisions contrary to the principle of equality guaranteed under Article 10 of the Constitution. He said: “For example, it is clear that the bill contains many provisions that are contrary to Article 10 of the Constitution, namely the principle of equality. Legal obstacles must also be removed regarding the right to engage in politics and the participation in democratic politics of prisoners released from prison. We have repeatedly stated that the obstacles preventing prisoners released from prison, as well as returning PKK militants, from participating in democratic politics must be removed as part of the aim of resolving the Kurdish question through democratic means.”


Nurcan Yalçın also assessed the framework law both as a relative of a prisoner and as a journalist. While noting that the legislation had shortcomings, Yalçın said it was important that many political prisoners currently in prison would be released. She added that “the fact that Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan and those who received aggravated life sentences before 2005 were excluded from the scope of the legislation has caused disappointment in society.”


The law must be expanded


Nurcan Yalçın said that statements had indicated that the legislation could be expanded in the coming period and therefore argued that, despite its shortcomings, the law should be regarded as a positive step. She said: “The framework law is now being regarded as the first concrete and positive step taken by the state within the framework of the Peace and Democratic Society Process. However, it is of course our hope that this law will be expanded further and that the other prisoners, as well as Kurdish People’s Leader Mr Abdullah Öcalan, will be included in its scope and attain their status and freedom.”

author: Unknown
title: Guerrilla Baran: 15 August Offensive is the resurrection of the Kurdish people
content:
The launch of the 15 August Offensive in Kurdistan under the leadership of the great commander Egîd (Mahsum Korkmaz), and the beginning of armed warfare, represented a major resurrection for the Kurdish people. The offensive demonstrated that the Kurdish people were no longer without means or without anyone to defend them. Commander Egîd opened a new path for the Kurdish people to defend their existence and, in this respect, became a symbol of guerrilla warfare in Kurdistan.


YJA Star guerrilla Rehşan Baran spoke about the 42nd anniversary of the 15 August Offensive. YJA Star guerrilla Rehşan Baran said: "With the launch of the 15 August Offensive, we have achieved very significant gains. Whatever is said today about the 15 August Offensive, it will never be enough. Because it is thanks to this offensive that we have reached where we are today. The developments that emerged around Comrade Egîd had an impact on young people and the population, leading to strong participation in the ranks of the guerrillas. At that time, the Kurdish people were indeed under tremendous pressure and attack. However, thanks to the movement created by Leader Apo and the 15 August Offensive carried out by Commander Egîd, major steps were taken for the freedom of the Kurdish people. With the 15 August Offensive, our people understood that they too had a force capable of defending themselves."


 


Guerrilla Baran added: "As the Kurdish people, we were finally able to begin speaking of our existence. Comrade Egîd brought this consciousness to the Kurdish people. Comrade Egîd was loved among the Kurdish people for his Apoist personality. What was Comrade Egîd’s purpose and goal? What kind of personality had he built himself into? In short, the important thing is how we will enhance the value that Commander Egîd left us and how we will uphold it. Our people must now realise that there are no obstacles standing before them.


We must understand the meaning and importance of this day; we must know what 15 August means to us. Because this offensive established the existence of the Kurds. We will fulfil Comrade Egîd’s aim in this offensive through our struggle. We have reached where we are today thanks to Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan]. We must intensify our struggle and take major steps in terms of self-defence. On this occasion, once again, I wish Leader Apo, our people and all our comrades a happy 15 August."

author: Unknown
title: The games being played over Shengal and the resistance of the Yazidi community
content:
On the 12th anniversary of the genocide, as the date 3 August 2026 approached, the suffering endured by the Yazidi community and by all people of conscience is the result of multifaceted political and geopolitical balances. The massacres that began with the attacks by ISIS in August 2014 cannot be explained solely by the brutality of a radical organisation; they were part of a broader genocidal project aimed at changing the region’s demographic and political map.


Twelve years later, Shengal is not only a place where suffering and disasters are commemorated, but has also become a center of conflict and strategic calculations among regional and international powers. The massacre, which took place before the eyes of the entire world, demonstrated the depth of the Yazidi people’s exclusion from legal protection and their vulnerability. The current situation in Shengal has also revealed the true face of autonomous diplomacy, politics aimed at defending interests, and international indifference.


This process shows that the Shengal issue has now gone beyond the limits of a humanitarian disaster and has become a political, legal and sovereignty crisis directly linked to the future of state structures in the Middle East.


Theatrical diplomacy, empty promises and bureaucratic corruption


In the period following the liberation of Shengal, there were numerous conferences, statements full of promises and theatrical diplomacy. Under public pressure, the international community and multinational institutions made sweeping promises to rebuild Shengal, recognise the genocide at the highest legal levels and bring the perpetrators before international courts.


Yet over the past 12 years, it has become clear that these promises have not been fulfilled, disappearing into bureaucratic labyrinths and networks of geopolitical interests. Funds allocated to Shengal did not reach the territory of Shengal and were siphoned off under the influence of organised corruption within Iraq’s administrative systems.


One of the most critical issues in Shengal politics was the Shengal Agreement of 9 October 2020, signed between the Iraqi central government and the Kurdistan Regional Government under the supervision of the United Nations and the Turkish state. This agreement was one of the clearest examples of top-down politics and the disregard for the will of the people. Decisions concerning the region’s future were taken without the participation of Yazidi local councils or genuine representatives of the forces that defended Shengal during its darkest days.


The main purpose of this agreement was not to resolve infrastructure problems or ensure the security of the population, but to attempt to restore the political and military hegemony of the forces that had withdrawn in 2014. Rather than bring peace, the agreement failed to take into account the reality on the ground and the autonomous will of the Yazidi community, deepening political and military tensions in the region and raising questions about the credibility of international efforts.


The use of refugee camps as a political tool 


From a humanitarian and social perspective, the most devastating consequence of this policy of siege is the situation of the hundreds of thousands of Yazidi refugees who, 12 years later, are still living in plastic tents. Life in the camps in Duhok province is no longer a temporary situation, but has become a political tool and an instrument of demographic change. The failure of these families to return to their ancestral lands is not a personal choice or simply the result of a lack of opportunities; it is the outcome of an organised policy of obstruction.


The authorities are preventing people from making their legitimate return through checkpoints, administrative obstacles, psychological warfare and fear propaganda. The aim of this policy of obstruction is to keep the Yazidi population in the camps as a tool of electoral pressure while simultaneously creating a demographic vacuum in Shengal, thereby facilitating the implementation of long-term hegemonic projects in the region.


Looking at the situation inside Shengal and its villages, the reality of this policy of despair becomes even clearer. Areas such as Sîba Şêx Xidir, Til Izêr, Herdan, Girzerik and Koço have been turned into physically and economically dead towns. The city’s infrastructure, clean water network, electricity system and health centers have deteriorated to a level that makes normal …

title: "Di mijara aşitiyê de bi tu awayî zarok wekî aktorekê nehatin nirxandin"
content:
Em weke Weqfa Ragihandinê ya IPSê/bianet, ji Tîrmeha 2023an vir ve bi armanca civaka sivîl bi hêz bike û rêyên têkiliyê bi awayekî birêkûpêk zêde bikin, bi Rêxistinên Mafan re rêze-civînan pêk tînin. Me civîna xwe ya 36an bi Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok re pêk anî.


Me civîn di 12ê Tebaxê de bi awayê online li dar xist. Li ser navê Weqfa Ragihandinê ya IPSê/bianetê Koordînatora Atolye BİAyê Ceyda Sungur, Koordînatora Lêkolînan a Atolye BİAyê Sinem Aydınlı, Rêvebirê Karên Nivîsaran ê berpirsyar ê bianetê Vecîh Cuzdan û Nûçegihana Hevkaran a Civaka Sivîl a bianetê/Asîstana Atolye BİAyê Evrim Gunduz beşdarî civînê bûn. Her weja li ser navê Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok jî Hivran Timur û Zeynep Sidar Irmak di civînê de amade bûn.


"Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok"ê projeyeke nû ji bo mafên zarokan daye destpêkirin


10 Mijdar 2022


Di civînê de, em li ser xebatên çand-huner û piştevaniya psîkososyal ên ku Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok bi zarokan re birêve dibin, atolyeyên wan ên ji bo zimanê dayikê û xebatên wan ên li taxên navçeya Sur a Amedê axivîn.


Hîvran Tîmûr: Piştî tayînkirina qeyuman komeleya me weke pêdiviyeke ava bû


Hîvran Tîmûrê diyar kir ku li Amedê di sala 2017an de piştî tayînkirina qeyuman ji bo şaredariyan û girtina hin saziyan, li bajêr pêdiviyek çêbû. Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok di encama van pêdiviyan de ava bû.


Piranîya xebatên komeleyê ji çalakiyên çand-hunerê pêk tên. Tîmûrê ku destnîşan kir ku ew xebatên xwe bi şêwezarên kurdî, kurmancî û kirmanckî/zazakî dimeşînin û piştevaniya psîkososyal jî beşeke ji çalakiyên wan e.


“Li Semsûrê zarok hîna jî nikarin mafên xwe bi kar bînin”


16 Cotmeh 2023


Tîmûrê aşkere kir ku piştî erdhejên 6ê Sibata 2023an wan li Semsûrê jî dest bi xebatan kir û diyar kir ku di van demên dawî de wan dîsa giranî daye ser Amedê. Tîmûrê destnîşan kir ku xebatên li Sûrê jî bi demê re ber bi rêxistinbûna taxê ve berfireh bûne û got:


“Dema em li Sûrê bicih bûn, me dît ku hewcedariyên cuda hene. Me dît ku zarokên li vir him ji komên olî yên tûndrew bandor bûne, him jî li gel malbatên xwe piştî şerên bajarî ên sala 2015an travmayên giran jiyane. Vê yekê pirsiyara ‘di warê rêxistinbûna taxê de em dikarin çi bikin?’ bi me re çêkir. Niha atolyeyên me hene ku em bêyî tu projeyan, bi awayekî xwebexş birêve dibin.”


Zeynep Sîdar Irmak: Em hewl didin bi zarokan re tîmeke şanoyê ava bikin


Zeynep Sîdar Irmakê da zanîn ku piştî wan komele bar kir Sûrê, wan di heyama havînê de dest bi xebateke pîlot kir. Irmakê destnîşan kir ku armanca wan dîtina hewcedariyên zarokên taxê û baldariya wan a li ser atolyeyan bû. Her weha Sîdar Irmakê ragihand ku bi pêşengiya dilxwazan çar atolye hatin vekirin, malbatan rasterast serî li van atolyeyan dan û atolyeyan du mehan berdewam kirin.


Irmakê got ku wan xwestiye piştî heyama havînê jî xebatên xwe bidomînin. Ji bo vê yekê jî diyar kir ku wan ji zarokên beşdarî atolyeyan bûne komek ava kiriye:


“Me ji zarokên ku beşdarî atolyeyan bûbûn komeke ji heft kesî pêk tê ava kir. Em bi malbatan re axivîn. Heke malbat jî bipejirîne ango em destûrê ji malbatan bigirin, em dixwazin di heyama dibistanê de jî bi vê komê re perwerdeyên drama, kûkla û kurdî bidomînin û ji wan tîmeke şanoyê ava bikin.”


Irmak: Armanca me ew e ku em vê xebatê li navçeyên cuda jî bikin


Zeynep Sîdar Irmakê behsa wê yekê kir ku komele li navçeya Çinara Amedê li dijî zewacên di temenê piçûkî de û zewacên bi darêzorê xebatan dimeşîne. Irmakê got ku xebata li Çinarê ji bendewariyên wan zêdetir bi pêş ketiye. Komele plan dike ku di heyama nû de xebatên weke vê li Bismil û Farqînê jî bike.


Irmakê destnîşan kir ku ew ê di heyama nû de çarçoveya atolyeyan jî berfirehtir bikin:


“Em ê perwerdeyên wekheviya zayendî ya civakî, tenduristiya zêdebûnê û tenduristiya zayendî jî li atolyeyên xwe zêde bikin. Me atolyeyên li Çinarê wekî du perwerdeyên cuda yên ji bo mêran û ciwanên nûgîhaştî plan kiribûn. Em ê xebatên nû jî bi veqetandina koman û berfirehkirina van sernavan bi rêve bibin.”


Tîmûr: Di mijara aşitiyê de bi tu awayî zarok wekî aktorekê nehatin nirxandin


Hîvran Timûrê got ku komeleyê mijara aşitiyê jî girtiye rojeva xebatên xwe û destnîşan kir ku di nîqaşên ku tên kirin de serpêhatî û gotinên zarokan bi têra xwe cih nagirin.


Tîmûrê da zanîn ku wan berê bi zarokan re xebatên wênegiriyê meşandine û ji ber vê ezmûnê jî wan dest bi fikirînê kiriye ku ka rojnamegeriyeke aştîxwaz ya zarokparêz dikare çawa bê avakirin. Tîmûr weha pê çû:

author: Stéphanie de Sève
title: ‘Justice for Jusi’: Officials launch investigation into death of 4 year old boy in Nunavik
content:
Various health institutions in Quebec have launched an investigation into the death of 4-year-old Jusi Padlayat from Ivujivik, Nunavik, in northern Quebec.


His parents made trips to the Inuulitsivik Health Centre on several occasions starting in July after the boy complained of stomach pain. Each time, he was sent home.


According to reports, on Aug. 1, Padlayat was found unconscious, and he was transported to Montreal. He died on Aug. 3 at the Montreal Children’s Hospital.


“We have a responsibility to ensure that the circumstances around this tragedy are thoroughly and objectively examined,” said a statement from the Nunavik Regional Board of Health and Social Services. “We are committed to transparency and to shedding light on the circumstances surrounding this loss.”


Quebec’s coroner is also investigating.


Politicians are weighing in on the boys’ death.


“The reports are extremely disturbing,” said Sonia Bélanger, Quebec’s health minister. “If a sick child did not receive the care he needed, that is absolutely unacceptable. An investigation was promptly ordered, and a coroner’s inquiry is also underway to establish the facts.”


Jusi Padlayat in an undated photo.


The post, “Justice for Jusi,” was trending on social media.


In a statement posted on social media, Mandy Gull Masty, minister of Indigenous Services Canada whose riding includes Nunavik, said Inuit families have the right to access “safe and reliable health care.”


“We expect the province of Quebec and the medical staff involved to address this matter with the utmost seriousness and to ensure that the system can provide answers to the family and community while also working to prevent future tragedies from occurring,” Gull Masty said.


Ivujivik sits at the tip of Quebec and is nearly 2,000 kilometres north of Montreal. The 2021 census said the community has a population of 412.

‘Justice for Jusi’: Officials launch investigation into death of 4 year old boy in Nunavik

author: Andrés
title: Denuncia masiva a la destrucción de décadas de inversión en ciencia y tecnolgía
content:
Masivo acto de la comunidad científica en el Obelisco. Denuncian la destrucción de décadas de inversión social exitosa en ciencia y tecnología. El obelisco se convirtió este miércoles en el escenario de una multitudinaria jornada de protesta en defensa de la ciencia, la tecnología y la universidad pública. Trabajadores y trabajadoras del CONICET, organismos científicos, universidades y organizaciones sociales coparon la plaza para repudiar el ajuste y el desmantelamiento del sistema científico nacional.

Por Leandro Rodríguez para ANRed.


Foto: Leandro Rodríguez


El reclamo tiene un punto central: la no renovación de 374 becas posdoctorales del CONICET, que dejó en la calle a cientos de investigadores, en el marco de un proceso que el sector denuncia como un verdadero desguace de la ciencia argentina. Cada investigador que desaparece es la pérdida de décadas de investigación autónoma acumulada en las instituciones públicas y la pérdida de soberanía científica y productiva. Esos despidos son un hito en el vaciamiento y la desfinanciación, y convergen con los despidos recientes en CNEA, y en otros organismos y con el incumplimiento de la ley de financiamiento universitario.


El acto llamó la atención tanto por la masividad como por la energía positiva que lo recorría. Toda una paradoja. Con casi tres años de ajuste brutal sobre los hombros de todo el sistema de ciencia y técnica y con el último zarpazo de casi 400 despidos en Conicet ya concretado a fin de julio pasado, la comunidad volvió a expresar una voz nítida y contundente.


Foto: Leandro Rodríguez


La organización del acto combinó el llamado de la RAICyT con la participación de todas las organizaciones del sector. La RAICyT es la “Red de Autoridades de Institutos de Ciencia y Tecnología de Argentina”, que agrupa a más de 400 directores y autoridades de organismos como el CONICET y universidades nacionales. Los sindicatos de cada institución también movilizaron, tanto las comisiones internas de ATE como de AGD UBA y CONADUH, así como agrupamientos estudiantiles. Y también lo hicieron buena parte de las corrientes políticas en las que participan los trabajadores del sector, desde tendencias peronistas hasta la izquierda. Para completar la escena, las organizaciones de jubilados que marchan todos los miércoles fueron hasta el Obelisco y completaron el poco espacio que quedaba en la plaza de la república sobre la avenida Corrientes.


Parte de la masividad puede explicarse por esa gran amplitud. Así como por un “cambio de clima” social. El llamado a “ponerse la camiseta por la ciencia” y defender la soberanía, enlazaba en una sola mirada la bandera de Malvinas tomada por los jugadores de la selección con el amplio repudio a las leyes de entrega como la “Ley de tierras” la semana pasada, las voces de los y las referentes jóvenes como Emilia, Tini, Lali, Milo J y tantos otros y la marcha atrás del gobierno retirando esas leyes de diputados.


En el acto se leyó un documento que denuncia el recorte presupuestario, la pérdida de puestos de trabajo, el deterioro salarial y el vaciamiento de organismos estratégicos como CONICET, INTI, INTA, CNEA, CONAE, SMN (servicio meteorológico nacional), entre otros. Allí se enfatizó que la soberanía nacional es imposible sin un sistema de ciencia y técnica y universidades públicas nacionales. Los datos al respecto son contundentes: la inversión en ciencia y tecnología en los países que sostienen empresas competitivas en el mercado mundial, es una inversión básicamente estatal. Desde China hasta Israel y EEUU. En ellos se invierte anualmente del 3 al 5% del PBI de cada país. En Argentina este año la inversión llegó a su piso histórico, el 0.14% del PBI, motosierra mediante. En definitiva, la capacidad de una sociedad de metabolizarse con la naturaleza y vivir sanamente en ella es imposible sin el conocimiento de la ciencia básica y sus aplicaciones productivas. Y ello requiere una inversión social a la que los privados no pueden hacer más que aportes privados parciales e insuficientes.[13/8/2026 17:10] Leandro Leandro: La conexión entre la comunidad científica y la sociedad de conjunto es lo que nunca se rompió, aunque sí está sometida a un inmenso desgaste. La “estrellita culona” del Conicet simboliza la vitalidad de esa conexión y ayer brilló más que nunca en el acto del Obelisco. Esa vitalidad se veía también en las sonrisas y abrazos entre quienes participaron.
