author: Unknown
title: Ayşegül Doğan: New bodies will be established for the implementation of the Framework Law
content:
The Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) spokesperson Ayşegül Doğan held a press conference regarding the decisions taken at the party's Central Executive Board (MYK) meeting held on Wednesday, August 12.


“The law has opened a very significant path”


Ayşegül Doğan noted that the Parliament passed a law whose significance would become clearer in the months ahead and that it was an important piece of legislation for her party. However, she stressed that the law was not a measure that would resolve all existing problems.


Remarking that the law had created new political and legal opportunities, Doğan said: "Recognizing the importance of this first step does not mean ignoring the aspects that still need to be addressed. On the contrary, for us, valuing this first step means emphasizing even more strongly what remains to be completed. Criticizing its shortcomings does not diminish its significance. Nor should we turn our backs on this law entirely because of those shortcomings. There is no need to reject it. The law has now been passed, opening a very significant path toward resolving the Kurdish question and democratizing Turkey. That is why we propose moving forward along this path."


Ayşegül Doğan pointed out that conflicts had not made the state stronger and further stated the following:


"If conflict had made the state stronger, we would be talking today about a strong democracy and a strong economy. Instead, thousands of people have lived in constant fear, and millions of homes have been struck by tragedy—all because of security-driven policies. That is why every step that helps bring this to an end is valuable and important to us, despite its shortcomings and inadequacies.


“A new era must have a new vocabulary”


Victory, defeat, division, partition, denial, destruction, rebellion, or rejection—we now need to leave all of these behind. A new era must have a new vocabulary, one that shows that this new period is being approached with a new mindset and that has a tangible impact on our lives.


That is why those who oppose the process now need new arguments as well. Otherwise, everything they put forward will unfortunately be perceived merely as rhetoric, as an absence of politics, and as categorical opposition to the process.


Steps aimed at strengthening our shared future


At no point in this process has any separatist demand ever been expressed. Such claims have no basis. There is no demand for separation. On the contrary, as reflected in the name of the law and the name of the parliamentary commission, steps are being taken in Parliament toward unity and integration and toward strengthening our coexistence. These are steps aimed at strengthening our shared future.


Some continue to put forward arguments suggesting that the issue can be resolved solely through security-based methods or military operations. This approach was tried continuously for 40 years and failed to produce a solution. It generated conflict and deepened the problem. Moreover, it changed the nature of the issue and internationalized it. A secure country is one that decides to eliminate the causes of conflict and demonstrates the political will to take steps in that direction. This is possible through law, politics, dialogue, and negotiation. This is how we need to view the process we are currently going through. The vast majority of armed conflicts around the world have ultimately been brought to an end through dialogue and negotiation.


New bodies will be established


Now we have the law. Parliament is there to oversee its implementation. There is therefore social will, public support, and solidarity. New bodies will be established. There is nothing secret or concealed. Every effort is being made to move the process forward openly and transparently. Nor do we have any hidden agenda.


There are shortcomings; we are aware of them, and we are working to ensure that they are addressed. Does the law meet all of our expectations? No. But is it realistic to expect a single law to have the capacity to meet everyone's expectations? No, it is not. We need to intensify our collective struggle to transform the law so that it can better meet our expectations.


We are talking about a law that concerns and directly affects the lives and freedom of thousands of people. We are talking about a law that could pave the way for the release and freedom of thousands of people, while also enabling many others to return, including those …

author: Unknown
title: İmralı Delegation: Following our meeting with Erdoğan, we need to meet with Mr. Öcalan as well
content:
The Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) İmralı Delegation has set out to meet with President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.


Before leaving Parliament, the delegation answered questions from journalists and then departed for the Presidential Complex.


Buldan: The process must move forward quickly


Speaking to journalists, Pervin Buldan said, "We will hold another meeting with the President today. We will come together to discuss certain issues immediately following the adoption of the law."


Buldan continued: "We have several issues on our agenda which we will try to address in a written statement. Of course, everything that has happened, the expectations, and what needs to be done will be among these issues. Meetings have been held at every stage after a certain point, but we have now entered a new phase. We want to emphasize the importance of this meeting following the vote on the law in Parliament.


The process must move forward quickly. We do not want it to be dragged out over time and become derailed. We believe this must not be allowed to happen. We believe progress needs to be made. We hope to achieve a result as soon as possible."


Sancar: The first important step now needs to be implemented


Mithat Sancar said that peace is a difficult path, adding, "The legal framework for peace provides the foundation for navigating this path in a sound manner. The law adopted in Parliament through a historic consensus has become the cornerstone of the legal framework for peace."


Mithat Sancar stated: "The legal framework for peace also requires other elements. The first important step now needs to be implemented. We will exchange views on the implementation phase and on how this step should be put into practice. We have our own ideas and proposals, which we will present. We will also share our views on what kind of roadmap should be developed for the other elements of the legal framework for peace."


“The also contains the fundamental elements of institutionalization”


In response to a question about the implementation of the law, Sancar said: "The law stipulates that various bodies need to be established. The legislation that has been adopted also contains the fundamental elements of institutionalization. These mechanisms need to be put into operation quickly. Establishing these bodies is the first step toward ensuring that the process moves forward on an institutional and legal basis. This will also require a decision by the National Security Council (MGK) and the publication of that decision in the Official Gazette. We believe this process must be completed as soon as possible. We will also discuss this issue with the President."


“We need to meet with Mr. Öcalan as soon as possible”


Asked whether the delegation would travel to İmralı Island, Pervin Buldan said, "A visit to İmralı will also be planned. We intend to travel to the island as soon as possible."


Pervin Buldan continued: "Following our meeting with the President, we need to meet with Mr. Öcalan as soon as possible. Perhaps afterward, we could also meet with Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş, because there is also a need for a monitoring body at this stage. We could hold discussions regarding the establishment of such a monitoring body in Parliament.


Our routine meetings with political parties will continue. Nothing specific has been scheduled yet. We believe that rulings by the Constitutional Court (AYM) and the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) should be implemented as soon as possible, without waiting for a decision from the National Security Council (MGK). There is strong public expectation on this issue. We will, of course, raise the need for these rulings to be implemented. This remains an important issue before us.”


Buldan concluded: "Administrative and legal arrangements are needed. As for the monitoring body, Mr. Numan Kurtulmuş could establish it if he wishes, even if Parliament goes into recess."

author: Chris Walker
title: Alito’s Assets in Fossil Fuels Have Grown by Up to $2.9 Million, Analysis Finds
content:
Recent polling indicates that Alito has a -7 point approval rating among Americans.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

A new analysis suggests that Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito gained as much as $2.9 million in assets from growth in stocks relating to the oil and gas industry over the course of the past two decades.

The analysis from the nonprofit watchdog group Court Accountability found that Alito’s assets (not including his personal housing properties) expanded by between $3.4 million and as much as $8.4 million between 2005 and 2024. Between $390,000 and $2.9 million of that growth was from companies involved in oil and gas extraction, the report noted.

Supreme Court justices are supposed to recuse themselves from cases if they have a direct interest in the outcome. (Members of the court decide for themselves whether recusal is warranted, without any body or other justices overseeing the process.) Even with the minimum possible figure earned by Alito during that time, the outcome of cases relating to the fossil fuel industry could have significant financial benefits for him.

Notably, Alito did recuse from a case involving the fossil fuel industry in the court’s last term. But it was a convenient move for him, as the case resulted in a unanimous 8-0 decision from the other justices. It’s possible that Alito made the decision to recuse knowing that the outcome of the case would likely be in his favor.

This upcoming term, a case involving state regulations of fossil fuel companies is set to be heard. Alito is refusing to recuse from the case, citing the fact that he does not have stock ownership in the companies involved.

However, the outcome of the ruling — whether states can regulate the industry when the federal government does not — will likely still have a bearing on the performance of his stocks.

“A reasonable person would think if you’re invested in the industry that could benefit from the outcome of a lawsuit, then you could personally stand to benefit from the outcome, even if you don’t hold the stock in the specific company that happens to be the named plaintiff,” said Lisa Graves, author of the analysis and co-founder of Court Accountability, explaining the situation to The Guardian.

According to an Economist/YouGov poll conducted in July, most Americans feel that the Supreme Court ended on a sour note, with only 36 percent of respondents giving positive approval numbers to the institution. Meanwhile, 50 percent of respondents said they disapproved of the court’s actions last term. Alito himself had a -7 point approval rating in the poll.

title: Uma lei que parcela prejuízos na conta de todos os brasileiros
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a newsletter Ligando os pontos, enviada toda quinta-feira. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

Estava marcado para ontem, dia 12 de agosto, no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), o julgamento de ações diretas de inconstitucionalidade contra a Lei Geral do Licenciamento Ambiental

(Lei 15.090/2025)

, que entrou em vigor em fevereiro. A matéria está sob relatoria do ministro Alexandre de Moraes, que deve avaliar se a legislação está de acordo com o Artigo 225 da Constituição, segundo o qual cabe ao poder público e à coletividade “o dever de defender o meio ambiente e preservá-lo para as presentes e futuras gerações”.


Apesar das expectativas da sociedade civil pelo julgamento, as três ações foram retiradas das pautas sem explicações e não há, por enquanto, informações de quando voltarão ao plenário do STF. O tema, entretanto, é urgente, uma vez que a legislação em vigor já está causando danos reais.


Enquanto tramitava no Congresso, o texto da nova lei do licenciamento foi apelidado de “Projeto de Lei da Devastação” e ficou conhecido como “a mãe de todas as boiadas”. Isso porque seu potencial destrutivo é enorme, já que elimina várias etapas de avaliação dos impactos ambientais de grandes obras. Estamos falando de projetos de infraestrutura, como estradas e hidrelétricas, ou a instalação de empreendimentos de mineração e exploração de petróleo, que agora podem ser aprovados sem estudos e sem medidas compensatórias.


O afrouxamento da lei foi negociado pelas bancadas retrógradas do Congresso sob a relatoria do ruralista Zé Vitor (PL-MG) na Câmara e apoio direto do presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União -AP). Este, claro, está de olho nos benefícios da exploração de petróleo na costa de seu estado, o Amapá.


Ao sancionar a nova lei, o presidente Lula vetou vários artigos, mas eles foram derrubados pelo Congresso. Na prática, o que está valendo agora no Brasil é quase um auto-licenciamento, desprezando consulta às comunidades afetadas e a proteção de áreas protegidas ou de biomas sensíveis como a Mata Atlântica. No momento em que apresentaram a ação de inconstitucionalidade no STF, o Observatório do Clima junto ao PSOL, a Articulação dos Povos Indígenas do Brasil e outras 11 organizações apontaram este

como o maior retrocesso ambiental em 40 anos

.


O atropelo revelou o profundo conflito que historicamente existe por trás do licenciamento ambiental no Brasil. Instituído pela Política Nacional do Meio Ambiente em 1981

(Lei 6938)

, o instrumento foi sempre demonizado por presidentes da República, parlamentares e claro, pelo setor produtivo, que o consideravam como uma barreira ao desenvolvimento e ao crescimento econômico. Tanto foi criticado que, com a atualização da lei, congressistas armaram verdadeiros golpes baixos, criando mecanismos como a Licença Ambiental Especial, que estabelece prazos irreais aos órgão reguladores.


Falar ao Ibama que deve aprovar

em 12 meses

 uma estrada cortando a floresta amazônica é fácil. Mas em nenhum momento se discutiu a aprovação de orçamentos maiores para capacitar os órgãos ambientais ou contratar mais servidores. Ao longo dos últimos anos, a queda no quadro de fiscais e servidores do Ibama foi brutal. Em comparação a 2014, o

número de funcionários é 30% menor

.


Nunca fui funcionário público, mas muitas vezes me peguei pensando como me sentiria se fosse um servidor do Ibama e as autoridades de ocasião resolvessem jogar no lixo os meus pareceres técnicos. Penso nisso porque essa tem sido uma prática comum, não importa a cor do governo: durante a avaliação de um projeto, os técnicos indicam vários problemas, mas esses alertas são desconsiderados e, num canetaço, um ministro, presidente ou governador decide que obra vai em frente. 


Vimos, seja nos governos de Lula, Dilma, Temer ou Bolsonaro, que a política e os interesses econômicos se impõe às análises objetivas. O problema é que, ao desrespeitar o rito de avaliação dos impactos ambientais, gestam-se consequências duríssimas. São hidrelétricas que funcionam com metade da capacidade de geração de energia, povos indígenas que perdem áreas de pesca e caça e populações deslocadas por enchentes descomunais, só para mencionar alguns efeitos irremediáveis.


A minha empatia por esses servidores do Ibama começou há vinte anos quando ocorria a grande polêmica em torno do licenciamento das hidrelétricas no rio Madeira, em Rondônia …

(IG Metall Verhandlungsführer Thorsten Gröger, 28.10.2024, ZDF) Deshalb gibt es keinen Grund, die Löhne in der Auto- und Zulieferindustrie zu senken. Die IG Metall hat aber allen Grund, die Einkommen und sozialen Rechte der Arbeiter:innen zu verteidigen! In den ersten drei Quartalen 2024 haben die großen drei VW, Mercedes und BMW Profite in Höhe von etwa 20 Milliarden Euro erzielt. Die Krise wird herbeigeredet, um Ängste zu schüren und Sozialabbau durchzusetzen. Unbegreiflich, dass die IG Metall dennoch erklärt: »Wir sind bereit, einen Beitrag zu leisten.«.

..“ Aus dem Leitartikel „Wem gehören die Fabriken? Euch gehören die Fabriken!“ der

„Aktionszeitung – für eine Verkehrsindustrie mit Zukunft“

 Nr. 1 vom März 2025, mit der auch die IG Metall zum Widerstand statt Sozialpartnerschaft aufgerufen wird – siehe weitere herstellerübergreifende Aufrufe aus der Autoindustrie:


„Zusammenhalt ist unsere stärkste Marke“: Die IG Metall ruft für Montag, 21. September, bundesweit in allen Betrieben der Automobil- und Zulieferindustrie zu einem Aktionstag auf


„

Die Beschäftigten der Autoindustrie leisten Widerstand gegen die Spar- und Verlagerungsfantasien ihrer Konzernbosse. Beim bundesweiten Aktionstag werden sie ein deutliches Zeichen setzen: Wettbewerbsfähigkeit entsteht nicht durch Sparen, sondern durch Investitionen.


Am

21. September

 werden die Beschäftigten der Automobilindustrie ein deutliches Zeichen setzen – bundesweit bei unzähligen betrieblichen Aktionen, bei unzähligen Zulieferbetrieben und Herstellern. Nicht länger werden sie sich zu Sündenböcken machen lassen für eine Krise, die sie nicht verursacht haben. Nicht länger werden sie die Zeche für Managementfehler und die Folgen geopolitischer Konflikte zahlen. Damit ist jetzt Schluss!

Die Beschäftigten sagen: Jetzt reicht’s!

Die Beschäftigten sollen mehr arbeiten, weniger verdienen oder gar ihren Job verlieren, während die Unternehmen Milliarden an Aktionäre auszahlen. Die Firmenchefs sind dabei, Deutschlands wichtigsten Wirtschaftszweig und zentralen Pfeiler für Wohlstand in die Bedeutungslosigkeit zu führen und abzuwirtschaften. Es droht der Totalschaden der Traditionsbranche. Dabei ist doch klar: Aus der Krise und zu mehr Wettbewerbsfähigkeit kommt die Branche nicht durch

Bei Digitalisierung und Batterien wurden wichtige Entwicklungen verschlafen. Investitionen in Zukunftstechnologien und Standorte wurden vernachlässigt.  Deswegen heißt es jetzt für die Beschäftigten: Widerstand. author: Keith Brower Brown
title: Canadian Construction Workers Walk Out against Tiers
content:
In the building trades, strikes have become vanishingly rare. But since late June, strikes by major construction unions have rocked jobsites across a Canadian province.


New Brunswick has a million residents on Canada's Atlantic coast, sharing a long border with the state of Maine. Construction investment has nearly doubled there in the last decade, especially for residential and infrastructure sites. Meanwhile, the number of construction workers ticked up by just a third.


Union hardhats saw a tight labor market could increase their leverage. But at this year's bargaining tables, construction bosses stonewalled union demands, aiming to maintain lower wages and divisive tiers.


In late June, two Electrical Workers locals launched strikes on all their construction sites, taking about four hundred workers off the job. At the same time, a Carpenters local struck two contractors, with about forty workers walking off. All have stayed out since.


AGAINST TIERS


At the heart of the strikes are demands to end divisive tiers, and to keep wages ahead of a spiraling local cost of living. Their unusually low pay by union standards may have helped international officers accept that a strike was needed.


“In a lot of jurisdictions it's true electricians make all the money,” said Cameron Maxwell, a striking electrician who joined the union four years ago. “Here that's not the position we're in. Our pay is much lower than for plumbers, drywallers, pipefitters, and [workers from other trades] are all surprised.”


“We were aiming at about a twenty percent raise over four years, because we're so far behind,” said Ian Cline, a veteran electrician who moved from Manitoba to New Brunswick this year. “There are apprentices in other trades and locals who make more than I do.”


During past downturns for construction, IBEW Local 1555 conceded to demands for an unusual tier system dividing up pay scales for commercial work, like the hospitals and schools that provide a steady source of union jobs.


“Industrial, commercial, residential having different pay scales isn't rare,” said Maxwell. “But the contractors pushed through manipulative language to divide the membership between A-, B-, and C-Rate commercial jobs, based on the size of the site.”


In 2022, the local officially struck for the first time, staying out for less than a month. “We ended up with an agreement, because contractors didn't dig in as much as this time,” said James Hoffe, a top officer for the local. They got a pay bump, but the tier system stayed.


Ending the commercial tiers is a top demand for members of IBEW Local 1555. “Whether you're paying $4 million for this project or not, we’re doing the same work as an electrician,” said Cline.


Other building trades joined the electrician walkoffs for a few days, despite contract provisions against that kind of solidarity strike.


“They have no-strike clauses. Taking that step was a risk, but it impacted the whole project,” said Jeff Morash, an officer with the local. That builds on a local tradition of solidarity.


“The other trades, whether they're plumbers, drywallers, whatever, we'll try to honor their pickets. If we can legally take a few days, we will. And there are members who will take sick days to support.”


ONE PROVINCE WAGE


Carpenters are also striking to keep members united across jobsites, where they do crucial cement and drywall work.


Thirty contractors across New Brunswick agreed to demands from Carpenters Local 1386 for a raise of about $6 US dollars per hour over the next four years. That amounts to about nine thousand US dollars extra pay a year for a carpenter, which will help members keep ahead of local grocery and gas costs skyrocketing after new US tariffs last year.


But two contractors, accounting for about an eighth of work for local members, have refused to join and bargain alongside the main employers association. The Carpenters decided a focused strike at those jobsites was needed.


“We want parity across contractors,” said James Dawson, a Carpenters local officer. “We intend to stand them down until we get it: one province wage across New Brunswick.”


Carpenters have held public rallies and festive picket lines, welcoming community supporters to join. “The contractors call this mob mentality,” said Dawson. “We call it a good time for a barbecue.”


BREAKING THE MOLD

author: Daron Letts
title: Batter up! $10,000 prize on the line in Calm Air Cup
content:
Bragging rights and $10,000 are on the line for the 10 softball teams competing in the Calm Air Cup this week at Rankin Inlet’s Justin Merritt ballpark.


Bat Attitude shortstop Ben Tulugak rounds third base Wednesday as Avengers infielder Gregory Wiseman runs for the ball during the Calm Air Cup softball tournament in Rankin Inlet. (Photo by Daron Letts)


The five-day tournament features teams from Arviat, Baker Lake, Coral Harbour, Iqaluit and Rankin Inlet. Players from Whale Cove

are in town to play with some of the teams, as well.


The action kicked off Wednesday with five games that started in the afternoon and spilled into early evening.


“We started off really hot defensively, but we crumbled,” said third baseman Colton Graham of the Rankin Inlet Avengers, after losing to Rankin Inlet’s Bat Attitude team 13-8 in the opening game.


“Our girls outplayed the guys, for sure.”


Graham’s team rallied later in the day to beat Rankin Inlet’s Rankdeez team 8-7.


The competition is organized as a round-robin tournament with two pools that compete in a double-elimination bracket.


“By Saturday and Sunday it will get more intense,” said umpire Chris Cobbett.


Cobbett and fellow official Barry Black are visiting from Winnipeg, flown north by Calm Air.


The intensity was not lacking on opening night as a crowd of 50 fans filled the bleachers. They clapped, hooted and hollered, and even shook empty pop bottles half-filled with gravel to loudly and proudly make their team allegiances known.


Kandace Graham has organized the event for the past decade. The tournament has been around since at least 1995, she said.


More than 11 games are scheduled Thursday, with the first game starting at 9 a.m. and the last game at 7 p.m. The playoffs are scheduled for Saturday and the final is set for Sunday.


The top two finishing teams will be eligible to compete in the 2027 national tournament hosted by Softball Canada, the locations for which are yet to be announced.


The first-place finisher wins a $10,000 prize to help with travel costs, which Rankin Inlet players fundraised for earlier in the year.

title: Die Linke Co-Chair: Öcalan and all political prisoners must be released
content:
Ines Schwerdtner, co-chair of Germany's Left Party -Die Linke-, is calling for a political solution to the Kurdish question and further steps toward a lasting peace process. These include the release of Abdullah Öcalan and political prisoners, as well as a political perspective for the Kurdish movement.


In an interview with ANF, Schwerdtner also takes a clear stance against Turkey's military violence against Kurds in Rojava and expresses her support for democratic self-administration and the right to self-determination. She argues that solidarity with the Kurdish resistance should not depend on whether it serves the foreign policy interests of Germany or other Western states at a given moment.


The interview also extends beyond the Kurdish question. Schwerdtner, who was re-elected as co-chair of Die Linke following its party congress in Potsdam, discusses the societal shift to the right, cuts to social welfare, militarization, restrictions on democratic rights, and the criminalization of Kurdish and other opposition groups in Germany. Other topics include the tightening of European asylum policy and the question of how workers and migrant communities can organize together in shared social struggles.


I would like to warmly congratulate you on your re-election as co-chair of Die Linke at the party congress in Potsdam. Although the question comes somewhat belatedly, how do you assess your re-election, what responsibility does this new mandate entail for you, and what perspective do you see for the party in the coming years?


 


I am very pleased about my re-election and, of course, about the result. It confirms the course we have taken. We have succeeded in giving many people hope again and inspiring them to become involved in building a strong left-wing force. This is also because we address the concrete problems people face every day, such as high rents and social injustice. At the same time, we organize protests against the policies of the federal government.


Our party has renewed itself in many ways over the past few years. It is more vibrant and stronger than it has been for a long time, and we have gained a great many young and committed members. I am proud of that, and I look forward to continuing on this path. The challenges are significant: the federal government is pushing ahead with the dismantling of the welfare state and massive militarization. That is precisely why we need a strong left—in parliament, on the streets, and in the workplace.


A strengthened Left in a political climate that has shifted to the Right


Die Linke has seen a significant increase in membership in recent months. Nevertheless, Germany's political agenda is still largely shaped by conservative and right-wing parties such as the CDU, CSU, and AfD. In your view, is left-wing politics today largely confined to a reactive opposition role rather than setting the political agenda itself?


No. We have said that we want to bring about change even from the opposition, and that is exactly what we are doing. On the issue of rents, we are putting massive pressure on the federal government. We are also putting the question of wealth distribution—and with it, the wealth tax—back on the agenda: Who actually finances our welfare state, and who must finally pay their fair share?


We are putting the social question and the issue of justice back at the center of political debate. And we are speaking about compliance with international law, even when doing so is uncomfortable. A strong left-wing voice is especially important because the policies of the so-called political center, with their cuts to social welfare and exclusion, create fertile ground for the right. We want to show that there is an alternative: a politics that does not attack those at the bottom or pit people against one another, but instead ensures that life becomes affordable again.


Social protest under growing pressure


The consequences of the shift to the right are evident not only in election results, but also in the dismantling of the welfare state and restrictions on democratic rights and freedom of assembly. In a political climate in which social protest is coming under increasing pressure, how does Die Linke intend to fight for social rights and democratic freedoms both in parliament and on the streets?

title: Süleymancılara operasyon: Aladağ yurt yangını davasında sanıkları savunan Ahmet Gökçen gözaltında
content:
Aladağ’da devlet yurdu yıkıldı, çocukların barınma hakkı cemaatlere bırakıldı; Süleymancı yurdunda 11 çocuk yaşamını yitirdi. Davada ailelerin avukatı Can Atalay tutuklanırken, sanıkların avukatı Ahmet Gökçen bugün Süleymancılara yönelik operasyonda gözaltında. Dün kamusal olanı cemaatlere devreden, bugün ise siyasi ilişkileri değişen cemaatleri operasyonlarla karşısına alan iktidar, adalet kimin için hizmetine sunuyor?

Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının soruşturması kapsamında 17 ilde 123 adrese operasyon düzenlendi. Alihan Kuriş’in de aralarında bulunduğu 49 kişi hakkında gözaltı kararı verilirken 30 kişi gözaltına alındı. Soruşturmanın MASAK tespitlerine dayandığı, cemaatin şirketleri ve mali hareketlerinin incelendiği bildirildi. Başsavcılığın iddiası, Kuriş’in “çıkar amaçlı suç örgütü” yöneticisi olduğu yönünde. Bugün cemaatin mali yapısını mercek altına alan devletin, 10 yıl önce Aladağ’da çocukların ölümüne giden süreçte nerede olduğu sorusu hala yanıt bekliyor.

Süleymancılara yönelik soruşturmada hangi şirketlere operasyon düzenlendi?

29 Kasım 2016’da Adana’nın Aladağ ilçesinde Süleymancılara ait kız öğrenci yurdunda çıkan yangında 11’i çocuk 12 kişi öldü, 24 çocuk yaralandı. Yangının ardından ortaya çıkan tablo, olayın yalnızca bir yurt yangını olmadığını gösterdi. İlçedeki devlet yurdunun yıkılmasının ardından çocuklar cemaat yurduna yönlendirilmişti. Yurdun ruhsat ve güvenlik sorunlarına ilişkin eksikliklere rağmen yıllarca faaliyet göstermesine izin verilmişti.

Kozan’da görülen Aladağ yurt yangını davalarında avukatlar ve aileler yıllardır şu soruların peşine düştü, “Devlet yurdu neden yıkıldı? Çocuklar neden cemaat yurduna yönlendirildi? Kaçak olduğu belirtilen bir yurt nasıl yıllarca faaliyet gösterdi? Kamu görevlilerinin sorumluluğu neden yeterince araştırılmadı?”

Çocukların aileleri bu sorular etrafında mahkeme salonlarında adalet aradı. Ailelerin avukatlarından biri de Can Atalaydı. Atalay, yurdun ruhsatsızlığına ilişkin kamu kayıtlarını gündeme getirdi, yalnızca yurt yöneticilerinin değil, denetim görevini yerine getirmeyen kamu görevlilerinin de sorumluluğunun araştırılmasını istedi. İstinaf aşamasında da ailelerin avukatlığını sürdürdü.

Bugün gözaltında bulunan dönemin eski HSYK üyesi Prof. Dr. Ahmet Gökçen Aladağ sanıklarının avukatlığını üstlendi. Gökçen, Marmara Üniversitesi’nde ‘Bu suça ortak olmayacağız’ bildirisine imza atan akademisyenlerin ihraç edilmesini öneren disiplin soruşturması komisyonunda yer alan isimlerden biriydi.

6 soruda Süleymancılar: Süleymancılar kimdir? Neden hedef oldular?

Aladağ davasında yurt yöneticileri çeşitli hapis cezalarına çarptırıldı. 2020’deki infaz düzenlemesinden yararlanan bazı sanıklar tahliye edildi. Kamuoyunda “Çakıcı affı” olarak adlandırılan bu düzenleme teknik olarak bir af değil, infaz sürelerini değiştiren bir düzenlemeydi. Daha sonra Adana Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi cezaları artırdı. İstinaf mahkemesi 8 sanık yönünden yeniden yargılama yaptı; İsmail Uğur'a 15 yıl, Cuma Ali Genç'e 13 yıl 9 ay, beş sanığa 11 yıl 3'er ay, Zeki Yılmaz'a 4 yıl 2 ay verdi. Süleymancılar ile iktidarın ilişkisi.

Süleymancılar ile AKP arasındaki ilişki de sanıldığı gibi baştan sona bir ittifak değildi. Cemaatin AKP ile ilişkisi dönem dönem gerildi; özellikle Antalya’daki 2009 ve 2014 yerel seçimlerinde CHP'ye verilen destek, bu siyasi ayrışmanın örneklerinden biri olarak gösterildi.

Buna rağmen Süleymancılar, AKP döneminde devletin cemaat ve vakıflara açtığı eğitim ve barınma alanından yararlanmaya devam etti. Cemaatin yurt ve kurs ağı büyüdü. Devletin özellikle öğrenci barınmasındaki boşluğu cemaatlerin doldurmasına izin veren politika, Aladağ’da en ağır sonucunu verdi.

İsmail Arı, Süleymancılar operasyonunu değerlendirdi: ‘Cemaatte taht kavgası, milyarlık servet’

Can Atalay ise yalnızca Aladağ ailelerinin avukatı değildi. Soma ve Ermenek maden faciaları, Çorlu tren katliamı ve Gezi davası gibi toplumsal açıdan önemli davalarda da mağdurların ve hak arayanların avukatlığını üstlendi. 2023 seçimlerinde Türkiye İşçi Partisi'nden Hatay milletvekili seçilen Atalay, Anayasa Mahkemesinin iki kez hak ihlali kararı vermesine rağmen tahliye edilmedi; milletvekilliği 30 Ocak 2024'te TBMM Genel Kurulunda düşürüldü.

Devlet, cemaatler iktidarla siyasi olarak çatıştığında mali ve hukuki denetim mekanizmalarını hızla işletebiliyor. Peki aynı devlet, çocukların hayatı söz konusu olduğunda neden yıllarca harekete geçmedi? 2016’da 11 çocuk öldü. Bugün Süleymancılar operasyonun …

author: Unknown
title: İsmail Arı, Süleymancılar operasyonunu değerlendirdi: ‘Cemaatte taht kavgası, milyarlık servet’
content:
Zeynep Algedik [email protected]

Ankara—Ankara Başsavcılığı’nın yürüttüğü soruşturma kapsamında Süleymancılar Cemaati’ne operasyon gerçekleştirildi. Cemaat lideri Alihan Kuriş’in de aralarında bulunduğu 49 kişi hakkında gözaltı kararı verilirken, 32 şirkete de kayyım atandı.

Yıllardır iktidarla gerilim yaşayan ve milyarlarca liralık ekonomik gücü bulunan cemaatin neden şimdi hedef alındığı sorusu gündeme gelirken operasyonun cemaat içindeki liderlik mücadelesi, iktidarla ilişkileri ve ekonomik güç dengeleri açısından ne anlama geldiğini BirGün gazetesinden İsmail Arı ile konuştuk.

Süleymancılar Cemaati’nin diğer cemaatler gibi televizyon kanalı, radyosu ve gazetesi olmadığını söyleyen Arı, “Cemaatin kamuoyunda tanınan Cübbeli Ahmet gibi ‘popüler’ isimleri de yok ve cemaat mensupları ile yöneticileri sosyal medyada da kullanmıyor. Kamuoyunda görünür olmaması nedeniyle ‘kapalı kutu’ olarak nitelendirilen cemaat, tıpkı diğer cemaatler gibi özel hastanesinden özel okul zincirine, gıdadan market zincirine kadar birçok alanda faaliyet yürütüyor ve milyarlarca liralık bir serveti yönetiyor” dedi.

Liderliğini 2016’dan beri Alihan Kuriş’in yaptığı Süleymancılar Cemaati’nde Menzil ve İsmailağa cemaatlerinde olduğu gibi büyük taht kavgası olduğunu Arı, “Cemaatteki karşıt grubun başını önceki dönem AKP’den İstanbul Milletvekili olan Fatih Süleyman Denizolgun çekiyor. Denizolgun daha önce sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamalarda, ‘Alihan Kuriş ile ilgili çok sayıda suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu’ belirterek Alihan Kuriş ve beraberindekilerin yargıdaki bazı isimler ile önceki Diyanet İşleri Başkanı Ali Erbaş gibi isimler tarafından korunduğunu iddia etmişti” diye anlattı.

Denizolgun’un son iki yıldır Alihan Kuriş’e dair çeşitli iddiaları gündeme getirerek yargının harekete geçmesi için çağrılar yaptığını hatırlatan Arı, “Denizolgun’un cemaatin yeni lideri olması halinde Süleymancılar Cemaati’nin şimdiye kadar olduğu gibi muhalefete değil iktidara destek vermesi bekleniyor. Bir diğer ihtimal ise cemaatin ikiye bölünmesi…” dedi.

İktidar ile Süleymancılar’ın 2016’dan beri aralarının açık olduğunu söyleyen Arı, özellikle 2019’daki yerel seçimde muhalefet partilerine destek verdiği bilinen cemaatin aynı yıl AKP’li Kağıthane Belediyesi tarafından yurdunun yıkılmasıyla gerilimin gün yüzüne çıktığını söyledi. Arı, operasyonun zamanlamasının son dönemde yargı kadrolarında yaşanan değişimlerden bağımsız değerlendirilemeyeceğini belirtti:

“İktidar destekçisi gazeteler 2014 yılından bu yana Süleymancılar Cemaati’ne operasyon yapılacağını dillendiriyordu. ‘Operasyon neden şimdi yapıldı?’ sorusu yargıdaki kadro değişiminden bağımsız düşünülemez. Örneğin Akın Gürlek’in İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcısı olmasıyla önce belediyelere yönelik operasyonlar başladı, ardından da ünlülere yönelik operasyonlar ile şike operasyonları gibi operasyonları konuştuk. Gürlek’in Bakan olması ve Ankara başta olmak üzere birçok kentin başsavcısının değiştirmesiyle benzer operasyonların İstanbul dışına taştığını, farklı kentlerde de gerçekleştirildiğini gördük. ‘Operasyon neden şimdi yapıldı?’ sorusunun yanıtı burada aramak gerektiğini düşünüyorum.”

Arı’ya göre bu operasyon cemaatin tümüne değil; lideri ve yönetici kadrosuna yönelik. Süleymancıların ülkenin en büyük cemaatlerinden biri olmasıyla birlikte birçok şirkete el konulsa bile bundan sonra milyarlarca liralık serveti yönetmeye devam edeceğini söyleyen Arı, “Cemaatin başına geçecek isim aynı zamanda bu serveti yöneten isim de olacak. ‘Süleymancılar AKP’yi destekleseydi bu operasyon yine de yapılır mıydı?’ sorusu ise bir başka tartışma konusu… İktidarı destekleyen cemaatlere operasyon yapıldığını görmedik…” dedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: "Barış meselesinde çocuklar bir özne olarak hiç konuşulmadı"
content:
IPS İletişim Vakfı/bianet olarak sivil toplumun güçlendirilmesi ve düzenli iletişim kanallarının artırılması hedefiyle Temmuz 2023’ten bu yana sürdürdüğümüz Hak Örgütleriyle Buluşmalar serisinde 36’ncı buluşmamızı Önce Çocuklar Derneği ile gerçekleştirdik. 


Çevrimiçi olarak 12 Ağustos’ta gerçekleştirdiğimiz buluşmaya IPS İletişim Vakfı/bianet adına Atölye BİA Koordinatörü Ceyda Sungur, Atölye BİA Araştırma Koordinatörü Sinem Aydınlı, bianet Sorumlu Yazı İşleri Müdürü Vecih Cuzdan ve bianet Sivil Toplum Paydaşları Muhabiri/Atölye BİA Asistanı Evrim Gündüz; Önce Çocuklar Derneği adına ise Hivran Timur ve Zeynep Sidar Irmak katıldı. 


Buluşmada, Önce Çocuklar Derneği’nin çocuklarla yürüttüğü kültür-sanat ve psikososyal destek çalışmalarını, anadil odaklı atölyelerini ve Diyarbakır’ın Sur ilçesindeki mahalle çalışmalarını konuştuk. 


Hak Örgütleriyle Buluşmalar


10 Şubat 2026


Hivran Timur: Kayyum atamalarından sonra bir ihtiyaç olarak kurulduk 


Hivran Timur, Önce Çocuklar Derneği’nin 2017’de Diyarbakır’da, belediyelere kayyum atamalarının ardından kentteki bazı kurumların kapatılmasıyla ortaya çıkan ihtiyaç üzerine kurulduğunu anlattı. 


Derneğin çalışmalarının ağırlığını kültür-sanat faaliyetleri oluşturuyor. Çalışmalarını Kurmancî ve Zazakî sürdürdüklerini belirten Timur, psikososyal desteğin de faaliyetlerinin bir parçası olduğunu söyledi. 


6 Şubat 2023 depremlerinin ardından Adıyaman’da da çalışmaya başladıklarını aktaran Timur, son dönemde yeniden Diyarbakır’a yoğunlaştıklarını belirtti. Sur’daki çalışmaların ise zamanla mahalle örgütlenmesine doğru genişlediğini söyledi: 


Sur’a taşınmamızla birlikte farklı ihtiyaçların olduğunu gördük. Buradaki çocukların hem radikal dini gruplardan etkilendiğini hem de aileleriyle birlikte 2015’teki şehir savaşlarının ardından ciddi travmalar yaşadıklarını gördük. Bu da bize ‘Mahalle örgütlenmesi anlamında ne yapabiliriz?’ sorusunu sordurdu. Şu anda projesiz, gönüllü bir şekilde yürüttüğümüz atölyelerimiz var. 


Kömür Kültür Sanat Merkezi Adıyaman'da açıldı


27 Mayıs 2024


"Adıyaman’da depremzede çocuklar eğitim, sağlık ve oyun hakkından mahrum"


16 Ekim 2023


Zeynep Sidar Irmak: Çocuklarla bir tiyatro ekibi oluşturmaya çalışıyoruz


Zeynep Sidar Irmak, derneğin Sur’a taşınmasının ardından yaz döneminde pilot bir çalışma başlattıklarını anlattı. Amaçlarının mahalledeki çocukların ihtiyaçlarını ve atölyelere ilgiyi görmek olduğunu belirtti. Gönüllülerin yürütücülüğünde dört atölye açıldığını ve ailelerin doğrudan başvurduğu atölyelerin iki ay boyunca devam ettiğini aktardı. 


Irmak, yaz döneminin ardından çalışmaları sürdürmek istediklerini söyledi. Bunun için atölyelere katılan çocuklardan bir grup oluşturduklarını belirtti: 


Atölyelere katılan çocuklardan yedi kişilik bir grup oluşturduk. Ailelerle görüştük. Ailelerin onayını alırsak okul döneminde de bu grupla drama, kukla ve Kürtçe eğitimlerine devam edip onlardan bir tiyatro ekibi oluşturmaya çalışıyoruz.


ÖNCE ÇOCUKLAR DERNEĞİ


Çocuklar için Kürtçe animasyon atölyesi


9 Ağustos 2022


Irmak: Çalışmayı farklı ilçelere de taşımayı planlıyoruz 


Zeynep Sidar Irmak, derneğin Diyarbakır’ın Çınar ilçesinde erken yaşta ve zorla evliliklere karşı çalışmalar yürüttüğünü anlattı. Çınar’daki çalışmanın beklediklerinden daha iyi ilerlediğini söyledi. Dernek, yeni dönemde benzer çalışmaları Bismil ve Silvan’a da taşımayı planlıyor. 


Irmak, yeni dönemde atölyelerin kapsamını da genişleteceklerini belirtti: 


Toplumsal cinsiyet eşitliği, üreme sağlığı ve cinsel sağlık eğitimlerini de atölyelerimize ekleyeceğiz. Çınar’daki atölyeleri erkeklere ve ergenlere yönelik iki ayrı eğitim şeklinde planlamıştık. Yeni çalışmaları da grupları ayırarak ve bu başlıkları genişleterek yürüteceğiz.


Dünya Edebiyatından 10 çocuk kitabı Kürtçe için seslendiriliyor


8 Temmuz 2022


Timur: Barış meselesinde çocuklar bir özne olarak hiç konuşulmadı


Derneğin barış meselesini de çalışma gündemine aldığını söyleyen Hivran Timur, yürütülen tartışmalarda çocukların deneyimlerinin ve sözlerinin yeterince yer bulmadığına dikkat çekti. 


Daha önce çocuklarla fotoğrafçılık çalışmaları yürüttüklerini aktaran Timur, bu deneyimden hareketle çocuk odaklı bir barış haberciliğinin nasıl kurulabileceği üzerine düşünmeye başladıklarını anlattı: 


Biz şimdi barış meselesini gündemimize almaya çalışıyoruz. Barış meselesinde çocuklar bir özne olarak hiç konuşulmadı. Çocukların medyada kendi sesleriyle yer bulması neredeyse mümkün olmuyor …

author: Naira Hofmeister
title: Corrida por Data Centers gera denúncias de violações trabalhistas em São Paulo
content:
Um “inferno”. Era assim que Francisco Rodrigues, 39 anos, ouvia seus colegas se referirem ao trabalho de construção e montagem do maior campus de data center do Brasil, mantido pela empresa Scala Data Centers, em Barueri, São Paulo.


“Eles falavam que queriam ir embora daquele inferno. Eu até consegui suportar, mas teve momentos em que pensei em desistir”, conta o ex-montador, que diz ter enfrentado jornadas de setenta horas semanais ao longo de um mês — o que ultrapassa o limite que qualquer brasileiro pode trabalhar segundo a legislação, mesmo recebendo horas extras.


Um Data Center é um edifício ou um conjunto deles ocupados por computadores que armazenam e processam informações, dados e imagens disponíveis na internet. Eles também são a casa onde as respostas de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) como o ChatGPT são processadas.

 Agora, com a demanda por IA cada vez maior, Data Centers se tornaram uma infraestrutura essencial no planeta. Isso porque um software de inteligência artificial exige muito mais poder de processamento do que uma operação simples de busca no Google ou envio de e-mail, por exemplo. 


O complexo da Scala em Barueri ocupa uma faixa de cerca de 600 metros às margens do Rodoanel Mario Covas. São nove edifícios, alguns com vários andares, que atendem “clientes de elite do setor” — entre eles a Amazon e a Oracle, conforme informações corporativas da empresa.


‘Teve momentos em que pensei em desistir’, relata Francisco Rodrigues, que enfrentava jornadas de 70 horas semanais


O Brasil é o principal mercado de Data Centers da América Latina. E a expectativa do governo federal, que trabalha pela aprovação de um

projeto

 de lei que concede isenções fiscais para esses empreendimentos no país, é atrair R$ 2 trilhões em investimentos privados ao longo de dez anos, para a expansão do setor.  


A promessa de geração massiva de empregos virou um argumento poderoso para essa indústria

, não só no Brasil, mas em todo o planeta. Em Eldorado do Sul, no Rio Grande do Sul, onde a Scala pretende construir uma “cidade de IA”, a

promessa

 da empresa é de gerar 3 mil postos de trabalho na primeira fase da construção.


Mas

a corrida por data centers está levando essa mão de obra ao esgotamento, segundo análise de 11 processos na Justiça do Trabalho

, entrevistas com trabalhadores e sindicalistas e consultas feitas ao Ministério Público do Trabalho pela

Agência Pública

. 


Procurada pela reportagem, a Scala disse, em nota, que prioriza “a segurança, a saúde e o bem-estar das pessoas em todas as suas operações” e que exige o mesmo padrão de seus fornecedores e parceiros. “A companhia adota rigorosos processos que colocam a preservação da vida e da saúde das pessoas em primeiro lugar e constituem um dos pilares fundamentais da qualidade de suas operações”. A íntegra pode ser lida no final da reportagem. 


Fachada do edifício da Scala Data Centers


“Pedia a Deus pra me mandarem embora”


“No começo, eu levantava feliz para ir trabalhar, mas depois de um tempo, pedia para Deus para que eu não tivesse mais que ir no Data Center, que eles me mandassem embora”

, lembra um homem de 44 anos que trabalhou como montador nas obras da Scala em Barueri e não quer revelar seu nome por medo de retaliações.

Ele deixou o serviço depois de um ano com gastrite crônica. “Eu estava no limite, aquilo estava me fazendo muito mal”, completa, referindo-se à pressão que sofria por produtividade

, o que incluía estender as jornadas além do combinado e negligenciar obrigações de segurança do trabalho para entregar tarefas mais rápido, segundo relata.


A Scala Data Centers é uma das líderes no mercado de Data Centers na América Latina: responde por aproximadamente um quarto da capacidade instalada no Brasil segundo seu demonstrativo financeiro (cerca de 200 MW do total de 800 MW

distribuídos

 em todos os empreendimentos do tipo instalados em território nacional) e possui unidades também no Chile, no México e na Colômbia. 


Seu plano de expansão inclui um estoque de terrenos de 1,2 mil hectares já adquiridos para a construção de novas unidades.

 Apenas a unidade prevista para ser construída em Eldorado do Sul (RS), apelidada de “cidade dos data centers” ou “cidade da IA”, pode chegar à capacidade total de 4.750 MW — seis vezes mais do que todos os Data Centers instalados no Brasil até esse momento.


A Scala tem uma estratégia corporativa para crescer com essa velocidade. Conforme a empresa explica em seus …

author: CMI Argentina
title: La Plata: cooperativas de recicladores mantienen el reclamo por la continuidad de sus puestos
content:
La Municipalidad de La Plata dejó sin trabajo a las 400 familias que realizan tareas en la gestión de residuos secos.


﻿


Escuchá el reporte de Robertina Sacido Torchio desde Radio Estación Sur.


Hace un mes que están sin contratación luego de que la Municipalidad de La Plata, en cumplimiento de la Ley Orgánica de Municipalidades y disposiciones del Tribunal de Cuentas, discontinuara las contrataciones directas de servicios y avanzara con un sistema de licitación pública.


Este nuevo mecanismo no incluye la gestión de residuos secos. Por ende, las 400 familias que realizan estas tareas, quedaron sin trabajo.


Es así que esta semana hicieron en la Plaza Moreno de la capital provincial un “basural a cielo abierto”, para visibilizar la situaciòn y exigirle respuestas al intendente Julio Alak.


En ese sentido, Yoana Zapata, despedida e integrante de la cooperativa Recicladores Unidos, expresó en diálogo con Radio Estación Sur: “La idea era un poco mostrar el trabajo que hacemos todos los días, cómo los compañeros meten la mano en la bolsa verde, en qué condiciones llega la bolsa verde de la ciudad, cómo la tratamos y cómo nos encargamos de la separación del origen para que eso después pueda volver a la industria”.


Además, Zapata agregó que “seguimos esperando una mesa de diálogo con el municipio para poder discutir algún tipo de convenio para poder trabajar. Obviamente que lo principal para nosotros es poder licitar el trabajo que hacemos nosotros, sino tratar de llegar a un acuerdo con algún tipo de convenio para poder seguir trabajando”.

author: David Swanson
title: Le Chapitre du Sud-Kivu Continue de S’organiser Pour la Paix Dans un Contexte Difficile
content:
Par Mkangya Alenga Léon, Coordinateur du chapitre, August 13, 2026


In English below


Depuis plus de trois décennies, l’est de la République démocratique du Congo est affecté par des conflits armés et une insécurité persistante. Cette situation continue d’avoir des conséquences dévastatrices pour les communautés locales, notamment des pertes en vies humaines, des violences, la pauvreté, l’insécurité alimentaire, les déplacements de populations et les mouvements continus de réfugiés à travers les frontières. En 2026, le regain d’insécurité autour de Goma, Bukavu et Uvira a davantage exposé les communautés à un environnement sécuritaire fragile. C’est dans ce contexte difficile que les membres du chapitre de World BEYOND War Sud-Kivu ont continué à renforcer leurs capacités et à développer des moyens de communiquer et de s’organiser pour la paix.


Communication


L’une des évolutions importantes du chapitre jusqu’à présent en 2026 a été son recours croissant aux outils de communication pour atteindre les communautés avec des messages promouvant la paix et la non-violence. À la suite d’une formation en ligne organisée par World BEYOND War sur les réseaux sociaux, les membres du chapitre du Sud-Kivu ont commencé à explorer de nouvelles façons de communiquer sur leurs activités et d’atteindre un public plus large. Le chapitre a pris l’initiative de prendre contact avec une chaîne de radio et d’y partager ses messages de paix. Ces messages sont également partagés avec les réseaux plus larges de WBW Afrique. Pour un chapitre qui intervient dans un contexte où les communautés sont directement touchées par les conflits et l’insécurité, le renforcement des capacités de communication constitue un élément important de la construction de la paix au niveau local.


Sur la sécurité des militants pour la paix


Le chapitre a également participé à des formations visant à renforcer les compétences et la résilience de ses membres. En effet, des membres ont pris part à une formation organisée par

Peace Brigade International Cameroon

 et le chapitre WBW du Cameroun, sur la sécurité des militants pour la paix et des défenseurs des droits humains en Afrique francophone. La formation a permis aux participants d’acquérir des connaissances sur la manière de se protéger et d’exercer leurs activités de manière plus sûre. Le chapitre a également participé à une formation sur la collecte de fonds organisée par World BEYOND War et a acquis des connaissances pratiques sur la collecte de fonds et le développement de projets. Les membres ont été initiés aux principaux éléments à prendre en compte dans la préparation de projets en vue d’opportunités de financement.


Compétences organisationnelles


Les membres du chapitre du Sud-Kivu ont investi dans le développement de leurs compétences en matière d’organisation et de campagne. À travers la formation

Organizing for Power’s Power-Up 2

, les participants ont appris à identifier les acteurs clés et à analyser les structures afin de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des campagnes plus efficaces. Le chapitre a également maintenu des échanges réguliers entre ses membres, aussi bien en ligne qu’en présentiel, afin de discuter du développement du chapitre et de coordonner son travail. Grâce à ces efforts, le chapitre ne limite pas son travail de construction de la paix aux événements publics ; il développe également les compétences, les réseaux, les canaux de communication et les structures qui permettent aux militants de rester engagés dans la durée. Dans un contexte où les conflits continuent de façonner la vie quotidienne, renforcer les capacités du chapitre local en faveur de la paix est essentiel. Cela signifie développer la capacité à communiquer avec les communautés, à s’organiser, à développer des campagnes, à protéger les militants et à promouvoir des alternatives à la violence dans une région qui connaît des décennies de conflits armés. Les activités déjà menées par le chapitre en 2026 s’inscrivent dans sa volonté de construire progressivement ces fondations et de mieux se connecter au mouvement plus large de World BEYOND War en Afrique et au-delà

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Deep Unlearning": Timnit Gebru on AI Hype, Ethics & Algorithmic Racial Bias
content: We speak with Timnit Gebru, a leader in the field of AI ethics, about how artificial intelligence is entrenching societal biases and inequality. Gebru is the founder and executive director of the Distributed Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, a group of academics, activists and engineers who produce research rooted in the belief that technology should benefit everyone. She also co-founded Black in AI, a nonprofit that works to increase the inclusion and visibility of Black people in the field of AI. Gebru previously served as co-lead of the ethical AI research team at Google but was fired in 2020 for writing a paper that warned about the financial and environmental costs of large language models, as well as their propensity to promote racism. The internet, which is what AI uses to train itself, “represents hegemonic views,” says Gebru. “We even know articles like Wikipedia are heavily biased. It’s overwhelmingly Western and male.”

author: anred
title: Relevamiento de especies en el Parque Rural de Ministro Rivadavia: ¿por qué es necesario un Biocorredor en Almirante Brown?
content:
A medida que se incrementan los loteos -algunos ilegales- no existe respuesta del Municipio de Almirante Brown en relación a los servicios públicos de arreglo de calles y recolección de residuos. De esta forma, el gobierno local continúa sin dar respuesta al reclamo de vecinos/as y productores/as en torno a la necesidad del cuidado ambiental y la protección de la producción rural en la zona.

 Por corresponsal, para ANRed.


En el año 2020, apenas iniciada la pandemia, el Municipio de Almirante Brown sanciona la ordenanza 11.819 la cual habilita la figura de Club de Campo, permitiendo que puedan desarrollarse lo que comúnmente se conoce como Countries y destinando para ello entre 1200 y 1400 hectáreas. Se trata de un territorio único en el distrito, por tener un desarrollo rural periurbano, con gran valor ambiental en el que no hay tendido de luminarias, con baja concentración habitacional y grandes parcelas de tierra con producción agrícola, ganadera, frutales, horticultura, floricultura, apicultura y ladrilleras. Desde entonces, vecinos/as del Parque Rural comenzaron a reunirse con preocupación por la nueva normativa.


Antes de la nueva ordenanza, regía la 10.257/14, que protegía el valor rural, productivo y ambiental de esta zona. A raíz de la modificación, aumentó el precio de la tierra un 300%, generando una especulación inmobiliaria, que sin intervención estatal desprotege el último pulmón y esponja de Almirante Brown. Los/as vecinos/as expresan que hace dos meses han presentado una de las últimas notas en las que solicitan una reunión con el Intendente, y actualmente siguen sin respuesta.


La preocupación vecinal es en torno al impacto en las zonas aledañas a Ministro Rivadavía, si continúan rellenando las tierras que hoy en día cumplen la función de esponja y humedal, que ayudan a evitar las inundaciones en todo el distrito y sobre las cuales se está priorizando el negocio inmobiliario, teniendo en cuenta que Ministro Rivadavia representa casi la totalidad del poco espacio verde que queda en todo Almirante Brown. Por otra parte, las/os vecinos/as proponen debatir acerca del acceso público al Arroyo Las Piedras y la creación de senderos a sus alrededores, teniendo en consideración la normativa nacional e internacional vigente conocida como “El camino de Sirga”, dejando 15 metros de cada lado del arroyo y sus brazos.


Actualmente han avanzado los loteos residenciales, pero no respetan las dimensiones establecidas por la nueva ordenanza, a través de estafas hacia las personas que los han adquirido. Ante esto, el Municipio colocó carteles que dicen “no te dejes estafar”, responsabilizando a quienes compran, sin intervenir con quienes venden de forma ilegal. Las/os vecinas/os entienden que, a pesar de la ilegalidad, nadie debe ser desalojado. Pero se encuentran solicitando intervención estatal para que la problemática no siga avanzando.


Por dicha razón, los/as vecinos/as se reúnen para organizar actividades que logren visibilizar el conflicto y sumar voluntades, en función de proteger la producción rural: como el pastoreo, el apoyo a productores/as rurales, el fomento del ecoturismo y el cese de producciones contaminantes para el suelo y el aire. Y al mismo tiempo, lograr la preservación de un conjunto de parcelas para la creación de un Biocorredor natural y silvestre, con servicios ecosistémicos y así beneficiar de forma directa a todo Almirante Brown.


Se han realizado dos bicicleteadas por la zona que contaron con la participación de más de 80 personas y el sábado 15 de agosto convocan a realizar un relevamiento de fauna, flora y funga -hongos- con el objetivo de seguir aprendiendo y aportar a valorizar el patrimonio ambiental de Almirante Brown.

@BIOCORREDORMINISTRORIVADAVIA

title: Cell Tower Goes Up in Smoke (France)
content:
Le Vigen (Haute-Vienne): Cell Tower Goes Up in Smoke

[On Thursday, May 7, around 4:50 a.m. in Le Vigen, about ten kilometers south of Limoges (Haute-Vienne), the TDF transformer located at the base of a Bouygues Telecom telecommunications tower was deliberately set on fire. The fire destroyed batteries, equipment cabinets, and the relay antenna’s cables. Bouygues’ mobile phone services, as well as the radio stations BFM, RMC, and Radio Espérance, were cut off in the area. Below is the claim of responsibility, published the following day on Indy Nantes.]

At dawn on Thursday, May 7, a Bouygues relay antenna and a TDF transformer for the digital radio station broadcasting BFM burned down south of Limoges, at a place known as “La Croix de l’Arbre.” This media and telecommunications infrastructure has been targeted because it is integral to the military industry and the widespread integration of digital technology into our lives.

For Bouygues, ongoing wars are just another source of profit. Through one of its subsidiaries, INEO Defense, it provides communications infrastructure for the French army. As for BFM and RMC, their networks help turn us into spectators of the massacres in Palestine, Lebanon, and elsewhere.

War begins with social pacification and our acceptance of the hegemonic narrative disseminated by the media. We won’t dwell on introducing BFM, well known for being one of the reactionary mouthpieces for industrial interests. Their narratives also accustom us to our powerlessness and define for us the enemy to be fought, whether internal or external. The war effort we reject is the one that seeks to make us accept social austerity as inevitable.

Yet the plundering and militarization of the world continue to face resistance. As demonstrated by the millions of people who took to the streets in support of Palestine and by all the acts of solidarity. Digital technology is being targeted as one of the pillars in the development of AI-driven remote control in military operations, as Israel is using it on a massive scale against the Palestinian people.

Furthermore, military exercises will be taking place in the region in the coming days. Let us not forget that when the military deploys, it is never merely an exercise but always an operation of psychological warfare designed to acclimate people to their presence and make them accept a state of permanent war.

content:

NATO

“The Israelis passed a tip, a concern, that the plane and potentially the president was under threat,” says Dan Lamothe, one of the

Washington Post

reporters who broke the story. But it turns out the ”

CIA

 had low confidence” in the Israeli tip, according to a more recent

Post

title: DEM Partî: Ji bo pirsgirêka Kurd yekem car gaveke hiqûqî hate avêtin
content:
Berdevka Partiya Wekhevî û Demokrasiyê ya Gelan(DEM Partî) Ayşegul Dogan tekildarî geşedanên dawî li navenda giştî ya partiya xwe daxuyanî da. 


Ayşegul Dogan bi lêv kir ku wan qanûna çarçoveyî di civîna Desteya Rêveberiya Navendî (MYK) de jî nirxandiye û wiha got:


“Di dîroka Tirkiyeyê de cara yekem qanûnekî bi vî rengî amade bû. Piştî muzakere û nirxandinên bi rojan, qanûn hat amadekirin. Di encama dengdayîneke mezin bi 467 dengan ew qanûn di Desteya Giştî ya Meclise de hat erêkirin û bû qanûn. Ji bo me qanûneke girîng bû. Cara yekêm em jî qanûnekî îmza dikin.”


Pêşnûmeya “pêvajoyê” li Parlamentoyê hat qebûlkirin


11 Tebax 2026


"Kêmasiyên qanûnê hene lê girîngiya wê jî heye"


Ayşegul Doganê destnîşan kir ku ew qanûn ji bo çareseriyê derfetên hiqûqî derdixin û wiha got:


“Helbet ev qanûn ji hemû pirsgirêkan re çareseriyê nayne. Em kêmasiyên wê rexne dikin lê girîngiya wê jî tînin ziman. Cara yekêm bi awayekî şênber em derbasî merhaleyeke qanûnî bûn. Di pirsgirêka sed salan de cara yekem gaveke qanûnî heye. Yên li dijî pêvajoyeyê jî hene. Helbet rexne û pêşniyar, pêvajoyê xurt dike. Hinek dibêjin ew pêvajo dewletê lewaz dike. Ew ne pêvajoyeke dan û standinê ye. Bi vê pêvajoyê 86 milyon welatî sûd digirin. Şer û pêvçûnan ji bilî qirîza aborî û demokrasiyê, tiştek bi xwe re neanî. Ji bo wê jî hemû gavên şer bi dawî bike tevî kêmasiyan jî ji bo me girîng e. Ji bo tu dayik negirîn divê em hemû berpirsyariyê bigirin. Hinek jî dibêjin ew dayîna tavizan e. Niha rêxistinê xwe fesîh kiriye û ji bo fesîxkirina rêxistinê hiqûqî bibe qanûnek hatiye amadekirin. Di vir de çi tavîz heye. Hinek jî weke ku welat dê parçe bibe propagandayê dikin. Lê berovajî vê propagandayê em qala hevgirtinê dikin. Ew gav ji bo xurtkirina pêşeroja me ye. Hinek jî weke ku pirsgirêk bi polîtikayên ewlehiyê tên çareserkirin propagandayê dikin. Hinek jî dibêjin, ‘berê jî pêvajo destpêkirin lê têk çûn û hûn çawa baweriyê tînin.’ Em jî dibêjin ‘divê hemû alî ji pêvajoyên têkçûne dersan bigirin. Dersgirtin jî bi qanûnê pêkan e. Niha ew yek jî tevî hêdî tê meşandin, lê ji bo pirsgirêk werin çareserkirin gav tên avetin û hewldanek heye.”


Metna pêşnûmeya “pêvajoyê” aşkere bû


5 Tebax 2026


"Ev qanûn ji bo çareseriyê zemîna hiqûqê ava dike"


Di berdewama axaftina xwe de Ayşegul Doganê anî ziman ku divê ji bo daxwazên wan bi cih werin têkoşîna hevpar bê xurtkirin û wiha got:


“Ew qanûn helbet hemû bendewariyên me dabîn nake. Lê bi hezaran kes dê di girtîgehan derbikevin. Bi hezaran kes dê bikarin vegerin. Ew qanûn xwedî wê potansiyeleyê ku zemîneke hiqûqî ji bo çareseriyê ava bike. Rêya me hertim aştî û demokrasiyê ye. Heta niha qada siyaseta demokratîk her tim ji ber van hincetan dihat krîmînalîzekirin. Lê niha serdemekê nû destpê dike. Ew qanûn ji bo merhaleyeke nû derî vedike. Pêkanîna qanûn jî tê meraqkirin. Xebatên me jî didomin. Hin destê werin amadekirin lê xebatên wê di rojên pêş de dê diyar bibe.”


Pêşnûmeya “pêvajoyê” li Parlamentoyê ye


10 Tebax 2026


Kongreya DEM Partiyê di 6ê Îlonê de ye


Ayşegul Doganê da zanîn ku ew dê kongreyê xwe di 6ê Îlonê de li Navenda Çandê ya Nazim Hîkmet a Enqereyê li dar bixin û wiha got:


“Ew kongre dê bibe kongreyeke amadekirinê ya ji nû ve avakirinê. Amedekariyên me yên kongreyê jî didomin. Bi kongeya 6ê Îlonê em starta ji nû ve ava kirinê bidin. Ji aliyê din vê jî em amadekariya civînên gel dikin. Em tevlîbûna jin û ciwanan pir girîng dibinin. ji bo ew pêvajo bi awayekî serkeftî encam bibe em ê beşên cuda yên civakê re jî civînan li darbixin.”


Ayşegul Dogan tekildarî hevdîtina heyeta DEM Partiyê bi Serokkomar Erdogan re jî diyar kir ku ji bo pêkanîna qanûnê hê demeke diyarkirî nîn e û got ku ji bo qanûn were pêkanîn divê hin gav werin avêtin.

title: Όχι στο ξέπλυμα της γενοκτονίας μέσω τουρισμού! – Συγκέντρωση ενάντια στην άφιξη του ισραηλινού κρουαζιεροπλοίου Crown Iris, στο λιμάνι του Πειραιά (Πύλη Ε12 Λιοντάρι) Παρασκευή 14/8 7:30
content:
Η ελληνική κυβέρνηση μετατρέπει τη χώρα σε «θέρετρο» για τους φονιάδες του Ισραηλινού στρατού. Την Παρασκευή 14/8, στον Πειραιά, για ακόμα μια φορά το Crown Iris φέρνει Ισραηλινούς στρατιώτες που έχουν αίμα Παλαιστίνιων στα χέρια τους, για «αναψυχή» στα ελληνικά νησιά.


Από τη Σύρο και τη Ρόδο μέχρι τη Σητεία και τώρα ξανά στον Πειραιά, το μήνυμα γίνεται όλο και δυνατότερο: Η γενοκτονία δεν ξεπλένεται με τον τουρισμό!


ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑΤΑ


14 Αυγούστου – Πειραιάς: Κανένα καράβι για τη γενοκτονία!


Το

BDS Greece

 στηρίζει και καλεί στη συγκέντρωση την Παρασκευή 14 Αυγούστου, στις 7:30 π.μ., στο «Λιοντάρι» στο λιμάνι του Πειραιά, ενάντια στην άφιξη του ισραηλινού κρουαζιερόπλοιου Crown Iris.


Από τη Σύρο και τη Ρόδο μέχρι τη Σητεία και τώρα ξανά στον Πειραιά, το μήνυμα γίνεται όλο και δυνατότερο:


Η γενοκτονία δεν ξεπλένεται με τον τουρισμό!


Την ώρα που το Ισραήλ συνεχίζει την καταστροφή και τον αποκλεισμό της Γάζας και εντείνει την κατοχή, την εποικιστική βία, τις εκτοπίσεις και την αρπαγή παλαιστινιακής γης στη Δυτική Όχθη, επιχειρεί να διατηρήσει στο εξωτερικό μια εικόνα «κανονικότητας». Τα κρουαζιερόπλοια, οι διακοπές και ο τουρισμός γίνονται μέρος αυτής της κανονικοποίησης.


Δεν θα συνηθίσουμε τη γενοκτονία. Δεν θα αποδεχτούμε την κανονικοποίηση του απαρτχάιντ και της κατοχής.


Ιδιαίτερα όταν ανάμεσα στους επιβάτες βρίσκονται άτομα που έχουν υπηρετήσει στις ισραηλινές ένοπλες δυνάμεις κατά τη διάρκεια της γενοκτονικής επίθεσης στη Γάζα, οι ελληνικές αρχές έχουν υποχρέωση να πραγματοποιούν ουσιαστικούς ελέγχους για εμπλοκή σε εγκλήματα πολέμου και σοβαρές παραβιάσεις του διεθνούς δικαίου.


Τεράστια είναι η ευθύνη της ελληνικής κυβέρνησης, που αντί να διακόψει κάθε συνεργασία με το Ισραήλ, βαθαίνει τις στρατιωτικές, οικονομικές και πολιτικές σχέσεις μαζί του, μετατρέποντας την Ελλάδα σε έναν υποτελή συνεργάτη του.


Απέναντι στην εγκληματική συνενοχή απαντάμε με Μποϊκοτάζ – Αποεπένδυση – Κυρώσεις μέχρι το Ισραήλ να συμμορφωθεί με το διεθνές δίκαιο και να σεβαστεί τα αναφαίρετα δικαιώματα του παλαιστινιακού λαού.


Στηρίζουμε την κινητοποίηση που οργανώνουν η Π.Ε.Ν.Ε.Ν., η Ένωση Παλαιστινίων Εργαζομένων Ελλάδας και η Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης στον Παλαιστινιακό Λαό Εργατικών Σωματείων και Συλλογικοτήτων.


Παρασκευή 14 Αυγούστου – 7:30 π.μ.| Πειραιάς – «Λιοντάρι»


Κανένα λιμάνι για τη γενοκτονία!


Καμία κανονικότητα με το ισραηλινό απαρτχάιντ!


Λευτεριά στην Παλαιστίνη!


14 Αυγούστου: Όλοι στη συγκέντρωση για το crown iris, 07:30 πμ Λιοντάρι Πειραιάς


Οι Αγωνιστικές Παρεμβάσεις-Συσπειρώσεις-Κινήσεις ΔΕ στηρίζουμε και καλούμε τους/τις συναδέλφους/ισσες, όπου κι αν βρίσκονται, να συμμετέχουν στην πανελλαδική Ημέρα Δράσης Ενάντια στη Γενοκτονία και τους Υποστηρικτές της, σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας, που καλούν το March to Gaza Greece, το BDS Greece και η Παλαιστινιακή Παροικία Ελλάδας.


Η Γενοκτονία του κράτους-τρομοκράτη του Ισραήλ εναντίον του Παλαιστινιακού λαού, με τις πλάτες των ΗΠΑ, του ΝΑΤΟ, της Ε.Ε. και της ελληνικής κυβέρνησης, συνεχίζεται αμείωτη παρά την υποτιθέμενη συμφωνία εκεχειρίας στη μαρτυρική Γάζα. Πάνω στις χιλιάδες δολοφονίες -μεταξύ αυτών και παιδιών και αμάχων- τους βομβαρδισμούς και την καταστροφή των υποδομών, έρχονται να προστεθούν και νέα ασύλληπτα και απάνθρωπα μέτρα, όπως η εκτροφή κροκοδείλων του Νείλου για να χρησιμοποιηθούν σε παλαιστινιακές φυλακές, και η θέσπιση από το Ισραήλ της θανατικής ποινής μόνο για Παλαιστίνιους. Ταυτόχρονα, στη Δυτική Όχθη στήνονται νέοι οικισμοί σιωνιστών εποίκων, οι οποίοι κλέβουν τη γη των Παλαιστίνιων, που εκδιώκονται, φυλακίζονται (πάνω από 9.500 πολιτικοί κρατούμενοι και ανάμεσά τους 400 παιδιά) και απειλούνται με θανατική ποινή.


Επιπλέον το αμέσως προηγούμενο διάστημα γίναμε μάρτυρες της επέκτασης των επιθετικών σχεδίων του αμερικάνικου ιμπεριαλισμού και του σιωνισμού με το χτύπημα ενάντια στον Ιράν (βασικού συμμάχου του παλαιστινιακού λαού) τις δολοφονίες αμάχων και κρατικών αξιωματούχων με στόχο την καθυπόταξη της χώρας, αλλά και την εκ νέου εισβολή του Ισραήλ στο Λίβανο, όπου και διατηρεί στρατεύματα στο νότιο τμήμα του.


Δεν θα σταματήσουμε να καταγγέλλουμε τη συνενοχή και στήριξη του ελληνικού κράτους και της κυβέρνησης της ΝΔ που


μέσω της golden visa και του real estate μετατρέπει την Ελλάδα σε ασφαλές καταφύγιο για τα ισραηλινά κεφάλαια


κλείνει αιματοβαμμένες «μπίζνες», χρηματοδοτώντας τη γενοκτονία με 5,8 δισ. € από τους φόρους μας (σε Elbit, PULS, SPIKE, «Ασπίδα Αχιλλέα»), λεφτά που κλέβει από την υγεία και την παιδεία.

title: Oppenheimer in Hiroshima, Odyssey in Gaza
content:
The near-hysterical reception that accompanies the release of a Christopher Nolan film has no exceptions. `Odyssey’, his latest flick to hit the screens, has succeeded in a way that would be envious to many, to say the least. The movie has found a huge audience, and also has become a talking point or a conversation starter as Nolan movies are wont to. The unqualified praise that is heaped on this `cinematic phenomenon’ in India deserves a closer look.

Is it the mythical parallel between India and Ancient Greece that makes the movie so palatable to an Indian audience? But Nolan has leached the movie of any of its Greek antecedents. The presence of an Indian actor as Odysseus’ second-in-command strangely jars since this rather serves only to push one out of immersion in the mythical cosmos of Homer. The horrific massacre at Troy and the nonchalance of heroes including Odysseus and Agamemnon to that violence, as depicted in the movie, hardly take away the awe that they inspire. This is more in line with Hollywood `war masala’ where the violence inflicted upon a native populace serves as the source of the trauma which in turn becomes the narrative furnace that propels the movie and the arc of its main character forward. The atrocities inflicted upon the innocents are elided, as they are literally fodder to the violence. So whither cinematic ethics, and what are its ramifications for contemporary Indian society where the release of a movie exalting toxic masculinity is uncannily followed by horrific violence inflicted upon the bodies of women?

The mythical parallels that inspire our adulation of the Nolan epic throw up a challenge, which has been around since the 18th-century debate about the ancients vs the moderns. The ancient cosmos had a coherent ethical code (like the Bronze Age ‘law of Zeus’ regarding the treatment of guests often gratuitously referred to in the movie), or it could have been a problematic space in which warfare and violence towards the vulnerable had been normalised. The modern Semitic world of Abrahamic faiths then dubiously takes the credit for having sanitised the ancient world of its `violence’. Instead of framing this as a binary, the mythical dimension of Semitic faiths has to be traced out.

The Edenic myth and the primogeniture of monotheism

If the Edenic myth in the Abrahamic religions is to be taken seriously, then the ancients had an inkling of that linearly separable dualistic world of God and man. The polytheistic deities of classical Greece then are preceded by the God of Moses, David, and Abraham, of course. Once the source of ancient violence has been located, it would be less inconvenient to point fingers.

Gaza and the primordial nature of violence

The blame for the soul-searing violence that is inflicted upon the populace of Gaza almost daily cannot be conveniently laid at the door of Abrahamic faiths. Islam and Judaism have more in common than one would imagine, like for instance, the kosher meal of a Jewish person would also be halal for a practising Muslim. That this requires no theological transubstantiation comes as a surprise, given the diametrically opposite points to which these two faiths have been located in the contemporary milieu.

The inherent belief in the primordiality of the one god, which is the basis of monotheism, finds its strongest adherents in these two religions.

So if the violence of Hiroshima can be blamed on the moderns and that of Troy on the ancients, where would the actual blame lie? The Ancient Greeks were a slave-keeping people, and the idea of universal `humanism’ can be a bit of a puzzle there. The Allies and the Axis powers during WWII had the totalitarian urge for destruction amply aided by technological prowess.

The organic violence of the ancients and technological annihilation perpetrated by the moderns can be imagined otherwise.

The technique implied in the motif of the Trojan horse belies the Odysseus myth. Odysseus himself is a hero but more in the mould of a master strategist or even trickster than that of a heroic gallant like Achilles. Strategy is aided by technical prowess in the Odyssey. The violence in Oppenheimer was baffling in one location-Japan. The majesty of Oppenheimer’s singular achievement that found so many takers worldwide was not surprisingly met with utter bafflement and astonishment in the space where that violence was inflicted. The banality of evil cannot be redeemed by the exaltation of the human genius behind …

author: A.N.A.
title: [Alemanha] Projekt A: O documental sobre projetos anarquistas na atualidade
content:
Dirigido por Marcel Seehuber e Moritz Springer. Port au Prince Film & Kultur Produktion. Alemanha, 2015. 85 inutos

 

Crises financeiras e ondas de refugiados, desigualdade social e catástrofes ecológicas, terrorismo e guerras… A civilização ocidental é como um trem-bala acelerando em direção a um muro. E no controle dos comandos, governos que não só são incapazes de resolver os problemas das pessoas, mas cuja mera existência já é um problema.

 

Projekt A

 é um documentário que contradiz os clichês típicos sobre o anarquismo e deixa clara uma coisa: outro mundo é possível. E o faz através de inúmeras entrevistas com ativistas anarquistas em diferentes pontos da Europa: em um centro de acolhimento para refugiados no distrito de Exarchia, em Atenas; nas florestas onde ocorreram ações de protesto contra a energia nuclear na Alemanha; na sede da CGT, como a maior organização anarcossindicalista do mundo, na Espanha; ou nos projetos da 

cooperativa catalã CIC

 ou do grupo 

Kartoffelkombinat

 em Munique, também organizado de forma cooperativa.

 

Não se trata de um documentário para ativistas de longa data, mas sim de um meio para dar a conhecer ideias anarquistas a pessoas completamente alheias a elas. Por esse motivo, pode nos parecer às vezes um pouco simples, e teríamos gostado que se aprofundasse um pouco mais nos debates que ocorrem no seio do anarquismo, ou que tivessem aparecido outras organizações de maior tradição anarquista – embora de tamanho inferior à CGT – como a CNT. No entanto, continua sendo interessante ouvir as ativistas que trazem sua ideia de uma existência independente do Estado e de suas estruturas, baseada na igualdade de direitos e com o objetivo de uma economia solidária e comunitária.

 

Como dizem os cineastas que criaram este documentário, “

Projekt A

 coloca em pauta uma visão alternativa do mundo e mostra algumas ideias anarquistas de vida e de atuação conjuntas. Uma forma de sociedade na qual ninguém deveria ter o poder para controlar o conhecimento, os recursos naturais, a terra ou outras pessoas”.

 

Você pode assistir ao documentário completo 

AQUI

:

 

https://kolektiva.media/w/hHLbG497cc9PFE3BhD4Zo1

 

KOLEKTIVA.MEDIA: Projekt A [Ativando as legendas]

 

O documentário PROJEKT A mergulha no mundo multifacetado dos anarquistas e rompe com os clichês habituais de arremessadores de pedras e caóticos. Pelo contrário, abre o olhar para um movimento que exige o impossível, que abala os alicerces da nossa sociedade e que, precisamente por isso, chama a atenção para os problemas centrais não resolvidos do nosso tempo. O filme trata de um movimento político, sua teoria e as pessoas que lutam por sua realização.

 

Hanna, Mariano, Didac, Margarita e Makis são anarquistas. Sonham com uma sociedade livre. Desenham visões concretas de um mundo diferente e tentam colocá-las em prática em suas vidas. Acreditam que os seres humanos podem viver sem dominação, sem Estado, sem polícia, sem leis e sem justiça: uma ideia absurda sob a perspectiva atual.

 

Suas vidas são um confronto com as autoridades, as convenções e os preconceitos. Seja na Espanha, na Grécia ou na Alemanha, em todos os lugares defendem seus ideais e, apesar de todos os revezes e da repressão estatal, mantêm-se combativos. A anarquia é uma abordagem radical e os protagonistas de PROJEKT A questionam os princípios fundamentais da ordem mundial capitalista.

 

E nisso já não estão sozinhos. Vinte anos após o colapso do socialismo real, amplos setores da sociedade também questionam o capitalismo como modelo social viável. Que alternativas o anarquismo oferece?

 

PROJEKT A investiga essa ideia, antiga e ao mesmo tempo nova, e leva o espectador a uma viagem através de projetos anarquistas.

 

O coletivo Projekt A

 

Nós, Moritz e Marcel, somos dois cineastas independentes com ampla experiência no campo do documentário.
