author: Sharon Zhang
title: ICE Is Buying Up to $20 Million Worth of Electric Shock Gloves
content:
The manufacturer says the gloves can allow ICE agents to force compliance within seconds.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is buying up to $20 million worth of gloves that can allow agents to issue a painful electric shock to force people into compliance, granting the agency yet another tool as it extrajudicially abducts and kills people across the country.

According to a notice posted by the Department of Homeland Security on Monday, ICE is planning to spend between $10 million and $20 million on the gloves. The product is made by a Kentucky-based company known as Compliant Technologies LLC, and is called the “Generated Low Output Voltage Emitter,” or the G.L.O.V.E.

The devices look like a normal pair of work gloves and are described by the company as an “invisible partner” and “force multiplier” for law enforcement. When the electric shock function is turned on with a button on the back of the glove, an officer can then administer a shock by laying hands on the subject’s bare skin.

This can force a subject to comply within seconds, Compliant Technologies claims.

“It’s immediate and sharp, and it will distract you. I call it like a bee sting,” Institute for the Prevention of In-Custody Deaths President John Peters told The Associated Press. Peters’s organization has been studying the device. “If the officer is getting any type of resistance from the person, this is certainly an effective tool.”

Peters says that it would offer a “great advantage” to officers who are weaker, and can be used to force ICE subjects to exit homes or vehicles or to move in and out of ICE detention centers.

Civil liberties advocates have raised alarm about the devices, noting ICE agents’ extensive abuses amid the Trump administration’s immigration raids across the U.S.

“ICE spent the last year showing this country they are too quick to use force. Now they will be able to deploy electric shocks with the slight push of a button that maybe nobody else can see them do,” said Jenn Rolnick Borchetta, an expert on policing at the American Civil Liberties Union, to AP. “Introducing gloves that can so easily be used to deliver terrible pain in encounters is a recipe for harm to the public.”

“ICE has repeatedly demonstrated a willingness to use aggressive and even deadly force against immigrants and U.S. citizens alike,” said Kica Matos, president of the National Immigration Law Center, in a statement. “Arming poorly trained agents with electric shock gloves to inflict pain on our neighbors is disgusting.”

The product’s user manual warns that use of the product can “increase the affects [sic] that can cause sudden death,” like disruptions to heart rhythm, blood pressure, and blood chemistry.

The company warns that it should not be used on particularly vulnerable populations like the elderly, children, and pregnant people. The company also says that it should not be used as punishment or on people merely expressing verbal defiance or belligerence, and that it should not be applied for more than 15 seconds.

The purchase grants another tool to ICE agents, whose agency already faces scrutiny for abuses. ICE agents have shot and killed at least 10 people since the start of the second Trump administration, while at least 54 people have been killed in ICE custody since 2025, as deaths in detention have reached record highs.

Meanwhile, the purchase is a drop in the bucket for the agency after Congress granted another $70 billion to ICE and Border Patrol earlier this year, on top of another $75 billion infusion last year.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish woman’s fate unknown 45 days after arrest by IRGC in Orumiyeh
content:
The fate of Parvin (Akhtar) Rasegh Ghezelbash, a 33-year-old Kurdish woman from Maku, remains unknown 45 days after her arrest by forces of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation in Orumiyeh, the provincial capital.


According to the Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN), IRGC Intelligence Organisation forces arrested Rasegh Ghezelbash without a warrant in Orumiyeh on 28 June and took her to an undisclosed location.


Despite her family’s repeated visits to the authorities and continuing efforts to obtain information about her situation, security and judicial authorities have refused to respond or provide any explanation.


No information is still available regarding the reason for her arrest or the charges brought against her.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish youth from across Europe to gather in Cologne
content:
Kurdish youth from various parts of Europe will gather in Cologne in early September for a joint action in support of democracy, peace, and freedom. The demonstration, scheduled for September 4, will place particular emphasis on the demand for the physical freedom of Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan.


According to the organizing committee, the event also aims to draw attention to the process for peace and democratic society and to the role of young people in its further development. The organizers emphasize the importance of youth as a driving social force in political transformation.


Central demand: Freedom for Öcalan


The organizing committee describes Abdullah Öcalan’s physical freedom as one of the key prerequisites for advancing the peace and democratization process. Against this backdrop, the gathering in Cologne aims to publicly highlight the demands for democracy, peace, and freedom.


Young people traveling from various European cities will gather on Thursday, September 3, at 2:00 p.m. in Cologne-Ehrenfeld, where joint preparations will take place for the following day’s action. The main demonstration will begin on Friday, September 4, at 9:00 a.m. in front of Cologne Cathedral. The organizing committee is calling not only on young people but also on the Kurdish community and supporters to take part in the action.


From Cologne to the Kurdish Cultural Festival in Dortmund


Following the demonstration in Cologne, participants will travel to Dortmund on Saturday, September 5, to attend the 34th International Kurdish Cultural Festival. The three-day gathering will therefore combine political action with cultural exchange among the Kurdish diaspora in Europe.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish political prisoner rearrested in Iran faces serious charges
content:
Mehdi (Sikan) Roshani, a Kurdish political prisoner from Malekshahi in Ilam Province, is facing charges of “enmity against God” (moharebeh) and “spreading corruption on earth” (efsad-e fel-arz) following his rearrest last month.


An informed source told the Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) that security forces arrested Roshani for a second time on 18 July and transferred him to Ilam Central Prison, where he remains held.


Following his transfer to prison, a new case was opened against him at Branch Six of the Investigation Office of the Ilam Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office, where he was formally notified of the charges.


However, no indictment has yet been issued, and the case remains at the investigation stage.


The source said Roshani had previously been prosecuted and sentenced over his participation in protests in Malekshahi.


Security forces first arrested Roshani on 16 January during protests in Malekshahi. After approximately three months in detention, he was temporarily released on bail.


The Islamic Revolutionary Court in Ilam later sentenced him to three years in prison, which was subsequently reduced to nine months.

author: Equality Now
title: Young people leverage digital media to advance gender equality in the Middle East and North Africa
content:
12th August 2026


Young people leverage digital media to advance gender equality in the Middle East and North Africa


9 min read


News and Insights


Achieve legal equality


Middle East and North Africa


Empowering a new generation of advocates with digital tools to transform human rights awareness from their smartphones


A smartphone, an internet connection, and a good story to tell.

Young people are among the most active users of digital technologies worldwide.

That’s all they need today to have unprecedented opportunities to express themselves, share knowledge, and make a difference in their societies.


Research

 indicates that the Middle East and North Africa region has one of the world’s highest rates of social media usage, with Generation Z (people born between 1997 and 2012) making up the majority of social media users in the region.


In the digital age,

online tools are no longer simply devices for personal communication or entertainment. For many young people, they have become tools for visibility, participation, and social engagement taking place on a daily basis.


Digital media transforms the advocacy landscape in the Middle East and North Africa


Currently, we are living in an era where a simple


photo or video could spark a movement. This transforms what appears to be an individual (personal) story into a collective (political) action. A prime example of this is the

 #MeToo movement,

where individual stories of sexual harassment and assault accumulated into an undeniable chorus that eventually sparked global conversations about gender-based violence. 


Today, digital media is transforming advocacy once again through the various available digital tools, which have become

“an essential component of almost any movement”,

according to

 the Community Tool Box

 at the University of Kansas. 


Social media platforms, mobile technologies, digital video, podcasts, and online communities have fundamentally changed how people engage with social issues. 


Advocacy in the Digital Era


Digital advocacy is further defined as “

the use of digital technology to contact, inform, and mobilise a group of concerned people around an issue or cause”, with the aim of urging relevant decision-makers and stakeholders to take action towards that issue or cause.


In that sense, advocacy is no longer confined to conference rooms, policy forums, or traditional media outlets. It increasingly takes place on smartphones, news feeds, and digital platforms that connect individuals and communities across geographical boundaries. 


Young people use digital media to advocate for human rights and gender equality


This massive digital presence has fundamentally changed how young people interact with information, as they are no longer just passive consumers. Rather, they are now active creators who contribute to knowledge production in digital spaces, with

Gen Z reshaping the future of advocacy

 in the region in their own ways.


Across the Middle East and North Africa, deeply rooted social norms continue to normalise gender-based violence and discrimination against women and girls. Yet young people are increasingly using their mobile phones to expose inequality, amplify overlooked grassroots issues, and demand action. In today’s digital landscape, a smartphone serves as a camera, newsroom, editing suite, archive, and advocacy platform all in one, democratizing media production and enabling youth to tell powerful stories without the need for large budgets, specialised equipment, or traditional media gatekeepers. 


Equality Now invests in youth movement building


Realising that young people are the cornerstone of the human rights and gender equality movement,

Equal

i

ty Now

has


turned to investing in those young minds through the

capacity-building workshops it implements for youth across the MENA region. These workshops are intentionally designed to provide young people from the MENA region with knowledge and tools of legal and digital media advocacy.


According to the MENA representative at Equality Now, Dr. Dima Dabbous, realising how young people love to use social media, Equality Now MENA has developed “a training module specifically designed to raise the capacities of young people on how to use social media for advocacy and allow them to air their views on human rights issues effectively to reach out to other young people in their communities and actually get them on board of advocacy efforts”.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Laguna Paiva II: reconocen como crimen de lesa humanidad el abandono de persona padecido por hijas e hijos de secuestrados y desaparecidos
content:
El Tribunal Oral en lo Criminal Federal de Santa Fe -integrado por los jueces Ricardo Vázquez, Mario Gambacorta y Osvaldo Facciano- dio a conocer el viernes pasado el veredicto condenatorio para los cuatro imputados en la causa conocida como Laguna Paiva II. Los delitos ventilados fueron privación ilegítima de la libertad, tormentos, violación de domicilio, apremios ilegales, incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público, falsedad ideológica y abandono de persona, este último considerado crimen de lesa humanidad por primera vez –y por iniciativa del equipo jurídico de la Asamblea Permanente por los Derechos Humanos- desde que se realizan este tipo de juicios.


“Esta no es una condena más sino una muy especial porque reconoce por primera vez en Argentina el abandono de persona, en este caso de niñas y niños, como un crimen de lesa humanidad. Y al mismo tiempo se suma a las 365 sentencias ya dictadas desde la nulidad de las leyes de impunidad en 2006 hasta el presente que demuestran, con rigor judicial, que en el país se desarrolló un genocidio”, afirmó a ANDAR el abogado Guillermo Torremare, de vasta experiencia en juicios de lesa humanidad y referente de la APDH así como miembro de la CPM.


El juicio Laguna Paiva II ventiló un conjunto de delitos cometidos desde comienzos de 1980 por parte de integrantes de la estructura represiva que operó en torno al Departamento de Informaciones D2 de la Policía provincial de Santa Fe. Entre los casos juzgados, se reconstruyó el derrotero y el padecimiento de 16 niñas y niños cuyos hogares fueron asaltados por patotas policiales y sus padres secuestrados, torturados y privados de libertad durante largo tiempo.


Esas infancias, de entre 1 y 13 años, sufrieron los tormentos propios de la situación que vivieron en los allanamientos clandestinos, y luego quedaron en total desamparo, por largos meses al cabo de los cuales algunos de sus familiares recuperaron la libertad. Tal desamparo implicó todo tipo de padecimientos, desde hambre, miedo y enfermedad hasta la total incertidumbre sobre el futuro, lo que signó la vida de cada una de esas víctimas.


Durante el juicio llevado a instancias del Tribunal Oral en lo Criminal Federal de Santa Fe  -integrado por los jueces Ricardo Vázquez, Mario Gambacorta y Osvaldo Facciano-se pudo demostrar que las niñas y niños no fueron meros damnificadas colaterales de la represión, sino que constituyeron un blanco autónomo y estratégico dentro del plan sistemático de exterminio desarrollado por la dictadura cívico militar.


En ese sentido, los magistrados -siguiendo el pedido de la fiscalía y de la querella de la Asamblea Permanente por los Derechos Humanos- determinaron que las conductas del exjuez Víctor Brusa y los tres expolicías Eduardo Riuli, Oscar Valdez y Antonio Parvelotti resultan constitutivas de delitos de lesa humanidad y recibieron penas que van desde los 9 a 18 años de prisión. Los fundamentos de la sentencia se conocerán el próximo 7 de septiembre.


“A la sentencia de Laguna Paiva II se llegó porque las organizaciones de derechos humanos y las de protección de las infancias apoyaron que se investigaran y juzgaran los terribles padecimientos de aquellos niños y niñas abandonados a su suerte luego del secuestro de sus padres”, enfatizó Torremare y agregó: “Que uno de los condenados sea un ex juez –Víctor Brusa- demuestra que la represión clandestina tuvo la cobertura civil de un sector del Poder Judicial”.


Por último y con respecto al tiempo transcurrido para el juzgamiento de los delitos sobre las niñeces, el abogado explicó que se trata de procesos dinámicos: “Hasta 2010 no se habían reconocido como crímenes de lesa humanidad a los abusos sexuales cometidos en centros clandestinos. Y hoy nos parece increíble que eso no haya sido visto o tratado antes. Con el abandono de persona, que tardó muchos años más, pasa algo parecido”.

author: Estefa
title: Hoy Florencia Cuellar cumpliría 37 años: «Feliz cumple China», palabras de su papá Alfredo
content:
Hoy 12 de agosto Florencia «La China» Cuellar hubiera cumplido 37 años, pero su vida fue arrebatada el 23 de enero del 2012 a sus 23. Fue encontrada aquel día sin vida en el penal de Ezeiza, había sido la única imputada de una pelea callejera, a los 19 años, y fue condenada a 6 años de prisión. Aquel 23 fueron sus mismas compañeras del penal quienes le avisaron a su papá Alfredo que algo estaba pasando, fue hallada sin vida en su celda del pabellón 23 de la unidad IV del penal. A pesar de los golpes encontrados en su cuerpo, el Servicio Penitenciario Federal, aseguró que se había tratado de un suicidio. Sus compañeras  declararon  que La China fue golpeada brutalmente por  agentes del Servicio y que la dejaron agonizar antes de montar la escena del suicidio. Pese a ello la causa avanzó lento, con irregularidades hace más de un década y sin investigación firme sobre la hipótesis de homicidio pese a los contundentes testimonios y antecedentes  en el Penal. «Cuando siento que me falta el aire y las ganas de vivir ya no son las mismas, es ahí donde te busco, en esa estrella lejana tan solo para pedirte que sigas iluminado mi camino!Feliz cumpleaños hija! Donde quieras que estés: ¡Ni Una Menos en las cárceles también !», compartimos la palabras de Alfredo Cuellar, su papá, en este nuevo aniversario del nacimiento de «La China». Un dolor insondable pero transitado con su memoria y la continuidad de una lucha que Florencia había iniciado contra las violencias  y el horror de las prisiones.  Por ANRed.


¡Feliz cumple China!


Estoy con la mirada firme


frente a la inmensidad entre el mar y la tierra , entre el ir y venir de este viento sureño! Que me acaricia el alma.


Siento que tú voz me llama, tu aliento ,lo percibo como si estuviera tan cerca mío, pero la realidad me indica que es simplemente un deseo.


Duermo en la noche con la ilusión de poder verte en mi sueño y veo que también es un deseo.


Me golpeó y me pellizco el cuerpo para ver si sigo siendo aquel padre que soñó envejecer feliz junto a sus hijxs y me di cuenta que también fue solo un deseo, solo sé que ya no soy ese padre que siempre quise ser,porque dejaste un enorme vacío en mi vida.


Se que te metiste en mi cuerpo te adueñaste de mi ser ,porque aún recuerdo esos últimos instantes cuando tú ataúd bajaba lentamente hasta el fondo de la tierra para quedarse con tu cuerpo pero no con tu voz , porque tú voz  ¡se quedó en mi para siempre!


Por eso cuando siento que me falta el aire y las ganas de vivir ya no son las mismas, es ahí donde te busco en esa estrella lejana tan solo para pedirte  ¡qué sigas iluminado mi camino!


¡Feliz cumpleaños hija! ¡Donde quieras que estés!


¡Ni Una Menos en las cárceles también !


Alfredo Cuellar

author: CMI Argentina
title: Un jurado popular declaró culpable al policía Grané por el crimen de Diego Roda
content:
El veredicto del jurado determinó que fue un caso de gatillo fácil y de esta manera volvió a plantear que la policía no debe abrir fuego en zonas urbanas, donde el riesgo letal a terceros es altísimo. Así lo establece la propia ley de actuación policial, y hacer lo contrario puede derivar en la condena por homicidio calificado por abuso de la función.


“El jurado popular entendió que el gatillo fácil es una conducta policial sistémica y por eso amparada desde la estructura del poder. Recordemos que pasaron diez años porque, entre otras cosas, los propios policías y el gobierno de María Eugenia Vidal se encargaron de encubrir el crimen”, dijo a Andar el abogado querellante Ismael Jalil. “El veredicto condenatorio va más allá del condenado y asume especial advertencia para los jueces técnicos proclives en calificar con figuras menos gravosas cuando no a directamente justificar esta conducta. El Jurado recibió nuestra advertencia en cuanto a tener en cuenta la trascendencia social de la función policial y que no existe excusa ninguna para amparar la resolución de ningún conflicto social o individual con el uso de la reglamentaria”, agregó.


A criterio de Jalil, cuando Grané mató a Diego Roda lo estaba haciendo el propio Estado. “No fue una muerte más, tampoco un exceso ni mucho menos un error. Ha sido la consecuencia de una política de estado a la que por diversas razones, se prestan los que -como el propio condenado- expresan en la calle el monopolio de la violencia estatal. El crimen de Diego Roda fue gatillo fácil, lo dijo el Jurado popular. Es de esperar que sirva de referencia para todos los casos que aún reclaman Justicia”, expresó el letrado.


El veredicto


Un jurado de doce vecinos de Morón consideró por unanimidad culpable al ex policía Fernando Grané por el crimen del comerciante de Ituzaingó, Diego Roda y el intento de homicidio de su esposa. Será condenado a prisión perpetua, tras casi diez años de investigación. La figura que se impuso fue la de homicidio calificado agravado por ser miembro de una fuerza de seguridad y, además, por falsedad ideológica al encubrir la escena del crimen para zafar de culpa y cargo. Así lo decidió el jurado el pasado 3 de agosto, luego de más de dos horas de deliberación. Ahora sólo resta la decisión final a cargo de la jueza Julia de la Llana, que impondrá el monto de pena.


El veredicto trajo un inmenso alivio a las víctimas y coincidió con el pedido realizado por los fiscales del juicio, Patricio Pagani y Adrián Ferreira, y con lo planteado por las querellas, a cargo de los abogados Jalil, en representación de los padres del fallecido, y Gerónimo Podestá en nombre de la viuda, Virginia Tueso.


Los hechos


El domingo 12 de septiembre de 2016 varios policías perseguían a unos delincuentes que se habían fugado en una camioneta robada en Villa Pineral en la madrugada. A la altura de Ituzaingó, se desencadenó la masacre. Los policías rodearon otra camioneta diferente y la acribillaron a balazos. En ella iban el verdulero Diego Roda, su esposa y su bebé de 12 días, a comprar las frutas para abrir la verdulería. Roda murió, su esposa fue herida y su bebé no recibió disparos.


En ese momento comenzó la maniobra de encubrimiento para exonerar a los policías y echarle la culpa a los ladrones a quienes perseguían. Sin embargo, se vino abajo con este veredicto unánime del jurado. Ante la masacre, los policías alteraron la escena y las actas para hacer creer que fueron los delincuentes quienes balearon la camioneta para robarla y continuar la huida, ya que la de ellos había reventado una goma. Un demorado peritaje balístico independiente, a cargo de la Policía de la Ciudad, demostró lo contrario. Tres años después, en 2019 y tras gran presión de la familia de Roda, la pericia arrojó que las balas eran de los policías del procedimiento.


Diego se levantaba todos los días antes de que el sol diera sus primeras señales. Pasaba por el mercado, compraba lo que hiciera falta y se iba a la verdulería El Económico, en la esquina de Brandsen y Belén, Ituzaingó, a esperar la llegada de los primeros clientes. Según el relato de los sitios Juicio por jurados y Primer plano, aquel domingo a la noche, Diego, de 38 años, apuró la salida de la casa de su suegra, en la calle El Delta al 2300, a unas pocas cuadras de trabajo. Virginia Tueso, su esposa, de 34, cargó en brazos a Pedrito, y los tres se metieron en el auto.

author: Joshua Carroll
title: UK Government Won’t Release Files on Israeli Firm ‘Meddling’ in Election
content:
The British government has refused to release any files about alleged meddling by an Israeli firm in elections in Scotland earlier this year.


A little-known firm named BlackCore was

accused by French authorities in June

of meddling in elections in Scotland, France, New York, Angola and Togo after a probe uncovered the use of fake social media accounts. 


Viginum, a French government agency that fights foreign digital interference, said BlackCore had coordinated hundreds of accounts to post negative comments about Scottish first minister John Swinney during his bid for re-election, which was nonetheless successful.  


The agency launched an investigation after evidence suggested BlackCore may have tried to smear three candidates from the leftwing France Unbowed party during municipal elections in March,

Reuters reported

. 


After

the National newspaper asked for files

 relating to the allegations under freedom of information (FOI) rules, the UK Cabinet Office rejected the request to “avoid giving offence to other nations and retain the trust of our international partners”.


It also said doing so could damage national security. “Taking into account all the circumstances of this case, we have determined that the balance of the public interest favours withholding this information,” it said. 


An exemption under FOI rules allows for information to be withheld if it would “prejudice relations between the United Kingdom and any other state”.


Scotland’s government, however, did release some files in response to an identical request made by the National, while withholding others on national security grounds. 


The files suggest that Swinney and other government figures were unaware of the allegations about BlackCore until they saw them in the media.  


“You might not have seen this,” one email between two redacted addresses said.   


John Webster, the principal private secretary to the first minister, was copied in. He replied: “I have shared this with FM [Swinney] – anticipating that he will want to understand more about this report… and what actions remedial and future / proactive are being taken.”


Scottish Greens co-leader Gillian Mackay told the National: “These allegations of meddling in elections from BlackCore represent a potentially extremely serious attack on Scotland’s democracy.


“The public deserves to know whether warnings were missed before polling day, and what action has been taken since. All governments should do their part to provide clear assurances that Scotland’s democratic processes are being protected.”


BlackCore deleted its online presence after being contacted by Reuters in June, and has not made any public statements about the allegations.

author: Chris Walker
title: White House Reportedly Asks DOJ to Revive Reflecting Pool Vandalism Charges
content:
Charges against Hearn were dropped in late July after prosecutors found evidence contradicting Trump’s narrative.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The Trump administration is reportedly considering renewing charges against former Olympic canoeist David Hearn, just weeks after U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro admitted that claims of him vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool were likely false.

The new charges would be highly unusual, especially with that admission being submitted in official court records, and would present a difficult case for Pirro’s office to pursue. The push to renew the case may be due to President Donald Trump’s continued, almost fanatical insistence — despite evidence indicating otherwise — that Hearn and others vandalized the pool.

The Wall Street Journal was the first to report on potential plans to renew the case, citing multiple sources with knowledge of the discussions taking place in the White House. According to their reports, the Trump administration is asking the Department of Justice (DOJ) to consider reviving the charges.

Hearn was on a long-distance bike ride earlier this summer when he stopped at the reflecting pool. Media reports at the time indicated that renovations of the pool had resulted in large algae growth, and that chemicals used to remedy the problem were lifting the newly painted blue lining at the bottom. When Hearn reached his hand in the pool to feel the lining for himself, he was immediately arrested by the National Park Service (NPS) and charged with felony level vandalism.

In late July, however, Pirro dropped the charges against Hearn, noting that internal documents at the Interior Department — which had publicly backed Trump’s assertions that Hearn had vandalized the pool — showed that damage to the pool was likely the result of the chemicals in the water, rather than vandals out to embarrass the president ahead of the nation’s 250th birthday celebrations.

Despite Pirro showing that evidence directly to Trump, the president continued to insist that Hearn and others had done extensive damage to the pool. In a post on Truth Social on Sunday, Trump insisted that an unnamed NPS employee had seen Hearn engage in vandalism, saying that the former Olympian was “‘violently’ ripping and tugging at the Pool’s somewhat delicate coating.”

Notably, Trump had previously claimed that the coating was so strong that it couldn’t even be cut. The president presented no other evidence to back his claims against Hearn in the post.

Norm Eisen, one of the lawyers representing Hearn, condemned the administration for considering renewing the charges.

“Is DOJ seriously considering reviving a case they ADMITTED lacked evidence to convict? It’s a new low for them — & blatant harassment of an innocent man,” Eisen said in a Bluesky post.

Prior to reports of the White House making these new considerations, Hearn himself said that the ordeal has tested his beliefs.

“My confidence is being tested for sure here, in what our nation can withstand,” Hearn told NPR earlier this week. “But I don’t think people are taking this lying down.”

Indeed, a plurality of Americans are doubtful of Trump’s claims regarding vandalism. According to an Economist/YouGov poll published on Tuesday, only 20 percent believe his claims regarding “vandals” being responsible for the damage at the reflecting pool, while 48 percent said they do not. Thirty-two percent said they were unsure.

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Naskapi-Cree rapper Kong brings message of resilience to Aqpik Jam
content:
When Kong steps onto the stage of Aqpik Jam Wednesday, he will be speaking to the youth.


Steve Einish, the Naskapi and Cree rapper known as Kong, has spent much of his life navigating struggles that can leave a young person feeling hopeless.


At 15, he lost his mother to cancer. Then he spent time in group homes and foster care before being incarcerated at age 20.


“There were times where I thought, ‘It’s over. My life is over. I just ruined my life,’” he said Tuesday in an interview. “I want the youth to rise up from whatever they’re going through because I myself have been there.”


The 37-year-old said music became an outlet for him while in prison, where he wrote the first verse to his song,

Pathways

, which he released in 2021.


Before he started recording, Kong spent years helping other performers develop their careers, working as a manager and booking agent across Canada.


He also operates Nomad Entertainment, a sound, lighting and events company serving Eeyou Istchee and surrounding Cree communities.


When the COVID-19 pandemic shut down live events in 2020, that work came to a standstill. With his business impacted and live events disappearing, he began to hone his craft.


“When I started to put out music, I said, ‘This is the last thing I’m going to try to accomplish in my life,’” Kong said, adding that he lost many opportunities due to his criminal record.


This year marks Kong’s first time performing at Aqpik Jam, Nunavik’s largest music festival. Held in Kuujjuaq, the event runs Tuesday to Friday.


For Kong, performing in Kuujjuaq is also an opportunity to reconnect with a history that stretches beyond his life.


“When I stepped off the plane, I felt like home,” he said.


Kong’s mother was from Whapmagoostui and his father from Schefferville, Que. His Naskapi family history is connected to Fort Chimo, now known as Kuujjuaq, where his ancestors lived before government officials started relocating families.


“My grandfather was just a kid when he was lost, separated from his family during the last move — to Kawawachikamach [in northern Quebec],” Kong said. “He didn’t remember his last name.”


The family that found his grandfather gave him theirs, Einish.


On the Aqpik Jam stage, Kong will be joined by DJ Blaster — or Sherwin Cumberbatch — who has been working in the industry for 30 years. The pair has been performing together for two years now.


Cumberbatch said he has seen firsthand how young people respond to Kong and his music.


“I see how they gravitate towards him, how they love him,” he said.


Kong said he’s looking forward to connecting with the crowd.


“I’m going to give it my all. I’m going to give 110 per cent to my set, and spread the message and good vibes,” he said.


Kong hopes to release his first studio album in the fall. The project will explore resilience, struggle, death, poverty and the realities facing young people in Indigenous communities.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Fentanilo: “Los que votaron la Ley Bases son cómplices de esta matanza”
content:
Daniel Oviedo murió el 17 de mayo del año pasado tras pasar 113 días internado en el Hospital Italiano de La Plata, que fue epicentro de una tragedia sanitaria. Daniel era papá de tres hijos y estaba en tratamiento de diálisis desde hacía 16 años. Su familia sostiene que lo que agravó su estado no fue su enfermedad, sino un factor externo inesperado.


Gisel es su hermana, visitó

Radio Ahijuna

 y dijo que su caso se confirmó con la detección de la anestesia adulterada: “En nuestro caso, el hospital había anotado cada ampolla que le daba a mi hermano. Había días que le daban entre 30 o 34 unidades de fentanilo. Entonces antes de llegar a la cama de mi hermano veía que por ahí los pacientes estaban de repente muy hinchados, vomitaban sangre, estaban sacados, muy muy nerviosos”.


Además, relató de qué manera se organizaron con el resto de los familiares de las víctimas: “Ni bien nos enteramos nos acercamos al hospital y el director del hospital nos dice que mi hermano estaba en una lista, lo primero que hago es ubicar al chico de la cama anterior. Este chico, que es la familia Ayala, ya venía juntándose con la mamá de Renato Nicolini, entonces me uní a ellos dos”.


Fueron detenidas y dejadas en libertad bajo fianza durante el fin de semana, Nélida Agustina Bisio, ex directora de la ANMAT, y Gabriela Mantecón Fumadó, ex responsable del Instituto Nacional de Medicamentos (INAME). Por el expediente también permanece detenido Ariel García Furfaro, dueño del laboratorio.


La investigación judicial continúa. El padre de Daniel dijo que el juez y la tarea que lleva adelante es aceptable, pero que el tema está fuera de agenda y dice que también hay responsabilidades penales que van desde el ministro de Salud, Mario Lugones, hacia arriba.


“Claramente es la responsabilidad del gobierno, pero la investigación debiera ir hacia arriba, hasta llegar a la cabeza de este despropósito de las regulaciones que es Javier Gerardo Milei, nada menos que nuestro presidente. Acá debiera pasar por Mario Lugones, que es el operador del Ministerio de Salud y es una de las billeteras del Estado”, además agregó que “todos los que levantaron la manito para votar las leyes Bases, en cierto sentido son cómplices de esta matanza, porque dieron pie a que se forme el Ministerio de Desregulación, Transformación y Modernización del Estado, a cargo de Federico Sturzenegger, que esta vez no atentó contra la billetera de los argentinos, como lo hizo en 2001 y después en el gobierno de Macri”.

author: Unknown
title: Four drones crash in the Hewlêr region
content:
Four drones crashed on Wednesday morning in areas of Soran, Xelîfan, and Herîr in Hewlêr (Erbil) province in Southern Kurdistan (Northern Iraq). One of the drones struck a residential building, but according to initial reports, no one was injured.


Loud explosions were heard after the drones crashed. A fire subsequently broke out in at least one of the crash sites. No information on further property damage has been reported so far.


It remains unclear who the drones belonged to or what their intended targets were. Iran or Iraqi militias allied with Tehran are considered possible perpetrators, although this has not yet been confirmed.


Repeated attacks on Southern Kurdistan


The incident comes amid ongoing drone and missile attacks on the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (KRI). Since the war waged by the United States and Israel against Iran began in late February, targets in Southern Kurdistan have repeatedly been attacked by Iran and Iran-aligned militias in Iraq. In addition to military facilities and energy infrastructure, positions and facilities belonging to Kurdish parties from Eastern Kurdistan have also been targeted. It remains unclear whether the drones that crashed in Hewlêr province on Wednesday were part of this wave of attacks.

author: Andrea DiP
title: Vale do Silício tenta vender a cristãos que Inteligência Artificial é plano divino
content:
“Se Deus tem usado o rádio, a televisão, as redes sociais e tantos outros meios tecnológicos para alcançar pessoas, por que não utilizaria também as IAs? Com certeza, Ele as utilizará!”. A frase é do pastor William E. Timm, coordenador de evangelismo digital na Rede Novo Tempo, publicada na Revista Adventista. 


Cada vez mais, a indústria da tecnologia tenta vender a ideia de que a Inteligência Artificial (IA) e seus desdobramentos são inevitáveis e necessários

 – para criar respostas, pensar por nós, dar conta de produzir dentro do tempo acelerado do capitalismo neoliberal que nos esmaga, solucionar crises e, no fim das contas, atuar como um oráculo do qual, em um futuro próximo, vamos precisar tanto quanto necessitamos de água ou luz. 


Mas tem um campo que ainda precisa ser totalmente convencido pelos “tech bros”: o da direita cristã, que ainda está… dividida. 


E é isso que alguns círculos do Vale do Silício estão tentando fazer, como mostra uma reportagem recente

da revista Mother Jones

.

 A jornalista Kiera Butler, que assina o texto, lembra que em 2025, durante a Conferência Nacional de Conservadorismo que acontece anualmente nos Estados Unidos (e que reúne um grupo que se consolidou como uma forte influência nas decisões políticas do governo Trump), o professor de psicologia da Universidade do Novo México, Geoffrey Miller confrontou o diretor de tecnologia da Palantir, Shyam Sankar, em uma discussão acalorada, dizendo que a indústria de IA, é “globalista, secular, liberal, feminizada e transumanista. Eles querem explicitamente o desemprego em massa, planejam um comunismo baseado na Renda Básica Universal e veem a espécie humana como um ‘carregador de inicialização’ biológico, como eles dizem, para a superinteligência artificial”. Sankar ficou visivelmente desconfortável.   


Miller não está sozinho,

há toda uma leva de cristãos ultraconservadores dizendo por aí que a IA é o anticristo e que o plano “woke” não vai parar na transição de gênero, mas que o objetivo final é transicionar de humano para máquina. 


Também não ajuda o fato de que alguns porta-vozes como Sam Altman, cofundador da OpenAI, amam declarações apocalípticas como a de que a IA “provavelmente levará ao fim do mundo

, mas, enquanto isso, haverá grandes empresas”. 


Por isso, alguns oligarcas do Vale do Silício estão tentando intermediar a discussão entre esses dois campos emergentes na direita religiosa: de um lado, dos admiradores da IA, de outro, seus céticos.

 Figuras como Peter Thiel, aliado do vice-presidente JD Vance e dono da Palantir, e outros entusiastas da tecnologia ligados à religião, como Katherine Boyle, uma das principais vozes da chamada “direita tecnológica”, católica e também próxima de Donald Trump e J.D Vance, e Trae Stephens, cofundador e presidente executivo da empresa de tecnologia de defesa Anduril Industries, sócio da Founders Fund, empresa de capital de risco de Peter Thiel,

estão liderando um esforço para defender que a IA é mais comparável a um “ente salvador”, até mesmo a um messias semelhante a Cristo. 


Assim, os cristãos têm sido convocados não só a abraçar a tecnologia, mas teriam a obrigação de fazê-lo, porque o progresso em si seria um bem moral.


A mensagem é sedutora para todo mundo porque promete para os pregadores da tecnologia uma legitimidade moral e, para os setores religiosos, a mesma tecnologia oferece poder, dinheiro e alcance no mundo contemporâneo. 


Uma pesquisa do Pew Research Center mostrou que,

em 2023, 52% dos americanos diziam estar mais preocupados do que entusiasmados com a inteligência artificial; em 2025, esse número caiu para 50%

, mas a desconfiança continua alta.

Por isso a legitimidade espiritual, que exige menos fatos concretos e mais a subjetividade da fé, se encaixa como uma luva.

 É uma tentativa de “reencantar a máquina”. 


No Brasil, esse movimento também cresce. O país tem cerca de 47 milhões de evangélicos, o equivalente a 27% da população, enquanto os católicos seguem como maioria, com 57%. E 95% dos brasileiros acessam a internet diariamente, segundo dados recentes do IBGE. E aí, claro: um país que é ao mesmo tempo massivamente cristão e massivamente conectado, se torna um laboratório perfeito para plataformas que transformam experiência religiosa em mercado digital.

author: Redação
title: Iniciativas de jornalismo lançam coalizão para investigar desinformação eleitoral
content:
Como nos anos anteriores, as eleições de 2026 prometem ser competitivas e polarizadas – mas os desafios em termos de desinformação devem ser ainda maiores.  


Regras eleitorais ainda pouco claras, compromissos reduzidos por parte das plataformas tecnológicas e o uso disseminado de Inteligência Artificial prometem ampliar a quantidade de conteúdos inautênticos e enganadores, piorando a qualidade do debate público em um momento crucial para a democracia brasileira. 


Por isso, quatro premiadas organizações de jornalismo resolveram unir forças para fazer uma cobertura colaborativa sobre a desinformação eleitoral. Trata-se do LIE – Laboratório de Investigação Eleitoral. Participam a Agência Pública, a mais premiada agência de jornalismo investigativo do Brasil; o canal

Amado Mundo

, lançado há um ano e que conta com jornalistas em diferentes cidades do Brasil e do exterior;

Aos Fatos

, organização jornalística pioneira no desenvolvimento de tecnologias e linguagens para o combate à desinformação no ambiente digital e nas políticas públicas e

Núcleo Jornalismo

, organização de jornalismo e comunidade que cobre o impacto da tecnologia na vida das pessoas.  


Juntos, eles terão uma equipe especializada, com editores, repórteres, analistas de inteligência e dados para investigar as principais campanhas desinformativas nas

eleições de 2026. 


“Durante as eleições de 2022, desenvolvemos a primeira versão deste laboratório investigativo, produzindo reportagens que tiveram impacto não só durante a campanha, mas também nos desafiadores meses seguintes. Estamos juntos novamente porque acreditamos no valor da cooperação para contar histórias relevantes e fazer a diferença em momentos decisivos”, afirma Tai Nalon, diretora executiva do Aos Fatos.


“Essa colaboração potencializa a nossa cobertura eleitoral, nos permite alcançar novos públicos e aumenta a nossa capacidade de gerar impacto real na sociedade por meio do nosso jornalismo”, explica Jade Drummond, diretora-executiva do Núcleo. Natalia Viana, diretora executiva da Agência Pública, concorda: “O desafio da desinformação neste ciclo eleitoral é gigante e é preciso que cada vez mais as redações colaborem para poder fazer uma cobertura de impacto”.     


“É fundamental discutir e acompanhar o desenrolar do período eleitoral em uma disputa polarizada e com uso e abuso de inteligência artificial. O combate à desinformação é uma meta de todos os veículos envolvidos em fazer um bom jornalismo. A cobertura colaborativa veio somar esforços para produção de material investigativo de alta qualidade em várias plataformas”, explica Angelina Nunes, editora de projetos especiais do canal Amado Mundo.


As pautas serão realizadas de maneira colaborativa. Com o

Radar

, ferramenta e núcleo de inteligência do Aos Fatos, a iniciativa vai monitorar o fluxo de informações e dados nas plataformas digitais, de modo a identificar o impacto e a abrangência de campanhas de desinformação e influência que desafiem o sistema eleitoral — e se antecipar a elas. Também durante o período, o Núcleo vai disponibilizar para as organizações parceiras acesso às ferramentas próprias Botponto, que monitora vídeos no YouTube e encontra o minuto exato em que palavras-chave são ditas, e Legislatech, que monitora documentos públicos diariamente. A Agência Pública disponibilizará um dashboard de dados de desinformação sobre soberania nas redes sociais. 


Os resultados das investigações podem ser acompanhados em todos os sites e no videocast Matinal, do Amado Mundo, disponível diariamente ao vivo no YouTube, às 8h30, ou, a partir das 10h, no Spotify.  


A maior parte das reportagens estará disponível para republicação nos sites das organizações participantes. Sugestões de pautas e dicas sobre conteúdos desinformativos são bem-vindos.


O projeto também contará com o apoio do NetLab, laboratório de pesquisa da Escola de Comunicação da

Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro

 (ECO –

UFRJ

) dedicado a diagnosticar o fenômeno da desinformação digital e suas consequências.

author: Redação
title: Laboratório de Investigação Eleitoral
content:
As eleições de 2026 acontecem em um cenário de forte polarização, avanço da inteligência artificial e circulação cada vez maior de conteúdos enganosos. Para investigar como a desinformação influencia o debate público e o processo eleitoral, Agência Pública, Amado Mundo, Aos Fatos e Núcleo Jornalismo se uniram no Laboratório de Investigação Eleitoral (LIE).


A iniciativa monitora redes e plataformas digitais, identifica campanhas de desinformação e investiga seus impactos nas eleições. Leia as reportagens do LIE e acompanhe as principais investigações sobre desinformação eleitoral em 2026.

title: Özgür Özel, Veli Ağbaba ve Sera Kadıgil’in fezlekeleri TBMM’de
content:
YENİ Parti Genel Başkanı Özgür Özel ve Malatya Milletvekili Veli Ağbaba ile Türkiye İşçi Partisi (TİP) İstanbul Milletvekili Saliha Sera Kadıgil'in yasama dokunulmazlıklarının kaldırılması hakkındaki fezlekeler TBMM Başkanlığı'na sunuldu.


YENİ Parti Genel Başkanı ve Manisa Milletvekili Özgür Özel ile Malatya Milletvekili Veli Ağbaba'nın yasama dokunulmazlıklarının kaldırılması hakkındaki Cumhurbaşkanlığı tezkeresi, 6 Ağustos tarihinde TBMM Başkanlığı'na geldi.


TİP İstanbul Milletvekili Sera Kadıgil'in yasama dokunulmazlığının kaldırılması hakkındaki Cumhurbaşkanlığı tezkeresi ise 7 Ağustos tarihinde TBMM Başkanlığı'na ulaştı.


Hazırlanan fezlekeler, Meclis Başkanlığınca "Gelen Kağıtlar" listesinde yayımlanarak Anayasa ve Adalet Komisyonu Üyelerinden Kurulu Karma Komisyona havale edildi.


Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı YENİ Parti Genel Başkanı Özgür Özel ve Malatya Milletvekili Veli Ağbaba hakkında "zincirleme şekilde rüşvet almak" suçundan yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında dokunulmazlıklarının kaldırılması talebiyle 4 Ağustos'ta fezleke hazırlandığını bildirmişti.


Süreç nasıl işliyor?


Fezleke süreci, bir milletvekilinin dokunulmazlığının kaldırılması amacıyla hazırlanan soruşturma dosyasının Meclis'te oylanarak karara bağlanması anlamına geliyor. Süreç, savcılık raporunun Adalet Bakanlığı ve Cumhurbaşkanlığı üzerinden Meclis'e ulaşmasıyla başlıyor, Karma Komisyon ve Genel Kurul aşamalarıyla devam ediyor.


Savcılık, suç iddiasına yönelik delilleri toplayarak bir fezleke hazırlıyor, dosya Adalet Bakanlığı ve Cumhurbaşkanlığı kanalıyla TBMM Başkanlığı'na gönderiliyor. TBMM Başkanlığı gelen fezlekeyi milletvekillerine duyuruyor. Fezleke, TBMM Anayasa ve Adalet Komisyonu üyelerinden oluşan Karma Komisyon'a sevk ediliyor, sonrasında kura ile beş kişilik bir Hazırlık Komisyonu kuruluyor.


Söz konusu milletvekili, Komisyonu'nda savunmasını yapıyor veya başka bir milletvekiline yaptırıyor. Bu komisyon bir ay içinde çalışmasını tamamlayıp raporunu Karma Komisyon'a sunuyor.


Karma Komisyon raporu görüşüyor, dokunulmazlığın kaldırılmasına ya da kovuşturmanın milletvekilliği sıfatının sonuna ertelenmesine karar veriyor. Sonrasında rapor TBMM Genel Kurulu gündemine giriyor. Milletvekili son savunmasını yapıyor.


Ayrı ayrı oylama yapılıyor


Bir milletvekili hakkında birden fazla fezleke varsa, her dosya için Genel Kurul'da ayrı ayrı oylama yapılıyor ve salt çoğunluk aranıyor.


Dokunulmazlığı kaldırılan milletvekili, kararın iptali için yedi gün içinde Anayasa Mahkemesi'ne (AYM) başvurabiliyor. Yüksek Mahkeme iptal istemini 15 gün içinde kesin olarak karara bağlıyor.


Başvuru reddedilirse veya başvuru yapılmazsa dokunulmazlık kalkıyor, dosya ilgili mahkemeye gidiyor ve milletvekilinin yargılanma süreci başlıyor.


Milletvekilliği sıfatı ise mahkeme kesin hüküm açıklayana kadar devam ediyor.


(HA)

title: 16 bar associations call for the shortcomings of the framework law to be addressed
content:
Sixteen bar associations from Kurdish provinces have called for amendments to the Framework Law adopted by the Turkish Parliament as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process. While welcoming the legislation as an important step toward ending the decades-long conflict, they said its scope and several of its provisions remain inadequate.


The joint statement was issued by the bar associations of Adıyaman, Ağrı, Batman, Bingöl, Bitlis, Dersim (Tunceli), Amed (Diyarbakır), Hakkari, Iğdır, Kars, Mardin, Muş, Siirt, Urfa, Şırnak, and Van.


"Law requires greater legal clarity"


According to the bar associations, the "Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Cohesion" creates an opportunity to bring the armed conflict to a lasting end and shift further political disputes onto the ground of law and democratic politics. "Against the backdrop of tens of thousands of deaths, forced displacement, deep social divisions, and the economic consequences of a conflict that has lasted for nearly half a century, we regard this approach as a historic opportunity."


At the same time, the bar associations said that significant clarification is needed. Provisions that allow for differing interpretations must be formulated in clear and predictable terms. The scope of the law must also be clearly defined, and objective criteria must be established to ensure its equal application.


"Lasting peace cannot be achieved through criminal law alone"


The bar associations also made clear that legislation governing the transition from armed conflict to democratic politics is not sufficient on its own. "It is evident that lasting peace cannot be achieved through criminal law measures alone," the joint statement said.


The joint statement underlined that the process must be based on the rule of law, transparency, social justice, and democratization. It also requires strengthening fundamental rights and freedoms as well as ensuring broad participation across society.


The bar associations therefore called for the existing shortcomings of the framework law to be addressed in accordance with universal legal principles and for the legislation to be incorporated into a broader democratization process.

title: Yemen'de hükümet güçleri Husilere saldırdı: Ölü ve yaralılar var
content:
Fotoğraf: Unknown authorUnknown author/Wikimedia Commons Public domain

Yemen’de hükümet güçleri ile Husiler arasındaki çatışmalar sürerken, ülkenin güneybatısındaki Dali kentinde Husilere yönelik saldırı düzenlendi.

Yemen devlet televizyonunun haberine göre, Yemen Silahlı Kuvvetleri Dali’nin kuzeyindeki el-Fahir Çarşısı çevresinde Husilere ait “toplanma noktaları ve takviye güçlerini” topçu atışlarıyla hedef aldı.

Haberde, saldırı sonucunda Husiler arasında ölen ve yaralananların olduğu belirtildi. Ancak ölü ve yaralı sayısına ilişkin herhangi bir bilgi paylaşılmadı.

Husiler de saldırıya ilişkin henüz açıklama yapmadı.

Bölgede çatışmaların yeniden yoğunlaştığı bir dönemde, Yemen resmi haber ajansı SABA, daha önce Husilerin ülkenin güneybatısında, Babu’l Mendeb Boğazı yakınlarındaki Moha Limanı’na balistik füzelerle saldırı düzenlediğini bildirmişti.

Husiler ise bir gün önce yaptıkları açıklamada, Yemen’in orta kesimindeki Moha ve Marib illerinde bulunan askeri mevzileri balistik füzeler ve insansız hava araçlarıyla hedef aldıklarını duyurmuştu.

Yemen’de Husiler ile hükümet güçleri arasındaki çatışmaların yanı sıra Kızıldeniz ve Babu’l Mendeb çevresindeki askeri hareketlilik de devam ediyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: anred
title: Denuncian penalmente a Marcos Galperin por usura en los préstamos de Mercado Pago
content:
Marcos Galperín, creador de Mercado Libre


Gabriel Solano, dirigente del Partido Obrero y del Frente de Izquierda, presentó una denuncia penal contra Marcos Galperin por los préstamos ofrecidos a través de Mercado Pago con altísimas tasas de interés que, en algunas operaciones, alcanzan un costo financiero total anual superior al 1.300%. La denuncia pone el foco en el crecimiento del crédito otorgado por plataformas fintech, en un contexto de pérdida de ingresos, exclusión del sistema bancario y creciente endeudamiento de los hogares, donde millones de personas recurren a préstamos para afrontar gastos cotidianos. «Estamos ante un verdadero mecanismo de usura, que se aprovecha de quienes necesitan dinero para llegar a fin de mes y no tienen otra alternativa. Mercado Pago convirtió el endeudamiento en un negocio masivo, automatizado y permanente», denuncia Solano. Según un relevamiento del Centro de Economía Política Argentina (CEPA), en mayo de 2026 la morosidad con entidades financieras alcanzó el 7,6%, siendo el nivel más alto de las últimas dos décadas. Asimismo, hay casi 6 millones de personas endeudadas morosas con bancos y billeteras virtuales y, en promedio, cada una debe $3.031.476.

Por ANRed.


El dirigente del Partido Obrero y del Frente de Izquierda

Gabriel Solano

 presentó una

denuncia penal contra Marcos Galperin

, dueño de

Mercado Libre

, por las condiciones de los préstamos ofrecidos a través de

Mercado Pago

. La presentación cuestiona tasas que, según Solano, llegan a superar el

1.300% de costo financiero total anual

, y reclama que la Justicia investigue si se configura el

delito de usura

.


«

Mercado Pago está haciendo un negocio extraordinario con la necesidad de millones de trabajadores que no pueden acceder al crédito bancario

. Estamos hablando de tasas que llegan a más de 1.300% de costo financiero total anual, mientras el Banco Nación presta a tasas varias veces inferiores e incluso refinancia a deudores en mora a tasas del 12 y 14%. No estamos ante una diferencia normal entre tasas de mercado:

estamos ante un verdadero mecanismo de usura, que se aprovecha de quienes necesitan dinero para llegar a fin de mes y no tienen otra alternativa

«, denuncia Solano.


La presentación invoca el

artículo 175 bis del Código Penal

, referido al

delito de usura

, y plantea que las tasas deberían ser analizadas a la luz de la situación económica de quienes recurren al financiamiento: «esto califica como delito de usura. El Código Penal en el artículo 175 bis refiere ‘al que, aprovechando la necesidad, la ligereza o la inexperiencia de una persona le hiciere dar o prometer, en cualquier forma, para sí o para otro, intereses u otras ventajas pecuniarias evidentemente desproporcionadas con su prestación, u otorgar recaudos o garantías de carácter extorsivo,

será reprimido con prisión de uno a tres años

‘ «, detalló el dirigente.


Marcos Galperín.


Solano también cuestionó el carácter masivo y automatizado del sistema de préstamos: «

la particularidad de Mercado Pago es que convirtió el endeudamiento en un negocio masivo, automatizado y permanente.

La propia información del Banco Central muestra que la morosidad en las billeteras virtuales es muy superior a la de los bancos, mientras millones de personas migran hacia estas plataformas porque quedaron afuera del sistema financiero tradicional».


El crecimiento del financiamiento no bancario se da mientras aumenta la presión del endeudamiento sobre los hogares. Un informe del Banco Central sobre proveedores no financieros de crédito registró un aumento real de la cartera de préstamos personales del grupo fintech entre agosto de 2025 y febrero de 2026, mientras que la deuda promedio por persona alcanzó $1,1 millones en febrero. En paralelo, el BCRA informó que la morosidad de las financiaciones a las familias alcanzó el

12,1% en abril de 2026

.


Gabriel Solano, dirigente del Partido Obrero y del Frente de Izquierda y los Trabajadores (FIT) Unidad.


Para Solano, el problema excede las condiciones particulares de un préstamo y se vincula con la falta de regulación específica sobre las plataformas digitales: «

la ausencia de regulación específica no habilita a una empresa a cobrar cualquier tasa ni la coloca por encima del Código Penal

. Reclamamos que la Justicia investigue porque detrás de estas tasas existe un aprovechamiento sistemático de la necesidad, ligereza o inexperiencia de los usuarios», sostuvo.


La denuncia también …

title: Barana meteoran a Perseidê îşev e: Li Tirkiyeyê welatî li kîjan bajarî di saet çendî de dikare bibîne?
content:
Barana meteoran a Perseidê her sal di mehên Tîrmeh û Tebaxê de tê dîtin û îşev jî dê bigehêje asta xwe ya herî bilind.


Çavkaniya barana meteoran ji wan hûrikan pêktên ku stêrka bi dûvik a bi navê "109P/Swift-Tuttle" li pey xwe dihêle. Dema Cîhan di wê herêma van hûrikan re derbas dibe, parçeyên wan ên dikevin atmosferê dişewitin û şopên ronahiyê çêdikin.


TUBİTAKê jî diyar kir ku Çalakiya Çavdêriya Ezman ku di navbera 12-15ê Tebaxa 2026an de li Gola Emre ya li Afyonkarahisarê li dar dixe, rastî barana meteoran a Perseidê a herî zêde tê.


Demên herî guncaw piştî nîvê şevê ne


Meteor dê piştî ku hewa tarî bibe werin dîtin. Lê belê tê çaverêkirin ku dema herî guncaw ji bo dîtinê saetên di navbera 02.00 û 05.00an de be.


Ji ber zêdebûne ronahiyê ya li navendên bajaran, cihên tarî, vekirî û yên ku qada wan a dîtinê berfirehtir e tên pêşniyarkirin ku ji bo baştir barana meteoran bê temaşekirin.


Ji bo temaşekirina barana meteoran pêdivî teleskop ango dûrbînê nîne.

Li Stenbolê herêmên ku ji ronahiya bajar hinekî dûr in Şîle, Agva, Riva, Anadolu Feneri, Poyrazkoy, Çatalca û Terkos e; li Enqereyê Kizilcahamam û dora wê û li Îzmîrê jî qadên tarî yên mîna Karaburunê ji bo temaşekirina barana meteoran baş in.

title: Filistin Esirler Cemiyeti: İsrail hapishanelerinde 40 gazeteci tutuluyor
content:
Filistin Esirler Cemiyeti, İsrail hapishanelerinde 40 Filistinli gazetecinin tutulduğunu açıkladı. Cemiyet, gazetecilerden 19’unun herhangi bir suçlama veya yargılama olmaksızın “idari tutukluluk” kapsamında tutulduğunu bildirdi.

Açıklamada, halen tutuklu bulunan gazeteciler arasında 5 kadın gazetecinin de olduğu belirtildi.

Filistin Esirler Cemiyeti, İsrail’in Ekim 2023’te başlayan saldırılarından bu yana 250’den fazla Filistinli gazetecinin tutuklandığını veya gözaltına alındığını bildirdi.

40 gazetecinin İsrail hapishanelerinde tutulduğunu belirten Cemiyet, 19 gazetecinin idari tutukluluk kapsamında olduğunu, 3 gazeteci hakkında ise ev hapsi uygulandığını kaydetti.

İdari tutukluluk uygulamasında İsrail makamları, kişileri resmi bir suçlama veya yargılama olmaksızın, belirli sürelerle tutuklayabiliyor.

Cemiyetin açıklamasında, İsrail’in Ekim 2023’ten bu yana Gazze ve diğer Filistin topraklarına yönelik saldırılarında 260’tan fazla gazetecinin öldürüldüğü ileri sürüldü.

Bu gazetecilerden ikisinin İsrail hapishanelerinde hayatını kaybettiği belirtildi.

Açıklamada ayrıca gazeteciler Nidal el-Vahidi ve Heysem Abdülvahid’in zorla kaybedildiği ve akıbetlerinin halen bilinmediği ifade edildi.

Filistin Esirler Cemiyeti, gazetecilerin öldürülmesi, tutuklanması, işkenceye maruz bırakılması ve zorla kaybedilmesinin münferit uygulamalar olmadığını savundu.

Açıklamada, bu uygulamaların “gerçeğin susturulmasını ve Filistin anlatısının bastırılmasını amaçlayan sistematik bir politikanın parçası” olduğu belirtildi.

Cemiyet, gazetecilerin hedef alınmasının Filistin’de yaşananların kamuoyuna aktarılmasını engellemeye yönelik olduğunu ifade etti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: French philosopher Catherine Malabou writes to Öcalan: “You unquestionably deserve your freedom”
content:
Support continues to grow from internationally renowned intellectuals, writers, philosophers, and sociologists for Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan’s

Call for Peace and Democratic Society

 of February 27, 2025, and the law subsequently passed by Parliament in search of peace and democratization.


In this context, French philosopher Catherine Malabou sent a letter to Öcalan, highlighting what she described as his “wise” and “courageous” decision.


The letter, which was delivered to the İmralı Delegation for transmission to the Kurdish leader, who has been incarcerated in Imrali Island Prison since 1999, reads:


“Many of us, in Turkey and around the world, who support the dignity, freedom, and recognition of the Kurdish people, are deeply pleased to know that a process has truly begun to grant civil rights to former members of the PKK. This latest development is a great victory, achieved thanks to your wise and courageous decision to engage in a peaceful political process.


Democracy must prevail whenever and wherever it is possible. In France, many people like myself read your works and are deeply interested in the model of political organization that you have conceived and advocated—democratic confederalism. The only intolerable reality is knowing that you are still being held in prison. I hope this inhumane situation will come to an end soon. After all these years, you deserve to live as a free person; you unquestionably deserve your freedom. In the meantime, keep up your courage, dear ‘Apo.’”


Background


Catherine Malabou is a French philosopher born on October 15, 1959. She completed her Ph.D. in 1994 at the École des Hautes Études en Sciences Sociales (EHESS) under the supervision of Jacques Derrida. Her doctoral dissertation on Hegel was titled

L’Avenir de Hegel: Plasticité, temporalité, dialectique

 (

The Future of Hegel: Plasticity, Temporality, Dialectic

). Malabou’s relationship with Derrida extended beyond that of student and mentor; the two later co-authored

La Contre-allée

(1999).


Malabou is best known for her interpretations of Hegel and for her original philosophical development of the concept of “plasticity.” By connecting Hegelian dialectics with contemporary philosophy and neuroscience, she rethinks the formation and transformation of the subject. She uses the concept of plasticity both to explain the brain’s neurobiological capacity for change and to explore the transformability of identities, social structures, and political forms. As a leading figure in post-Derrida and post-Heidegger continental philosophy, Malabou is also recognized as one of the pioneers in fostering dialogue between philosophy and neuroscience.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish musician Nuarîn detained upon arrival in Turkey
content:
Kurdish musician Nuarîn was detained immediately after entering Turkey. The artist, who has been living in Europe for the past eleven years, was taken into custody on Tuesday upon her arrival at Çukurova Airport near Mersin and has remained in detention since then.


No information has yet been released regarding the reasons for her detention. A confidentiality order has been imposed on the investigation file, meaning that the charges against the musician have not been disclosed.


Nuarîn is originally from Nusaybin district in the province of Mardin. She began her musical career in 2004 at the Mesopotamia Cultural Center (NÇM) in Mersin. She initially performed with the group Koma Nuarîn, which was named after her. After the group disbanded, she continued her musical career as a solo artist under the name Nuarîn from 2008 onward. She has been living in Paris for several years, where she continues her artistic work.

author: Daron Letts
title: ‘This is a resurrection’: Kivalliq Summer Games returns after 12-year hiatus
content:
The first Kivalliq Summer Games to be held in 12 years is expected to draw more than two dozen athletes from the region to Chesterfield Inlet this week.


“This is a resurrection of the Games,” said hamlet recreation co-ordinator Russell Mullins, who is organizing the event.


From Thursday to Sunday, 26 athletes from Arviat, Baker Lake, Rankin Inlet and Chesterfield Inlet are set to compete in Arctic sports ranging from the four-man carry to the knuckle hop.


Athletes are categorized as under-18 juniors or over-18 seniors. There are 17 males and nine females taking part, ranging from age 12 to 34.

Six of the 10 Chesterfield Inlet athletes are competing for the first time.


The idea to bring the Games back stemmed from a conversation between Mullins and Schultz during the Arctic Winter Games in Whitehorse in March.


“We j

ust realized that we are s

everely outgunned by all the other territories, Nunavik, and Alaska,” he said, referring to Nunavut’s performance in the Arctic games.


Other regions, such as the Northwest Territories and Greenland, hold their own competitions.


“Why not Nunavut?” Mullins said.


Many people in the community are doing a little something to help out, including residents Glen Brocklebank and Ana Leishman, who are among those volunteering.


Their 17-year-old daughter Ivalu Leishman-Brocklebank is competing in all the events.


“It’s been a long time,” said Brocklebank, in an interview on Tuesday. “The Games are fun and exciting to watch. I’m pretty pumped.”


All the events will take place in the Victor Sammurtok School gym, except the walrus pull, which will be held outdoors.


The walrus pull involves an athlete resisting competitors who try to pull the athlete upright.


This and other strength competitions, such as the arm pull and the head pull, are judged best out of three rounds.


In the kicking events, including the two-foot and one-foot high kicks, as well as the Alaskan high kick, the target will be raised approximately 7.5 centimetres each round until the top three athletes are determined.


Judging the competition are Peter Tautu, Mark Amarok and Gloria Thompson from Chesterfield Inlet and Mary Anne Hananak from Whale Cove.


The Kivalliq Inuit Association is a sponsor.


“KIA is pleased to support opportunities that bring our communities together through sport,” said KIA president Kono Tattuinee in an email.


Tattuinee said he looks forward to seeing “the talent, dedication, and teamwork on display throughout the Games.”


Nunavut Sport Federation is also providing funding. Its o

perations manager, Scott Schultz, took care of the logistics and travel arrangements.


The Northern store is providing discounted food for the event, which parents and other volunteers will help to prepare and serve in the school kitchen.


Most athletes will stay with relatives in the community. Cots will be set up in a classroom in the school for any athletes who need accommodations.


“We’re pretty much ready for the athletes to start coming,” Mullins said.


The opening ceremonies are scheduled to begin at 6:30 p.m. on Thursday. Closing ceremonies follow the junior boys’ and senior men’s knuckle hop competition at 9 p.m. on Sunday.

author: Andrés
title: Nube 9: 25 años de música, memoria y Beatles
content:
Nube 9 celebró sus 25 años de trayectoria en el Teatro del Globo con un recorrido por toda la discografía de The Beatles. Liderada por Fernando Blanco, la banda desplegó una potente presentación en uno de los escenarios emblemáticos del centro porteño, ante un público que cantó y vibró durante toda la noche.

Por Daniel Ávalos para ANRed.


Foto: Daniel Ávalos


El Teatro del Globo fue escenario de una noche cargada de música y memoria. Nube 9, una de las bandas argentinas con mayor trayectoria en la interpretación de la obra de The Beatles, festejó sus 25 años con un show que recorrió distintas etapas de la discografía del cuarteto de Liverpool.


Desde el comienzo, la banda funcionó como un reloj. La precisión musical, las excelentes interpretaciones vocales y el cuidado de los arreglos les permitió transitar por distintas épocas de The Beatles sin perder intensidad. Fernando Blanco, al frente de Nube 9, comandó una formación que se mostró sólida y potente sobre el escenario.


Foto: Daniel Ávalos


El recorrido musical estuvo acompañado por imágenes que recuperaron parte de la historia de estos 25 años. Videos de distintas presentaciones y viajes alrededor del mundo mostraron el camino construido por la banda a lo largo de un cuarto de siglo.


Foto: Daniel Ávalos


Del otro lado del escenario, el público fue protagonista. Canción tras canción, las voces de la sala acompañaron las interpretaciones de Nube 9, transformando el recital en una celebración colectiva. Los clásicos de The Beatles volvieron a encontrarse con varias generaciones de espectadores que los hicieron propios una vez más.


Foto: Daniel Ávalos


Reducir a Nube 9 a una banda tributo sería quedarse corto. Hay en su propuesta una identidad construida durante 25 años, una forma particular de interpretar y transmitir la música de The Beatles que ya tiene sello propio.En el Teatro del Globo, Nube 9 celebró su historia mirando hacia atrás, pero también reafirmando el presente. Veinticinco años después, la música continúa sonando.Buena vida a Nube 9. Y que sigan los Beatles.
